Base helpers in `permissions.role-based.base.ts`.
    
    ##### Inputs
    Request contexts (`requestingPrincipal()` -> user Mongoose doc with populated `roleId {permissions[]}`, `mageEvent`), event documents (`acl`, `teamIds`), permission names.
    
    ##### Processing flow
    - `ensureContextUserHasPermission(ctx, perm)`: no roleId -> denied 'anonymous'; role.permissions includes perm -> null; else `permissionDenied(perm, username)`.
    - `userRoleHasPermission(user, perm)`: false if no user/role.
    - `authorizeEventAccess(event, user, appPerm, eventPerm)`: role has appPerm -> allow; else `userHasEventPermission`; else denied(appPerm, username, eventId).
    - `userHasEventPermission`: if 'read' and `userIsParticipantInEvent` (event's populated teams contain userId via `findTeamsInEvent`: findById if not a model instance, populate teamIds, team.toJSON with id hex) -> true; else `event.acl[userId]` (string or `{role}`) in `rolesWithPermission(perm)` (OWNER: read/update/delete, MANAGER: read/update, GUEST: read).
    - `EventFeedsPermissionService`: fetch feed content requires `READ_EVENT_USER` role or event read; ALL other feed admin ops (list service types, create service, list services, list topics, create feed, list all feeds) are unconditionally denied in this event-scoped service.
    - `ObservationPermissionsServiceImpl`: create = `CREATE_OBSERVATION` + event participant (team membership only, not ACL); update = `UPDATE_OBSERVATION_ALL`, or `UPDATE_OBSERVATION_EVENT` + event **read** access; read = `READ_OBSERVATION_ALL` or `READ_OBSERVATION_EVENT` + event read; store attachment content: unknown attachment -> allowed (null); update permission -> allowed; when content not yet stored, creator with create permission -> allowed (create-only role compatibility); else denied 'STORE_ATTACHMENT_CONTENT'.
    - Icons: create requires `STATIC_ICON_WRITE`; get always allowed.
    - Map settings: `MAP_SETTINGS_READ` / `MAP_SETTINGS_UPDATE`.
    - Users: `READ_USER`; preferences: any authenticated principal.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[authorizeEventAccess] --> B{userRoleHasPermission appPerm}
      B -->|yes| OK[null]
      B -->|no| C[userHasEventPermission]
      C --> D{read and userIsParticipantInEvent?}
      D -->|yes| OK
      D -->|no| E{acl userId role in rolesWithPermission}
      E -->|yes| OK
      E -->|no| X[permissionDenied]
      D -.-> F[MongooseMageEventRepository.findTeamsInEvent populate teamIds]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Reads `events` (acl, teamIds) and `teams` (userIds) via populate; no writes.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    `PermissionDeniedError | null` or boolean.
    
    ##### External calls
    `MongooseMageEventRepository.findTeamsInEvent`, `rolesWithPermission`, `permissionDenied`.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - Team membership grants only 'read', never update/delete.
    - `userIsParticipantInEvent` uses `team.userIds.indexOf(userId)` — relies on string/ObjectId equality after toJSON; mismatched types would silently deny.
    - Observation update with `UPDATE_OBSERVATION_EVENT` needs only event READ (not update).
    - Attachment-content check returns null (allowed) when the attachment id is not on the observation; caller must handle 404.
    - Every permission check does a DB populate of teams (no caching).

    Commentary: Store attachment content permission logic
    Code:
        async ensureStoreAttachmentContentPermission(context: ObservationRequestContext<UserWithRole>, observation: Observation, attachmentId: AttachmentId): Promise<PermissionDeniedError | null> {
          const user = context.requestingPrincipal()
          const attachment = observation.attachmentFor(attachmentId)
          if (!attachment) {
            return null
          }
          const hasUpdatePermission = await this.ensureUpdateObservationPermission(context).then(x => x === null)
          const contentExists = !!attachment.contentLocator
          if (contentExists) {
            if (hasUpdatePermission) {
              return null
            }
          }
          else {
            if (hasUpdatePermission) {
              return null
            }
            /*
            TODO:
            This create permission check preserves backward compatibility for a MAGE
            client that uses a role with permission only to create observations, but
            not update them.  Adding attachments requires two or more requests, one
            to create the observation document with attachment meta-data embdedded in
            form field entries, and one request per attachment to save the content of
            the attachment(s).  Hence, to support the create-only role, the old
            attachment submission code checked for observation create permission
            instead of observation update permission to ensure that users with the
            create-only role could still add attachment content to observations they
            created.
      
            This permission check should go away when we implement fully custom roles
            and permissions management, however, we may also need to implement some
            kind of transaction mechanism to group all the requests for submitting an
            observation with attachments, whether creating or updating.  This could
            be some token that the service returns and the API client submits with
            each request until the observation submission is complete.
            */
            const isContextUserCreator = observation.userId === user.id
            if (isContextUserCreator && await this.ensureCreateObservationPermission(context).then(x => x === null)) {
              return null
            }
          }
          return permissionDenied('STORE_ATTACHMENT_CONTENT', user.id, `observation ${observation.id}, attachment ${attachmentId}`)
        }

    - **getObservations(event, o)**: filter.geometry -> `$geoIntersects`; `startDate`/`endDate` -> `lastModified` `$gte`/`$lt`; `observationStartDate`/`observationEndDate` -> `properties.timestamp`; `states` -> `states.0.name $in`; `favorites.userId` -> `favoriteUserIds $in`; `important` -> `important $exists`; `o.sort`; fields via `parseFields` (nested object -> dotted projection, default id/type true, `state` flag -> `states:{$slice:1}`; no fields -> `{states:{$slice:1}}`); `filter.attachments===true` -> `attachments:{$slice:0}`; `o.lean`; `o.populate` -> userId and important.userId displayName; `o.stream` -> returns `query.cursor()` (no callback) else exec callback.
    - **createObservationId**: insert empty doc into `observationids`; **getObservationId**: findById -> `_id` or null.
    - **getLatestObservation**: max `lastModified`.
    - **getObservationById**: with parsed fields.
    - **updateObservation(event, id, update)** (create-or-update): each `properties.forms` entry gets `_id` (existing or new ObjectId), `id` deleted; for fields whose event form definition type is `attachment`, entries with `action:'add'` become attachment stubs `{observationFormId, fieldName, name, contentType}`, entries with `action:'delete'` collect ids; the field is removed from the form entry. `findById`; if missing create new with `_id`, `userId`, `deviceId`, `states:[{name:'active', userId}]`. Overwrite `type`, `geometry`, `properties`; append adds; filter out deletes; `save`; populate user displayNames.
    - **removeObservation**: findByIdAndDelete.
    - **removeUser / removeDevice**: for every event (`Event.getEvents`) `updateMany({userId|deviceId}, $unset)`.
    - **addState**: `$push states $each [state] $position 0` only if current `states.0.name != state.name`; returns state even if not applied.
    - **addFavorite/removeFavorite**: `$addToSet`/`$pull favoriteUserIds`. **addImportant/removeImportant**: set/unset `important`.
    - **getAttachment**: findOne with attachment id; returns matching subdoc (throws if observation null).
    - **addAttachment** (legacy): match elem by id+contentType+name; set size and relativePath. **removeAttachment**: `$pull`. **addAttachmentThumbnail**: `$push attachments.$.thumbnails`.

    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[updateObservation] --> B[forms: assign _id, split attachment add/delete]
      B --> C[observationModel event.collectionName findById]
      C --> D{exists}
      D -- no --> E[new doc states active]
      D -- yes --> F[existing]
      E --> G[set type geometry properties; merge attachments]
      F --> G --> H[save] --> I[populate userId important.userId]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Collection `observations<eventId>` (owner: observations capability; exports read it). Schema: `type enum['Feature'] required`, `lastModified` (timestamps updatedAt) and `createdAt`, `userId`, `deviceId`, `geometry Mixed`, `properties Mixed` (incl. `timestamp`, `forms[]`), `attachments[AttachmentSchema]`, `states[{name, userId}]`, `important{userId,timestamp,description}`, `favoriteUserIds[]`; strict:false. Attachment: `observationFormId ObjectId req`, `fieldName req`, lastModified, contentType, size, name, relativePath, width, height, `oriented` default false, `thumbnails[{minDimension req, contentType,size,name,width,height,relativePath}]`, `processingStatus enum pending|success|rejected|error`, processingMessage, processingHook, stagedContentId, `processingRetryCount` default 0. Indexes: geometry 2dsphere, lastModified, userId sparse, deviceId sparse, properties.timestamp, states.name, attachments.lastModified/oriented/contentType/thumbnails.minDimension/processingStatus. Other models: `ObservationId` (collection `observationids`, empty schema), `Attachment`, `Thumbnail`, `State` registered for schema reuse.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    Writes observation docs; cross-event `updateMany` on user/device deletion.
    
    ##### External calls
    models/event.getEvents.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - `updateObservation` throws if a form entry's `formId` is not in event.forms (`formDefinition` undefined).
    - `removeDevice` calls `Event.getEvents(callback)` (options-less) vs `removeUser` `getEvents({}, cb)`; both fetch all events without access filter.
    - `addState` is a conditional no-op without signaling.
    - Attachment `url` presence signals stored content to clients — keep.
    - `$slice:1` on states means only current state returned by default.

    ##### Entry point
    Module functions in models/observation.js called by legacy api/observation, api/attachment, user/device delete hooks, exports, and `app.param('observationId')`.
    
    ##### Inputs
    `event` (needs `collectionName`, `forms`), ids, filter objects.
    
    ##### Processing flow
    - `observationModel(event)`: lazily `mongoose.model(collectionName, ObservationSchema, collectionName)` cached in `models` map -> collection `observations<eventId>`.
    - `getObservations(event, o)`: conditions: `geometry $geoIntersects`, `lastModified` [$gte startDate, $lt endDate), `properties.timestamp` [$gte observationStartDate, $lt observationEndDate), `states.0.name $in states`, `favoriteUserIds $in [favorites.userId]`, `important $exists` if important. options.sort. `parseFields`: projection from nested object flattened to dot keys, default id/type true, `state` -> `states $slice 1`; no fields -> `{states:{$slice:1}}`. `filter.attachments===true` -> `attachments $slice 0` (contradictory: excludes attachments). `lean`, `populate` userId & important.userId (displayName). `o.stream` -> returns `query.cursor()` (stream used by exports) else callback.
    - `createObservationId`: inserts empty doc into `observationids` (id reservation); `getObservationId` verifies.
    - `getLatestObservation`: findOne sort lastModified desc, projection lastModified.
    - `getObservationById(event,id,{fields})`.
    - `updateObservation(event,id,update)`: each `properties.forms[]` entry gets `_id` (new ObjectId if absent), `id` removed; for fields whose event form definition type is `attachment`: entries with `action:'add'` become attachment subdocs `{observationFormId, fieldName, name, contentType}`; `action:'delete'` ids collected; field removed from form entry. Load doc; if absent create new with `_id`, userId, deviceId, `states:[{name:'active',userId}]` (upsert-by-id). Set type, geometry, properties; append adds; filter removes; `save()`; populate users.
    - `removeObservation`: findByIdAndDelete.
    - `removeUser`/`removeDevice`: for every event (`Event.getEvents`) `updateMany {userId|deviceId} $unset`.
    - `addState`: `updateOne({_id, 'states.0.name' $ne name}, $push states $each [state] $position 0)` (state history newest first, no duplicate consecutive state).
    - `addFavorite`/`removeFavorite`: `$addToSet`/`$pull favoriteUserIds`.
    - `addImportant`: set `important`; `removeImportant`: `$unset`.
    - `getAttachment`, `addAttachment` (elemMatch on id+contentType+name, sets `attachments.$.size/relativePath`), `removeAttachment` ($pull), `addAttachmentThumbnail` ($push thumbnails).
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      C[callers api.Observation / api.Attachment / exports] --> OM[observationModel event -> observationsN]
      OM --> Q[getObservations find + parseFields] -->|o.stream| CUR[query.cursor]
      OM --> UO[updateObservation: split attachment actions -> findById -> new or update -> save -> populate]
      OM --> ST[addState $push position 0]
      OM --> FAV[add/removeFavorite, add/removeImportant]
      OM --> ATT[get/add/removeAttachment, addAttachmentThumbnail]
      U[User/Device delete] --> RU[removeUser/removeDevice: Event.getEvents -> updateMany unset]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Collection per event `observations<eventId>` (strict:false; timestamps createdAt/lastModified): `type enum Feature req, lastModified, userId, deviceId, geometry Mixed, properties Mixed (properties.forms[] with _id, formId, field values; properties.timestamp), attachments[{observationFormId req, fieldName req, lastModified, contentType, size, name, relativePath, width, height, oriented=false, thumbnails[{minDimension req, contentType, size, name, width, height, relativePath}], processingStatus enum pending|success|rejected|error, processingMessage, processingHook, stagedContentId, processingRetryCount=0}], states[{name, userId}], important{userId,timestamp,description}, favoriteUserIds[]`. Indexes: geometry 2dsphere, lastModified, userId sparse, deviceId sparse, properties.timestamp, states.name, attachments.lastModified/oriented/contentType/thumbnails.minDimension/processingStatus. `observationids` collection (empty docs).
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    JSON transform: `id`, `eventId` (if options.event), `url=<path>/<id>`, `state` = first state with `url=<obsUrl>/states/<id>`, form entries `id`, attachments `id` and `url=<obsUrl>/attachments/<id>` only if `relativePath` set (clients rely on url presence to detect stored attachment), thumbnails removed, populated `user` with `userId` kept as id, `important.user`.
    
    ##### External calls
    None.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - `updateObservation` throws if `formEntry.formId` not in event.forms (formDefinition undefined).
    - `removeUser` passes `{}` options, so `Event.getEvents` runs with no access filter but populates nothing; errors from getEvents ignored. `removeDevice` calls getEvents with function-only signature.
    - `getAttachment` throws if observation not found (observation null).
    - `filter.attachments===true` projects attachments away — counterintuitive.
    - Date upper bounds are exclusive.
    - Callers of updateObservation outside batch (validation layer) not traced -> medium confidence.

  Snippet: service/src/models/observation.js:338-405
    Commentary: Observation upsert with attachment action handling.
    Code:
      exports.updateObservation = function (event, observationId, update, callback) {
        let addAttachments = [];
        let removeAttachments = [];
        const { forms = [] } = update.properties || {};
        forms.map(observationForm => {
          observationForm._id = observationForm._id || new mongoose.Types.ObjectId();
          delete observationForm.id;
          return observationForm;
        })
          .forEach(formEntry => {
            // TODO: move to app or web layer
            const formDefinition = event.forms.find(form => form._id === formEntry.formId);
            Object.keys(formEntry).forEach(fieldName => {
              const fieldDefinition = formDefinition.fields.find(field => field.name === fieldName);
              if (fieldDefinition && fieldDefinition.type === 'attachment') {
                const attachments = formEntry[fieldName] || [];
                addAttachments = addAttachments.concat(attachments
                  .filter(attachment => attachment.action === 'add')
                  .map(attachment => {
                    return {
                      observationFormId: formEntry._id,
                      fieldName: fieldName,
                      name: attachment.name,
                      contentType: attachment.contentType
                    }
                  }));
      
                removeAttachments = removeAttachments.concat(attachments
                  .filter(attachment => attachment.action === 'delete')
                  .map(attachment => attachment.id)
                );
      
                delete formEntry[fieldName]
              }
            });
          });
      
        const ObservationModel = observationModel(event);
        ObservationModel.findById(observationId)
          .then(observation => {
            if (!observation) {
              observation = new ObservationModel({
                _id: observationId,
                userId: update.userId,
                deviceId: update.deviceId,
                states: [{ name: 'active', userId: update.userId }]
              });
            }
      
            observation.type = update.type;
            observation.geometry = update.geometry;
            observation.properties = update.properties;
            observation.attachments = observation.attachments.concat(addAttachments);
            observation.attachments = observation.attachments.filter(attachment => {
              return !removeAttachments.includes(attachment._id.toString())
            });
      
            return observation.save();
          })
          .then(observation => {
            return observation
              .populate([{ path: 'userId', select: 'displayName' }, { path: 'important.userId', select: 'displayName' }]);
          })
          .then(observation => {
            callback(null, observation);
          })
          .catch(err => callback(err));
      };

  Description: ##### Entry point
    Express routes registered by `routes/layers.js` (loaded dynamically by `routes/index.js` via `modulesPathsInDir`). `app.all('/api/layers*', bearerAuthentication)` (L16) applies bearer auth to every `/api/layers...` path; `/api/events/:eventId/...` routes add bearer auth explicitly. Path params resolved by `routes/index.js` `app.param`: `layerId` -> `new api.Layer().getLayer(id)` (`Layer.findById`) into `req.layer` (404 'Layer not found'); `eventId` must match `/^[0-9]+$/` (else 400) -> `Event.getById(id,{populate:false})` into `req.event` (404 'Event not found').
    
    | Method | Path | Gate | Handler chain |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | GET | /api/layers | access.authorize('READ_LAYER_ALL') | parseQueryParams -> api.Layer.getLayers({includeUnavailable}) -> layerXform.transform |
    | GET | /api/layers/count | READ_LAYER_ALL | api.Layer.count -> {count} |
    | POST | /api/events/:eventId/features | validateEventAccess | getLayers({layerIds,type:'GeoPackage',state:'available'}) -> GeoPackageUtility.getClosestFeatures |
    | GET | /api/layers/:layerId/features | READ_LAYER_ALL | type must be 'Feature' -> api.Feature.getAll -> FeatureCollection |
    | GET | /api/layers/:layerId/:tableName/:z/:x/:y.:format | READ_LAYER_ALL | handleGeoPackageXYZTileRequest |
    | GET | /api/events/:eventId/layers | validateEventAccess | getLayers({layerIds:event.layerIds,type,includeUnavailable}) |
    | GET | /api/layers/:layerId/file | READ_LAYER_ALL | stream file from layerBaseDirectory |
    | GET | /api/layers/:layerId | READ_LAYER_ALL | JSON or file stream (content negotiation) |
    | GET | /api/events/:eventId/layers/:layerId | validateEventAccess | same as above |
    | GET | /api/events/:eventId/layers/:layerId/:tableName/:z/:x/:y.:format | validateEventAccess | handleGeoPackageXYZTileRequest |
    | GET | /api/events/:eventId/layers/:layerId/features | validateEventAccess | Feature type + layer in event check -> getAll |
    | POST | /api/layers (1st) | CREATE_LAYER | upload.single('geopackage') -> validateLayerParams -> create non-file layer |
    | POST | /api/layers (2nd) | (none of its own; reached only via next() from 1st) | validateGeopackage -> create -> processGeoPackage -> respond |
    | PUT | /api/layers/:layerId/available | UPDATE_LAYER | processGeoPackage -> 202 |
    | PUT | /api/layers/:layerId | UPDATE_LAYER | validateLayerParams -> api.Layer(id).update |
    | POST | /api/layers/wms/getcapabilities | bearer only (no permission) | superagent GET `${url}?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities` |
    | DELETE | /api/layers/:layerId | DELETE_LAYER | api.Layer.remove -> 200 |
    
    ##### Inputs
    - Query: `type`, `includeUnavailable` (parseQueryParams uses deprecated `req.param`, so body/query/params all accepted).
    - POST /api/layers body (multipart or JSON): `type` (required: 'Imagery' | 'Feature' | 'GeoPackage'), `name` (required), `description`, Imagery fields `url`, `base`, `format`, `wms{layers,styles,format,transparent,version}`; multipart file field `geopackage` stored by multer to `env.tempDirectory` (MAGE_TEMP_DIR, default /tmp) as `<16 random bytes hex><ext>`.
    - POST /api/events/:eventId/features body: `layerIds: [{id, table}]`, `latlng: {lat,lng}` (coerced with `Number()`), `tile` (passed through).
    - Tile params: `x,y,z` digits (coerced `Number`), `tableName`, query `stroke`, `fill`, `width`.
    - WMS: body `url`.
    
    ##### Processing flow
    1. **validateEventAccess** (L162): pass if role has `READ_LAYER_ALL`; else if role has `READ_LAYER_EVENT` and `defaultEventPermissionsService.userHasEventPermission(req.event, req.user.id, 'read')` (true if user is in any of the event's teams, or event `acl[userId]` role is OWNER/MANAGER/GUEST) pass; else 403.
    2. **validateLayerParams**: 400 `cannot create layer "type" param not specified` / `... "name" ...`; sets `req.newLayer = req.body` (whole body, no whitelist).
    3. **Create (non-file)**: if `req.file` absent -> `state='available'` -> `api.Layer.create` -> `Counter.getNext('layer')` numeric id; `Feature` type: `collectionName='features'+id`, `db.createCollection('features'+id)` then `Layer.create`; other types: `Layer.create` directly. Response `layerXform.transform(layer,{path:`${req.getPath()}/${id}`})` with `Location: <id>` header.
    4. **Create (GeoPackage)** when a file was uploaded: 1st handler calls `next()` -> falls to 2nd `POST /api/layers`: `validateGeopackage` returns next() if body.type !== 'GeoPackage' (then creates whatever type with state unset -> see notes); 400 if no file; sets `state='unavailable'`, `geopackage=req.file`, runs `GeoPackageUtility.validate(path)`; validation errors stored as `invalid.errors` (not a rejection); thrown error -> 400 'Cannot create layer, GeoPackage is not valid ...'. `api.Layer.create` -> createGeoPackageLayer: `file={name:originalname, contentType:mimetype, size, relativePath: <id>/<multer filename>}`, `fs.copy(temp, layerBaseDirectory/relativePath, {clobber:true})`, then insert. If `layer.invalid` -> respond immediately (state stays 'unavailable'). Else **processGeoPackage**.
    5. **processGeoPackage** (L60): no-op unless type GeoPackage. `state='processing'`; `getTables(path)`; builds `processing[]` entries `{layer:name, description:'"<name>" layer optimization' (tile) | '"<name>" layer index' (feature), complete:false, type}` (this block is executed twice identically, L69-110); `layer.save()`; error -> 400. Calls `next()` so the response is sent, then asynchronously `GeoPackageUtility.optimize(path, progressCb)`: on each progress, when progress.layer changes mark previous entry complete; set `count`, `total`, `description`; `layer.save()` (not awaited). After optimize: `fs.stat` -> `file.size = stats.size`; then `processing=undefined`, `state='available'`, `save()` (errors only logged).
    6. **PUT /:layerId/available**: same processGeoPackage on the existing layer, responds 202 (for non-GeoPackage it just returns 202 with current layer).
    7. **Tile**: table must exist in `req.layer.tables` else 404 'Table does not exist in layer.'; `GeoPackageUtility.tile(layer, table, style, {x,y,z})` returns a data URL; null -> 404; else `image/png` body = base64 part after the comma. `:format` is ignored.
    8. **Features**: non-Feature layer -> 400; event variant also 400 'layer requested is not in event <name>' when `event.layerIds.indexOf(layer._id) === -1`; returns `{type:'FeatureCollection', features: docs.map(toJSON)}` (feature toJSON renames _id->id).
    9. **Get layer / file**: `/file`: 404 if no `file`, 409 if state 'processing', else stream `layerBaseDirectory/file.relativePath` with Content-Type `file.contentType` and Content-Length `file.size` on stream 'open'. `/:layerId`: if `req.accepts('application/json')` -> JSON; else if file -> same as /file; else no response is sent.
    10. **Update**: `LayerModel.update(id, newLayer)` picks discriminator model by `newLayer.type` and `findByIdAndUpdate(..., {new:true})`.
    11. **Delete**: Feature -> `dropCollection(collectionName)` (fire-and-forget, warn on error) then `layer.deleteOne()`; GeoPackage -> `fs.remove(dirname(layerBaseDirectory/relativePath))` (fire-and-forget) then deleteOne; others deleteOne. `LayerSchema.pre('deleteOne')` runs `Event.removeLayerFromEvents` -> `Event.updateMany({}, {$pull:{layerIds:layer._id}})`.
    12. **WMS getcapabilities**: fetch, parse with `wms-capabilities` + xmldom, return JSON; error -> `res.json(400,{message})`.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[POST /api/layers] --> B[bearerAuthentication app.all]
      B --> C{authorize CREATE_LAYER}
      C -- no --> X403[403]
      C --> D[upload.single geopackage -> tempDirectory]
      D --> E[validateLayerParams]
      E -- missing type/name --> X400[400]
      E --> F{req.file?}
      F -- no --> G[state=available; api.Layer.create]
      G --> G1{type}
      G1 -- Feature --> G2[createCollection features+id; Layer.create]
      G1 -- other --> G3[Layer.create]
      F -- yes --> H[2nd POST /api/layers: validateGeopackage]
      H --> H1[GeoPackageUtility.validate]
      H1 --> I[api.Layer.create -> createGeoPackageLayer fs.copy to layerBaseDirectory/id/filename]
      I --> J{layer.invalid?}
      J -- yes --> R1[respond layer state unavailable]
      J -- no --> K[processGeoPackage: state=processing getTables processing[] save]
      K --> R2[respond layer]
      K -.async.-> L[GeoPackageUtility.optimize progress saves]
      L --> M[fs.stat size; state=available; save]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    - Mongo `layers` collection (model `Layer`, discriminatorKey `type`): `_id:Number` (from `counters` 'layer'), `name` (unique), `description`, `state` enum available|unavailable|processing, `type`. Imagery: `url, base, format, wms{layers,styles,format,transparent,version}`. Feature: `collectionName`. GeoPackage: `file{name,contentType,size:String,relativePath}`, `tables[{name,type tile|feature,minZoom,maxZoom,bbox[Number]}]`, `invalid{errors[Mixed]}`, `processing[{count,total,description,layer,type,complete}]`.
    - Per-layer feature collection `features<id>` (read via models/feature).
    - `events.layerIds` updated on layer delete.
    - Filesystem: read+write `env.layerBaseDirectory` (MAGE_LAYER_DIR, default /var/lib/mage/layers) under `<layerId>/<tempfilename>`; read `env.tempDirectory` uploads (temp file is copied, never deleted here).
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    JSON via `transformers/layer` (not traced in detail; Layer toJSON renames `_id`->`id`, deletes `collectionName`, sets `url=options.path` for Feature layers). Binary PNG tiles; streamed GeoPackage files; Mongo collection creation/drops; directory removal; console logging.
    
    ##### External calls
    - `GeoPackageUtility` (`utilities/geopackage`): `validate(path)` -> errors array; `getTables(path)`; `optimize(path, cb)` with progress `{layer,count,totalCount,description}`; `tile(layer, table, style, xyz)` -> data URL; `getClosestFeatures(gpLayers, lat, lng, tile)`. Internals not traced in this batch.
    - Outbound HTTP to arbitrary user-supplied WMS `url` (superagent).
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - Two handlers on POST /api/layers: the CREATE_LAYER check only exists on the first; the GeoPackage path depends on the first calling `next()` when `req.file` is set. If a file is uploaded with a non-GeoPackage `type`, validateGeopackage skips and the layer is created without `state` being set (schema requires `state`, so create likely fails validation) — preserve or fix deliberately.
    - Response for GeoPackage creation is sent before optimization completes; clients poll `state`/`processing`. Progress saves are un-awaited and may race.
    - `processing` population duplicated (harmless). `file.size` stored as String.
    - `GET /api/layers/:layerId` sends nothing when client doesn't accept JSON and the layer has no file (request hangs).
    - `getLayers` excludes non-`available` layers unless `includeUnavailable` truthy (any non-empty string, incl. 'false').
    - Feature-in-event check uses `indexOf(layer._id)` on Number array.
    - WMS proxy has no permission beyond bearer auth; errors return 400 JSON `{message}`.
    - Temp upload files are never cleaned up by these routes.
    - Uses deprecated `req.param`, `res.send(400, ...)`, `res.json(400, ...)` Express 3 signatures.
  Recommendation: Fully documented except internals of utilities/geopackage (GeoPackageUtility) and transformers/layer, which are outside this batch; confirm intended behavior for file uploads with non-GeoPackage type.

    | GET | /api/layers/:layerId | READ_LAYER_ALL | JSON if Accept json, else stream file |
    | GET | /api/events/:eventId/layers/:layerId | validateEventAccess | same as above |
    | GET | /api/events/:eventId/layers/:layerId/:tableName/:z/:x/:y.:format | validateEventAccess | PNG tile |
    | GET | /api/events/:eventId/layers/:layerId/features | validateEventAccess | Feature layer in event |
    | POST | /api/layers (2 chained registrations) | CREATE_LAYER | create layer, optional GeoPackage upload |
    | PUT | /api/layers/:layerId/available | UPDATE_LAYER | re-process GeoPackage -> 202 |
    | PUT | /api/layers/:layerId | UPDATE_LAYER | api.Layer(id).update(newLayer) |
    | POST | /api/layers/wms/getcapabilities | bearer only (no permission) | server fetch `${body.url}?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities`, parse with wms-capabilities |
    | DELETE | /api/layers/:layerId | DELETE_LAYER | api.Layer.remove -> 200 |
    
    ##### Inputs
    - Create: multipart with optional file field `geopackage`, body `{type, name, ...}` (type required -> 400 'cannot create layer "type" param not specified'; name required). Types seen: 'GeoPackage', 'Feature', WMS (imagery).
    - Tiles: path `z,x,y` digits, `format` ignored; query `stroke`, `fill`, `width`.
    - Features POST body: `{layerIds: [{id, table}], latlng: {lat, lng}, tile: {x,y,z}}`.
    - Query `type`, `includeUnavailable` via deprecated `req.param`.

    - `validateEventAccess`: `READ_LAYER_ALL` -> allow; `READ_LAYER_EVENT` + event read permission (team/ACL) -> allow; else 403.
    - Create flow: handler 1 (`CREATE_LAYER`, `upload.single('geopackage')`, `validateLayerParams`): if no file -> state 'available', `api.Layer.create`, respond with `Location: <id>`. If file -> `next()` to handler 2: `validateGeopackage` (only for type 'GeoPackage'; missing file -> 400; sets state 'unavailable', `geopackage=req.file`, runs `GeoPackageUtility.validate(file.path)`; errors stored in `newLayer.invalid.errors`; exception -> 400) -> `api.Layer.create` -> if `invalid` respond immediately; else `processGeoPackage` -> respond.
    - `processGeoPackage`: skip if type != GeoPackage. Path = `layerBaseDirectory/layer.file.relativePath`. state='processing'; `getTables` (feature tables: name,type 'feature',bbox; tile tables: name,type 'tile',minZoom,maxZoom,bbox); builds `processing[] {layer, description '"<name>" layer optimization' (tile) or '"<name>" layer index' (feature), complete:false, type}` (the whole block is executed twice, identically); `layer.save()`; error -> 400. Then `next()` (response sent) and asynchronously: `GeoPackageUtility.optimize(path, progress)` indexes every feature table; progress callback updates `processing[i].count,total,description` and saves on every tick; then `fs.stat` updates `file.size`; then `processing=undefined`, `state='available'`, save.
    - Tile: find table in `req.layer.tables` (404 'Table does not exist in layer.'); `GeoPackageUtility.tile` -> data URL string; responds `image/png` with base64 payload decoded (`tile.split(',')[1]`); null -> 404.
    - Features near point: `api.Layer.getLayers({layerIds, type:'GeoPackage', state:'available'})` -> `getClosestFeatures(gpLayers, Number(lat), Number(lng), tile)` -> JSON array.

    ```mermaid
      A[/api/layers*/] --> B[bearerAuthentication]
      B --> C{route}
      C -->|POST /api/layers| D[access.authorize CREATE_LAYER] --> E[upload.single geopackage] --> F[validateLayerParams]

      F -->|file| H[validateGeopackage GeoPackageUtility.validate]
      H --> I[api.Layer.create state unavailable]
      I -->|invalid| J[respond]
      I -->|valid| K[processGeoPackage getTables save state processing]
      K --> L[respond]

      C -->|tile| T1[handleGeoPackageXYZTileRequest] --> T2[GeoPackageUtility.tile] --> T3[image/png]
      C -->|POST features| P1[validateEventAccess] --> P2[api.Layer.getLayers GeoPackage available] --> P3[getClosestFeatures]
      C -->|wms| W1[superagent GET url GetCapabilities] --> W2[WMSCapabilities.toJSON]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    `layers` collection via `api.Layer` (fields: `_id`, type, name, state 'unavailable'|'processing'|'available', file {relativePath, contentType, size}, tables[{name,type,bbox,minZoom,maxZoom}], processing[], invalid{errors}, geopackage); `features` via `api.Feature(layer).getAll`. Filesystem: `environment.layerBaseDirectory` (`MAGE_LAYER_DIR`, default `/var/lib/mage/layers`) read (stream, stat) and GeoPackage files indexed in place (written by `featureDao.index`). Upload temp file from multer.

    - Progress bookkeeping bug: `currentLayer` starts undefined and is never assigned, so `processing[].complete` is never set true; processing array is cleared at the end anyway.
    - `getTables` + processing build executed twice (redundant).
    - `GET /api/layers/:layerId` with non-JSON Accept and no file never responds (hang).

    Code:
        create(layer) {
          return CounterModel.getNext('layer').then(id => {
            switch (layer.type) {
            case 'Feature':
              return createFeatureLayer(id, layer);
            case 'GeoPackage':
              return createGeoPackageLayer(id, layer);
            default:
              return LayerModel.create(id, layer);
            }
          });
        }
      
        remove(layer) {
          switch (layer.type) {
          case 'Feature':
            return removeFeatureLayer(layer);
          case 'GeoPackage':
            return removeGeoPackageLayer(layer);
          default:
            return LayerModel.remove(layer);
          }
        }
      
        update(layer) {
          return LayerModel.update(this._id, layer);
        }
      }
      
      function createFeatureLayer(id, layer) {
        log.info('Creating feature collection for id: ' + id);
        layer.collectionName = `features${id}`;
        return LayerModel.createFeatureCollection('features' + id)
          .then(() => LayerModel.create(id, layer));
      }
      
      function removeFeatureLayer(layer) {
        LayerModel.dropFeatureCollection(layer)
          .catch(err => log.warn("Error dropping layer collection ", err));
      
        return LayerModel.remove(layer);
      }
      
      function createGeoPackageLayer(id, layer) {
        layer.file = {
          name: layer.geopackage.originalname,
          contentType: layer.geopackage.mimetype,
          size: layer.geopackage.size,
          relativePath: path.join(id.toString(), layer.geopackage.filename)
        };
      
        const targetPath = path.join(environment.layerBaseDirectory, layer.file.relativePath);
        return fs.copy(layer.geopackage.path, targetPath, {clobber: true})
          .then(() => LayerModel.create(id, layer));
      }
      
      function removeGeoPackageLayer(layer) {
        const directory = path.dirname(path.join(environment.layerBaseDirectory, layer.file.relativePath));
        fs.remove(directory).catch(err => log.warn("Error removing GeoPackage directory ", err));
      
        return LayerModel.remove(layer);
      }

Builds `req.device={uid,registered:true}` and `req.user={username, displayName:username, active:true, authentication:{type:'local', password, authenticationConfiguration:{name:'local'}}}`.

    ```mermaid
      B -- no --> C[validateSetup]
      C -- invalid --> X400[400]
      C --> D[Role.getRole ADMIN_ROLE] --> E[AuthenticationConfiguration local/local] --> F[User.createUser] --> G[Device.createDevice registered] --> H[200 user+device]
    ```

    - `authorizeSetup` on error calls `next(err)` but continues executing (no return).
    - Missing uid: `res.send(400).send(...)` sends status 400 with body '400'-ish then throws on second send — re-implement as plain 400.
    - Uses `models/user.createUser` directly (not api.User.create), so no usersReqAdmin/default teams/events logic, and `authenticationConfiguration` sub-object is left on the input.

  Snippet: service/src/routes/setup.js:9-107
    Commentary: Setup gate, validation, waterfall.
    Code:
        function authorizeSetup(req, res, next) {
          User.count(function (err, count) {
            if (err) next(err);
      
            if (count > 0) {
              return res.sendStatus(404);
            }
      
            next();
          });
        }
      
        function validateSetup(req, res, next) {
          const username = req.param('username');
          if (!username) {
            return res.status(400).send('username is required');
          }
      
          const password = req.param('password');
          if (!password) {
            return res.status(400).send('password is required');
          }
      
          const passwordconfirm = req.param('passwordconfirm');
          if (!passwordconfirm) {
            return res.status(400).send('passwordconfirm is required');
          }
      
          if (password !== passwordconfirm) {
            return res.status(400).send('passwords do not match');
          }
      
          const uid = req.param('uid');
          if (!uid) {
            return res.send(400).send('uid is required');
          }
      
          req.device = {
            uid: uid,
            registered: true
          };
      
          req.user = {
            username: username,
            displayName: username,
            active: true,
            authentication: {
              type: 'local',
              password: password,
              authenticationConfiguration: {
                name: 'local'
              }
            }
          };
          next();
        }
      
        app.post(
          '/api/setup',
          authorizeSetup,
          validateSetup,
          function (req, res, next) {
            async.waterfall([
              function (done) {
                Role.getRole('ADMIN_ROLE', function (err, role) {
                  done(err, role);
                });
              },
              function (role, done) {
                req.user.roleId = role.id;
                done();
              },
              function (done) {
                AuthenticationConfiguration.getConfiguration('local', 'local').then(config => {
                  req.user.authentication.authenticationConfigurationId = config._id;
                  done();
                }).catch(err => {
                  done(err);
                });
              },
              function (done) {
                User.createUser(req.user, function (err, user) {
                  done(err, user);
                });
              },
              function (user, done) {
                req.device.registered = true;
                req.device.userId = user._id;
                Device.createDevice(req.device)
                  .then(device => done(null, user, device))
                  .catch(err => done(err));
              }
            ], function (err, user, device) {
              if (err) return next(err);
      
              res.json({ user: userTransformer.transform(user, { path: req.getRoot() }), device: device });
            });
          }
        );

    - `teamsForUserInEvent`: teams in event.teamIds containing user.

  Snippet: service/src/models/feature.js:28-50
    Commentary: Dynamic model per layer collection.
    Code:
      
      function featureModel(layer) {
        var name = layer.collectionName;
        var model = models[name];
        if (!model) {
          // Creates the Model for the Features Schema
          model = mongoose.model(name, FeatureSchema, name);
          models[name] = model;
        }
      
        return model;
      }
      
      exports.featureModel = featureModel;
      
      exports.getFeatures = function (layer) {
        return featureModel(layer).find({}).exec();
      };
      
      exports.createFeatures = function (layer, features) {
        features.forEach(feature => feature.properties = feature.properties || {});
        return featureModel(layer).create(features);
      };

    1. **#1 local login registration**: log DEPRECATED warning; `passport.authenticate('local')`; error -> next(err); no user -> `next('route')` (falls to #2). Paging: if `page`/`page_size` present: limit=page_size||25 (NaN->25), start=page*limit; else `limit`/`start` parsed. `Device.getDevices` (term regex over device fields and matching users' displayName).       function createObservationCollection(event) {
        log.info("Creating observation collection: " + event.collectionName + ' for event ' + event.name);
        mongoose.connection.db.createCollection(event.collectionName).then(() => {

      function dropObservationCollection(event, callback) {
        log.info("Dropping observation collection: " + event.collectionName);

          log.info('Dropped observation collection ' + event.collectionName);

      exports.create = function (event, user, callback) {
        async.waterfall([
          function (done) {
            Counter.getNext('event')
              .then(id => done(null, id))
              .catch(err => done(err));
          },
          function (id, done) {
            event._id = id;
            event.collectionName = 'observations' + id;
      
            event.acl = {};
            event.acl[user._id.toString()] = 'OWNER';
      
            Event.create(event).then(
              newEvent => {
                createObservationCollection(newEvent);
                done(null, newEvent);
              },
              err => done(err)

              if (err) {

                  done(err);
                });
              }

    Code:
      exports.getEvents = async function (options, callback) {
        if (typeof options === 'function') {
          callback = options;
          options = {};
        }
      
        const query = {};
        const filter = options.filter || {};
        if (filter.complete === true) query.complete = true;
        if (filter.complete === false) query.complete = { $ne: true };
        if (filter.searchTerm) {
          const searchRegex = new RegExp(filter.searchTerm, 'i');
          query['$or'] = [
            { name: searchRegex },
            { description: searchRegex }
          ];
        }
        if (filter.excludeTeamId != null) {
          query.teamIds = { $nin: [filter.excludeTeamId] };
        }
        if (filter.teamId != null) {
          query.teamIds = { ...query.teamIds, $in: filter.teamId };
        }
        if (filter.layerId != null) {
          const layerIdNum = typeof filter.layerId === 'string' ? parseInt(filter.layerId) : filter.layerId;
          query.layerIds = { ...query.layerIds, $in: [layerIdNum] };
        }
        if (filter.excludeLayerId != null) {
          const excludeLayerIdNum = typeof filter.excludeLayerId === 'string' ? parseInt(filter.excludeLayerId) : filter.excludeLayerId;
          query.layerIds = { ...query.layerIds, $nin: [excludeLayerIdNum] };
        }
        if (filter.excludeFeedId != null) {
          query.feedIds = { $nin: [filter.excludeFeedId] };
        }
        if (filter.feedId != null) {
          query.feedIds = { ...query.feedIds, $in: [filter.feedId] };
        }
      
        let projection = {};
        if (options.projection) {
          projection = convertProjection(options.projection);
      
          // Need these to check event access
          projection.acl = true;
          projection.teamIds = true;
        }
      
        try {
          const andClauses = [];
      
          const buildAccessClause = async (userId) => {
            if (!userId) return null;
      
            const teamDocs = await Team.Model.find({ userIds: { $in: [userId] } }, { _id: 1 }).lean();
            const teamIdsForUser = teamDocs.map(t => t._id);
            const readRoles = rolesWithPermission('read');
            const aclKey = `acl.${userId.toString()}`;
            return {
              $or: [
                { teamIds: { $in: teamIdsForUser } },
                { [aclKey]: { $in: readRoles } }
              ]
            };
          };
      
          const accessUserId = options && options.access && options.access.user ? options.access.user._id : null;
          const filterUserId = filter && filter.userId ? filter.userId : null;
      
          const [accessClause, filterClause] = await Promise.all([
            buildAccessClause(accessUserId),
            buildAccessClause(filterUserId)
          ]);
      
          if (accessClause) andClauses.push(accessClause);
          if (filterClause) andClauses.push(filterClause);
          if (andClauses.length) {
            if (query.$and) {
              query.$and = query.$and.concat(andClauses);
            } else {
              query.$and = andClauses;
            }
          }
        } catch (err) {
          return callback(err);
        }
      
        const totalCount = await Event.countDocuments(query).exec();
      
        let findQuery = Event.find(query, projection)
          .sort({ name: 1, _id: 1 })
          .collation({ locale: 'en', strength: 2, numericOrdering: true });
      
        if (options.limit != null) {
          findQuery = findQuery.limit(options.limit).skip(options.start * options.limit || 0);
        }
      
        findQuery.exec().then(
          events => {
            if (options.populate) {
              Event.populate(events, [{ path: 'teamIds' }, { path: 'layerIds' }]).then(
                events => callback(null, events, totalCount),
                err => callback(err)
              );
            } else {
              callback(null, events, totalCount);
            }
          },
          err => callback(err)
        );
      };

    ```mermaid
      D -- no --> DEN[PermissionDeniedError]
    ```

      export class RoleBasedExportsPermissionService implements ExportAppLayerPermissionService {
      
        constructor(private eventPermissions: EventPermissionServiceImpl) {}
      
        async ensureCreateExportPermission(context: EventRequestContext<UserWithRole>): Promise<PermissionDeniedError | null> {
          const user = context.requestingPrincipal()
      
          // Ensure user is part of this event
          if (await this.eventPermissions.userHasEventPermission(context.mageEvent, user.id, EventAccessType.Read)) {
            return null
          }
      
          return permissionDenied('CREATE EXPORT', user.id)
        }
      
        async ensureGetMyExportPermission(context: AppRequestContext<UserWithRole>): Promise<null | PermissionDeniedError> {
          const user = context.requestingPrincipal()
          return user ? null : permissionDenied('READ EXPORT', 'principal')
        }
      
        async ensureGetMyExportContentPermission(context: AppRequestContext<UserWithRole>): Promise<null | PermissionDeniedError> {
          const user = context.requestingPrincipal()
          return user ? null : permissionDenied('READ EXPORT CONTENT', 'principal')
        }
      
        async ensureDeleteMyExportPermission(context: AppRequestContext<UserWithRole>): Promise<null | PermissionDeniedError> {
          const user = context.requestingPrincipal()
          return user ? null : permissionDenied('DELETE EXPORT', 'principal')
        }

    Commentary: Event read permission semantics.
    Code:
        async userHasEventPermission(event: MageEventAttrs | MageEventModelInstance, userId: UserId, eventPermission: EventAccessType): Promise<boolean> {
          if (eventPermission === EventAccessType.Read && await this.userIsParticipantInEvent(event, userId)) {
            return true
          }
          let userEventRole = event.acl[userId]
          if (typeof userEventRole === 'object') {
            userEventRole = userEventRole.role
          }
          const userRoleHasPermission = rolesWithPermission(eventPermission).some(role => role === userEventRole)
          return userRoleHasPermission
        }
      
        /**
         * Check whether the given user is a member of any of the given MAGE event's
         * teams.
         * TODO: This is arguably an entity-layer function, but is here for now as
         * the concept of team membership only really has value in access control
         * decisions, currently.
         * @param event
         * @param userId
         * @returns
         */
        async userIsParticipantInEvent(event: MageEventAttrs | MageEventModelInstance, userId: UserId): Promise<boolean> {
          const teams = await this.resolveTeamsForEvent(event)
          return teams.some(team => team.userIds.indexOf(userId) !== -1)
        }

    1. `bearerAuthentication`; `access.authorize('CREATE_LAYER')` (note: CREATE, not UPDATE).
    2. `upload.single('file')`.

KML -> `fs.readFileSync(path,'utf8')`. Any exception -> 400 'Unable to extract contents from KMZ file.'+err.
    5. `new api.Feature(layer).createFeatures(features)` -> insert into `features<layerId>`.
    6. Respond `{files:[{name: Buffer.from(originalname,'latin1').toString('utf-8'), size, features: count}]}`.

    ```mermaid
      E --> F{ext kml/kmz}
      F -- no --> X3[400]

      G -- yes --> H[adm-zip: find .kml, images->data URLs]
      G -- no --> I[readFileSync]
      H --> J[transformKML.kml]
      I --> J
      J -- throws --> X4[400]
    ```

    - Imports append; existing features are never replaced.

    Code:
      const kmlToGeoJSON = (kmlPathname: string, isKMZ: boolean): KmlFeature[] => {
          let kmlString: string;
          let images: Record<string, string> = {};
      
          if (isKMZ) {
              // TODO: Update how images are handled in KMZ files to prevent duplication. Move images to a separate directory and store their paths in the KML.
              const zip = new Zip(kmlPathname);
              const zipEntries = zip.getEntries();
              const kmlEntry = zipEntries.find(entry => entry.entryName.toLowerCase().endsWith('.kml'));
      
              if (!kmlEntry) {
                  throw new Error('No KML file found inside KMZ.');
              }
      
              zipEntries.forEach(entry => {
                  const entryName = entry.entryName;
                  try {
                      if (!entry.isDirectory && /\.(png|jpg|jpeg|gif|bmp)$/i.test(entryName)) {
                          const buffer = entry.getData();
                          const base64 = buffer.toString('base64');
                          const mimeType = getMimeType(entryName);
                          images[entryName] = `data:${mimeType};base64,${base64}`;
                      }
                  } catch (error) {
                      console.error(`Error processing entry ${entryName}:`, error);
                  }
              });
      
              kmlString = kmlEntry.getData().toString('utf8');
          } else {
              kmlString = fs.readFileSync(kmlPathname, 'utf8');
          }
      
          try {
              return kml(kmlString, images);
          } catch (error) {
              throw new Error('Failed to transform KML: ' + error);
          }
      }
      
      const validate = async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void | Response> => {
          const layRequest = req as LayerRequest;
          if (layRequest.layer.type !== 'Feature') {
              return res.status(400).send('Cannot import data, layer type is not "Static".');
          }
      
          const fileExtension: string = layRequest.file?.originalname?.toLowerCase().split('.').pop() || '';
      
          if (!['kml', 'kmz'].includes(fileExtension)) {
              return res.status(400).send('Invalid file, please upload a KML or KMZ file.');
          }
      
          try {
              layRequest.features = kmlToGeoJSON(layRequest.file!.path, fileExtension === 'kmz');
          } catch (err) {
              return res.status(400).send('Unable to extract contents from KMZ file.' + err);
          }
          return next();
      }
      
      function importRoutes(app: Express, security: SecurityConfig): void {
      
          app.post(
              '/api/layers/:layerId/kml',
              security.authentication.bearerAuthentication,
              access.authorize('CREATE_LAYER' as AnyPermission),
              upload.single('file'),
              validate,
              (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
                  const layerRequest = req as LayerRequest;
                  new api.Feature(layerRequest.layer).createFeatures(layerRequest.features)
                      .then((newFeatures: any[]) => {
                          const response: ImportResponse = {
                              files: [{
                                  name: Buffer.from(layerRequest.file!.originalname, 'latin1').toString('utf-8'),
                                  size: layerRequest.file!.size,
                                  features: newFeatures ? newFeatures.length : 0
                              }]
                          };
      
                          res.json(response);
                      })
                      .catch((err: Error) => next(err));
              }
          );

      // Creates the Model for the Layer Schema
      const Layer = mongoose.model('Layer', LayerSchema);
      exports.Model = Layer;
      
      const ImageryLayer = Layer.discriminator('Imagery', ImagerySchema);
      const FeatureLayer = Layer.discriminator('Feature', FeatureSchema);
      const GeoPackageLayer = Layer.discriminator('GeoPackage', GeoPackageSchema);
      
      exports.getLayers = function (filter) {
        const conditions = {};
        if (filter.type) conditions.type = filter.type;
        if (filter.layerIds) conditions._id = { $in: filter.layerIds };
        if (!filter.includeUnavailable) {
          conditions.state = { $eq: 'available' };
        }
        return Layer.find(conditions).exec();
      };
      
      exports.count = function () {
        return Layer.countDocuments({}).exec();
      };
      
      exports.getById = function (id) {
        return Layer.findById(id).exec();
      };
      
      exports.createFeatureCollection = function (name) {
        return mongoose.connection.db.createCollection(name).then(function () {
          log.info('Successfully created feature collection for layer ' + name);
        });
      };
      
      exports.dropFeatureCollection = function (layer) {
        return mongoose.connection.db.dropCollection(layer.collectionName).then(function () {
          log.info('Dropped collection ' + layer.collectionName);
        });
      };
      
      exports.create = function (id, layer) {
        layer._id = id;
        return Layer.create(layer);
      };
      
      exports.update = function (id, layer) {
        let model;
        switch (layer.type) {

      const roleModel = RoleModel(mongoose.connection);
      
      /**
       * app.ts's initRepositories() overrides this with a MongooseRoleRepository
       * wired the same way as every other repository in the app layer, but the
       * default constructed here keeps this module self-sufficient for callers
       * (migrations, the standalone migration CLI, auth strategies, legacy
       * routes) that use its callback API directly without going through the app
       * layer bootstrap.
       */
      let roleRepo = new MongooseRoleRepository(roleModel);
      
      /**
       * This module is a thin bridge that keeps the legacy callback API working
       * for the handful of callers (migrations, auth strategies, legacy routes)
       * that have not been migrated to the new RoleRepository interface directly.
       */
      exports.initialize = function (repos) {
        roleRepo = repos.roleRepo;
      };
      
      function assertValidPermissions(permissions) {
        for (const permission of permissions || []) {
          if (!validPermissions[permission]) {
            throw new Error("Permission '" + permission + "' is not a valid permission");
          }
        }
      }
      
      exports.getRoleById = function (id, callback) {
        roleRepo.findById(id).then(
          role => callback(null, role),
          err => callback(err)
        );
      };
      
      exports.getRole = function (name, callback) {
        roleRepo.findByName(name).then(
          role => callback(null, role),
          err => callback(err)
        );
      };
      
      exports.getRoles = function (callback) {
        roleRepo.findAll().then(
          roles => callback(null, roles),
          err => callback(err)
        );
      };
      
      exports.createRole = function (role, callback) {
        try {
          assertValidPermissions(role.permissions);
        } catch (err) {
          return callback(err);
        }
      
        roleRepo.create({
          name: role.name,
          description: role.description,
          permissions: role.permissions
        }).then(
          role => callback(null, role),
          err => callback(err)
        );
      };
      
      exports.updateRole = function (id, update, callback) {
        if (update.permissions) {
          try {
            assertValidPermissions(update.permissions);
          } catch (err) {
            return callback(err);
          }
        }
      
        roleRepo.update({ id, ...update }).then(
          role => callback(null, role),
          err => callback(err)
        );
      };
      
      exports.deleteRole = function (role, callback) {
        const id = role.id || role._id;
        roleRepo.removeById(id).then(
          role => callback(null, role),
          err => callback(err)
        );
      };

        authorize(permission: AnyPermission): express.RequestHandler {
          return function(req, res, next): any {
            if (!req.user) {
              return next()
            }
            const role = req.user.roleId as Role
            if (!role) {
              return res.sendStatus(403)
            }
            const userPermissions = role.permissions
            const ok = userPermissions.indexOf(permission) !== -1
            if (!ok) {
              return res.sendStatus(403)
            }
            next()
          }
        }
      })

    Commentary: Captcha signup flow.
    Code:
        app.post('/api/users/signups', validateUsername, function(req, res, next) {
          let text;
          let image;
      
          if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test') {
            text = 'captcha';
            image = Buffer.from('image');
          } else {
            const generated = captchaCanvas.createCaptchaSync(300, 100, {
              captcha: {
                characters: 6,
                size: 46,
                rotate: 8
              },
              trace: { size: 3, opacity: 0.8 },
              decoy: { total: 25, opacity: 0.3 }
            });
      
            text = generated.text;
            image = generated.image;
          }
      
          const solution = String(text).toUpperCase();
      
          hasher.hashPassword(solution, (err, hash) => {
            if (err) return next(err);
      
            const claims = { captcha: hash };
      
            tokenService
              .generateToken(req.username, TokenAssertion.Captcha, 60 * 3, claims)
              .then(token => {
                res.json({
                  token,
                  captcha: `data:image/png;base64,${image.toString('base64')}`
                });
              })
              .catch(next);
          });
        });
      
        app.post(
          '/api/users/signups/verifications',
          validateAccount,
          function verify(req, res, next) {
            passport.authenticate('captcha', (err, payload) => {
              if (err) {
                const status =
                  err.reason === VerificationErrorReason.Expired ? 401 : 400;
                return res.status(status).send('Invalid captcha, please try again');
              }
              if (!payload) return res.sendStatus(400);
      
              req.payload = payload;
              next();
            })(req, res, next);
          },
          function role(req, res, next) {
            Role.getRole('USER_ROLE', (err, role) => {
              req.userRole = role;
              next(err);
            });
          },
          function(req, res, next) {
            const attempt = String(req.body.captchaText || '').toUpperCase();
            hasher.validPassword(attempt, req.payload.captcha, (err, valid) => {
              if (err) return next(err);
      
              if (!valid) {
                return res.status(403).send('Invalid captcha, please try again.');
              }
      
              const user = {
                username: req.payload.subject,
                roleId: req.userRole.id,
                displayName: req.account.displayName,
                email: req.account.email,
                phones: req.account.phones,
                authentication: {
                  type: 'local',
                  password: req.account.password,
                  authenticationConfiguration: {
                    name: 'local'
                  }
                }
              };
      
              log.info('account signup requested', {
                username: user.username,
                displayName: user.displayName,
                email: user.email,
                phones: user.phones
              });
      
              new api.User()
                .create(user)
                .then(newUser => {
                  newUser = userTransformer.transform(newUser, {
                    path: req.getRoot()
                  });
                  res.json(newUser);
                })
                .catch(err => {
                  next(err);
                });
            });
          }
        );

  Description: ##### Entry point

    ##### Inputs
    ExportParams; event (id, name, style{fill,stroke,fillOpacity,strokeOpacity,strokeWidth}, forms with style, primaryField, variantField, primaryFeedField, secondaryFeedField); observation icons for event.
    
    ##### Processing flow
    1. Single PassThrough `mage-export.kml`; write XML header with kml/gx/atom namespaces, `<Document><name>MAGE-Export.kml</name><open>1</open>`.
    2. Observations: `iconRepository.getIcons(event.id)`; write styles: `eventStyle` (only if an icon with no formId/primary/variant exists; id=`<eventId>`, href `icons/<contentLocator>`) + per form: default style id `<eventId>-<formId>` (href `icons/` empty), per icon with primary+variant id `<eventId>-<formId>-<primary>-<variant>` (variant style overrides), primary-only id `<eventId>-<formId>-<primary>`. Colors `kmlColor` = opacityHex(~~(op*255)) + BB + GG + RR; defaults fill/stroke `#5278A2`, fillOpacity 0.2, strokeOpacity 1, strokeWidth 2; invalid hex → `000000`.
    3. `<Folder><name>{event.name}</name>`; for each observation: `observationPlacemark` — name = primaryFeedField/secondaryFeedField values of first form entry joined ` - ` else event name; visibility 0; styleUrl `#` + [eventId, formId, primary value, variant value] joined `-` (from first form entry); TimeStamp `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ` UTC; geometry: Point `lon,lat`, Polygon outer ring only (extrude 1), LineString (extrude 1, clampToGround, tessellate 1), else none; description HTML: header Timestamp/Latitude/Longitude (centroid)/MGRS, then per form an h4 + fields (exclude archived/password/geometry; include if attachment exists for field+entry (strict `===`), checkbox if definition `field.value != null`, else truthy entry) sorted by field id; attachments render `<a href=attachments/<name>>` and `<img width=150>` for image/*; other values `.toString()`; GPS section with provider/accuracy.
    4. Attachments appended as `attachments/<name|Attachment_id>` (async forEach, not awaited).
    5. `</Folder>`; append each icon content as `icons/<contentLocator>`.
    6. Locations: iterate; on user change finalize previous user (write placemarks via `placemarks.join()`, append user icon `icons/users/<userId>`, collect `userStyle`, `</Folder>`); fetch user, open `<Folder><name>{displayName}</name>`; placemark name = UTC timestamp, styleUrl `#user-<id>`, description lists every location property `key: value.toString()`. After loop write `styles.join()`.
    7. `</Document></kml>`, end.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[KmlExportTransform.export] --> B[write KML header]
      B --> C{observationParams}
      C -- yes --> D[iconRepository.getIcons -> observationStyles]
      D --> E[Folder event.name]
      E --> F[observationPlacemark per obs]
      F --> G[async attachments -> attachments/]
      F --> H[icons -> icons/]
      C --> I{locationParams}
      H --> I
      I -- yes --> J[group by consecutive user -> Folder displayName]
      J --> K[locationPlacemark] --> L[finalizeUser: user icon icons/users/id]
      I --> M[close Document]
      L --> M
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Reads observation icons (repo + content), observations cursor, attachments, users, user icons, locations cursor.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    Zip: `mage-export.kml`, `icons/...`, `icons/users/<id>`, `attachments/<name>`.
    
    ##### External calls
    xmlbuilder2 `fragment`, moment, @turf/centroid, mgrs, winston log.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - `event.name` and `user.displayName` are interpolated raw (not XML-escaped) into `<name>`.
    - `placemarks.join()` / `styles.join()` use the default comma separator, inserting `,` text between elements.
    - Location folders are per *consecutive run* of userId; a user reappearing later gets another folder and duplicate icon entry; locations of unknown users are counted but not written.
    - Checkbox inclusion uses form definition `field.value`; if non-null while the entry has no value, `undefined.toString()` throws and fails the export; null location property values also throw.
    - Style variables (strokeWidth/colors) leak from one icon iteration into the next.
    - Attachment append not awaited (race with finalize).
  Recommendation: Fully documented. Customer input: whether to XML-escape folder names, fix comma separators between placemarks, and fix potential undefined.toString() failures.

- sfind-8c90e9396b8a4d6cb8ebf9e96cacfa0f: Export lifecycle: CreateExport / FetchExports / GetExportContent / DeleteExport + IterateObservations [critical/dismissed] repo: COG-GTM/NGA-mage-server, scan: scan-297683f5856041e28b46cf6ff133ab19 created 2026-11-05 17:34:05 UTC, category: api-endpoint
  Description: ##### Entry point
    App-layer operations wired in `initExportsAppLayer` (service/src/app.ts ~L897-975) and exposed by `ExportRoutes` mounted at `/api/events/:<eventScopeKey>/exports` (bearerAuthentication + ensureEventScope) and `MyExportRoutes` at `/api/exports/mine` (bearerAuthentication). Functions: `CreateExport` (L93), `FetchExports` (L48), `GetExportContent` (L60), `DeleteExport` (L199). `IterateObservations` (L226) is the observation-stream helper injected into every format transform.
    
    ##### Inputs
    `CreateExportRequest` (built by adapters.exports.controllers.web.ts): `format` ∈ `EXPORT_FORMATS = ['kml','geojson','geopackage','csv']`; `filter.observations` = { startDate, endDate (ISO8601 parsed to Date), includeAttachments (default **true** in web parser), favorites (bool), important (bool), userIsAnyOf (`users` array), teamIsAnyOf (`teams` array), hasAttachments (true|undefined), fieldFilter {keyword?, condition?}, projection? (`[{formId, fields: string[]}]`) }; `filter.locations` = { startDate, endDate, userIsAnyOf, teamIsAnyOf }. Context: `requestingPrincipal()` (user), `mageEvent`. GetExportContent/DeleteExport: `exportId`.
    
    ##### Processing flow
    **CreateExport**
    1. `permissionService.ensureCreateExportPermission` (RoleBasedExportsPermissionService): allowed iff `eventPermissions.userHasEventPermission(event, user.id, Read)` — no role permission is consulted.
    2. `exportsRepository.createExport({userId, eventId, ...req})` — persists Export doc (exportType=format, expirationDate = now + exportTtl).
    3. `exportFactory(format)`; if null → `invalidInput('invalid export type')` (record already created and left behind; unreachable from web because the controller validates format first, and the factory switch covers all 4 formats).
    4. `contentStore.writeContent(newExport)` → file stream `<exportDirectory>/<exportId>-<exportType>.zip`; patch `{status: Running, relativePath}` via `updateExportForUser`.
    5. Build `ExportParams`:
       - observations: `resolveUserIsAnyOf(teamRepo, userIsAnyOf, teamIsAnyOf)`; findSpec.where = {stateIsAnyOf:['active'], timestampAfter:startDate, timestampBefore:endDate, isFavoriteOfUser: favorites ? user.id : undefined, isFlaggedImportant: important, userIsAnyOf, hasAttachments, fieldFilter}; includeAttachments; projection.
       - locations: where = {eventId, timestampAfter, timestampBefore, userIsAnyOf}.
    6. `archiver('zip')` piped to content stream; `exporter.export(event, archive, params)` started **without await** (fire-and-forget).
       - success: await `archive.finalize()` and content 'close'; `contentStats` → size (undefined if stat error); update `{status: Completed, size, summary:{observations, locations}}`; log `<username|id> exported data` with format/event/counts.
       - failure: log, `contentStore.deleteContent`, update `{status: Failed}`, `archive.abort()`.
    7. Returns immediately `{...newExport, status: Running, relativePath}`.
    
    **FetchExports**: permission = principal truthy; `repository.getExportsForUser(user.id)`.
    **GetExportContent**: permission (principal truthy) → `getExportForUser(exportId, user.id)` (null → EntityNotFound 'Export') → `contentStore.readContent` (null → EntityNotFound 'Export content'; ExportStoreError → InfrastructureError) → `{export, bytes}`.
    **DeleteExport**: permission → `deleteExportForUser` (null → EntityNotFound) → `contentStore.deleteContent(exp)` (result ignored) → return deleted export.
    **IterateObservations**: if `where.fieldFilter` → `searchRepo.findIdsByFilter(fieldFilter, event)` → ids; `obsRepoFactory(event.id).iterate({...findSpec, where:{...where, ids}})` (Mongo cursor; `includeAttachments=false` → projection `attachments: {$slice: 0}`).
    **Projection helpers**: `projectionIncludesForm/Field` return true when no projection; `projectedObservationFormFields` keeps only form entries whose formId is in the projection and only keys listed in `fields`, always re-adding `id` and `formId`.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[POST /api/events/:id/exports] --> B{ensureCreateExportPermission<br/>event Read ACL}
      B -- denied --> X[PermissionDenied]
      B -- ok --> C[exportsRepository.createExport]
      C --> D{exportFactory format}
      D -- null --> E[invalidInput]
      D -- transform --> F[contentStore.writeContent<br/>id-type.zip]
      F --> G[update status=Running]
      G --> H[resolveUserIsAnyOf teams->users]
      H --> I[archiver zip -> file]
      I --> J[[exporter.export async]]
      I --> R[return Running export]
      J -- resolved --> K[finalize, stat size<br/>status=Completed + summary]
      J -- rejected --> L[deleteContent, status=Failed, abort]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Mongo `exports` (via ExportsRepository/mongoose): userId, eventId, exportType, status (Running|Completed|Failed), relativePath, size, options/filter, expirationDate, summary.{observations,locations}.{count,startTimestamp,endTimestamp}. Files: `<MAGE_EXPORT_DIR>/<id>-<exportType>.zip`. Reads: event observations collection, user locations, teams (findAllByIds), search index ids.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    Zip file on disk; Export record status transitions Running→Completed/Failed; info/error logs. Content download streams the zip.
    
    ##### External calls
    `archiver` (zip), format transforms (CSV/KML/GeoJSON/GeoPackage — separate flows), ObservationSearchRepository, TeamRepository, ExportStore (file system).
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - Export is asynchronous: API returns Running before any data is written; there is no job queue — a process restart mid-export leaves status Running forever (cleanup only via ExportArchiveTask TTL sweep).
    - Observation state is hard-coded to `active`; `favorites` maps to the *requesting* user.
    - `resolveUserIsAnyOf` returns `undefined` (=no user filter) when teams resolve to zero members → export of ALL users' data; team ids are not checked against the event.
    - Summary timestamps default to `new Date(0)` / `new Date()` when no rows.
    - Create permission checks only event ACL, not READ_OBSERVATION_ALL/EVENT or location permissions.
    - GetExportContent does not check status, so a Running (partial) zip can be downloaded.
    - DeleteExport ignores content-delete errors; failure path deletes content then aborts archive (ordering).
  Recommendation: Fully documented. Customer input needed: (1) should export creation also require READ_OBSERVATION_* role permissions (today only event Read ACL is checked); (2) should content download be blocked while status is Running; (3) confirm the 'team with zero members => unconstrained' rule is intended for exports.

  Description: ##### Entry point
    `GeoJsonExportTransform.export` invoked by `CreateExport` for format=`geojson`.
    
    ##### Inputs
    Same ExportParams as other transforms; event forms; observation `attachments[]` {id, name, fieldName, observationFormId, contentLocator}.
    
    ##### Processing flow
    1. Observations: PassThrough appended as `observations.geojson`; iterate observations; between items write `,` (no opening/closing array or FeatureCollection wrapper).
    2. `mapObservationProperties`: new properties = {...properties, id, timestamp: `moment(ts).toISOString()`, mgrs: mgrs.forward(centroid)}; delete `forms`; for each projected form entry with a known form, for each field skip if archived, `password`, `geometry`, or `checkbox` whose **form definition** `field.value === null`; `attachment` fields → value = array of `contentLocator` of attachments having contentLocator, matching fieldName and `String(observationFormId)===String(formEntry.id)`; other fields included when `formEntry[name] !== undefined`, keyed by `field.title`. Result grouped `properties[<form.name>] = [ {<title>: value,...}, ... ]`.
    3. For each collected attachment, `forEach(async ...)` reads content and appends `attachment.name || Attachment_<id>` to zip root (not awaited).
    4. User/device lookup (userRepository.findById / deviceRepository.getDeviceById) when id changes; `properties.user = username`, `properties.device = uid`.
    5. Write `JSON.stringify({geometry, properties})` (no `type`).
    6. Locations: PassThrough `locations.geojson`; write `{"type": "FeatureCollection", "features": [`; each location: add `properties.mgrs` (centroid) and write full `JSON.stringify(location)`; close `]}`.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[GeoJsonExportTransform.export] --> B{observationParams}
      B --> C[observations.geojson PassThrough]
      C --> D[iterate obs: write ',' separator]
      D --> E[mapObservationProperties<br/>ISO ts, mgrs, forms by title]
      E --> F[async attachment append - not awaited]
      E --> G[user/device lookup]
      G --> H[write geometry+properties]
      A --> I{locationParams}
      I --> J[locations.geojson FeatureCollection]
      J --> K[location + mgrs JSON]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Reads observation cursor, users, devices, locations cursor, attachment content. Writes zip entries.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    `observations.geojson` (sequence of `{geometry,properties}` objects separated by commas — not a valid JSON document), `locations.geojson` (valid FeatureCollection), attachment files at zip root.
    
    ##### External calls
    @turf/centroid, mgrs, moment, AttachmentStore.readContent.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - Attachment field values reference store `contentLocator` paths while zip entries are named by attachment name — links don't match archive paths.
    - Attachment appends are fire-and-forget; they can race `archive.finalize()` (missing files or archiver error).
    - Stale user/device when observation lacks userId/deviceId (previous values retained).
    - Checkbox exclusion tests the form definition default value, not the entry.
    - Form data keyed by field *title* (CSV uses name); observation features lack `"type":"Feature"`.
    - Both `stream.push(null)` and `end()` are called on the observation stream.
  Recommendation: Fully documented. Customer must decide whether to reproduce observations.geojson as-is (comma-joined objects, not a FeatureCollection) or emit valid GeoJSON; also whether attachment write race should be fixed.
