    - DeleteFeedService (FEEDS_CREATE_SERVICE): find feeds → `eventRepo.removeFeedsFromEvents` (**not awaited**) → `feedRepo.removeByServiceId` → `serviceRepo.removeById`.
    - ListServiceTopics: lookup service/type *before* permission (EntityNotFound leaks existence) → ensureListTopicsPermissionFor → connection topics.
    - buildFetchContext: service → type → connection → topic in available topics (else EntityNotFound FeedTopic) → validate variableParamsSchema (error → invalidInput) → wrap connection so `fetchTopicContent` pares item properties via `retainSchemaPropertiesInFeatures(items, feed.itemPropertiesSchema || topic.itemPropertiesSchema)`.
    - resolveFeedCreate: parse string icon URLs (invalid → key errors) → `FeedCreateUnresolved(topic, feed)` → `iconRepo.findOrImportBySourceUrl(url, null, EagerAwait)` per unresolved icon → `FeedCreateAttrs`.
    - PreviewFeed (FEEDS_CREATE_FEED for service): validate variableParams against schema; merge `{...variableParams, ...constantParams}` (constants win); validate against topic.paramsSchema; resolve; unless skipContentFetch fetch content → preview {feed, content{feed:'preview', topic, variableParams, items, pageCursor?}}.
    - CreateFeed: resolve → `feedRepo.create` → {...feed, service, topic}.
    - ListAllFeeds / ListServiceFeeds / GetFeed (FEEDS_LIST_ALL).
    - UpdateFeed: feed lookup before permission; rejects changing service/topic; resolve → `feedRepo.put`.
    - DeleteFeed: lookup → `eventRepo.removeFeedsFromEvents(feed.id)` → `feedRepo.removeById`.
    - FetchFeedContent (ensureFetchFeedContentPermissionFor feed): build context → params = variableParams then `Object.assign(params, constantParams)` → fetchTopicContent → {...content, feed: id, variableParams}; errors → InfrastructureError.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[FetchFeedContent] --> B{permission}
      B --> C[feedRepo.findById]
      C --> D[buildFetchContext: service, type, connection, topic]
      D --> E[merge variable+constant params]
      E --> F[conn.fetchTopicContent]
      F --> G[retainSchemaPropertiesInFeatures]
      G --> H[FeedContent]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Mongo feed service types, feed services, feeds, events (feed references), static icons.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    Creates/updates/deletes feed services and feeds; removes feed ids from events; imports static icons (eager network fetch).
    
    ##### External calls
    Plugin FeedServiceType (validateServiceConfig, redactServiceConfig, createConnection → fetchServiceInfo/fetchAvailableTopics/fetchTopicContent), JsonSchemaService, StaticIconRepository.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - Every content fetch first re-fetches topic list from the remote service.
    - Constant params override variable params.
    - DeleteFeedService does not await event cleanup; FetchFeedContent mutates `req.variableParams` object via Object.assign.
    - Error messages are logged with console.error and replaced by generic InfrastructureError.
  Recommendation: Fully documented at app layer; plugin service-type connection behavior is external.

  Description: ##### Entry point
    `GeoPackageExportTransform.export` for format=`geopackage` (deps: locationRepo, streamObservations, iconStore, attachmentStore, iconRepository, userRepository, userIconStore, logger).
    
    ##### Inputs
    ExportParams, event forms (id, name, primaryField, variantField, color, fields), observation icons.
    
    ##### Processing flow
    1. `createGeoPackageFile`: `mkdtemp(<os.tmpdir>/geopackage-)` + `moment().format('YYYMMDD_hhmmssSSS').gpkg`; `GeoPackageAPI.create`.
    2. Observations:
       - `Forms` attributes table (formName, primaryField, variantField, color, formId TEXT) with one row per projected form (only if any).
       - `Form_<formId>` attributes table per projected form: column per non-archived projected field (numberfield→INTEGER, else TEXT, dataColumn title=field.title) + formId INTEGER default, + primaryField/variantField TEXT if form defines them.
       - `Observations` feature table: lastModified, timestamp, createdAt DATETIME; mageId, userId, deviceId, primaryField, variantField TEXT.
       - Feature style extension; default event icon (`iconRepository.getIcon(event.id)`) set as table default icon (png, width 36, anchor 0.5/1.0, name per `populateGpkgIconRow`).
       - `Attachments` media table (name TEXT, size REAL).
       - Per observation: count++, timestamps; projected forms; **if none → `break` (stop iterating)**; primary/variant = `String(firstEntry[form.primaryField])` / variant only if primaryField set; add feature; expand envelope; `linkObservationFeatureIcon` via `IconTreeCache` (form→primary→variant; load failures cached as ICON_LOAD_ERROR); for each of the observation's (unprojected) form entries: build row {primaryField, variantField, formId, ...fields} where attachment ids are appended to the attachment field; conversions multiselectdropdown→`join(', ')`, date→ISO, checkbox→String, geometry→WKT, attachment→`join(', ')`; null/unknown fields skipped; `addAttributeRow('Form_<formId>')`; attachments → `addMedia` (contentType or application/octet-stream, name|id, size|0) linked to Observations feature and form row; `linkRelatedRows(ATTRIBUTES)`; errors logged and skipped.
       - RTree index; contents bounds set from envelope.
    3. Locations: `Locations` feature table (Location Id, User Id, Username, Display Name, Device Id TEXT; Date/Time DATETIME; Accuracy, Altitude, Bearing, Speed REAL) + style ext; per location: refetch user when id changes; add feature; user icon (from userIconStore) inserted once per user and set as feature default icon; bounds; RTree; bounds only written if final user non-null.
    4. Append file stream as `<event.name with \W removed | Event_<id>>.gpkg`; on archive `end` unlink temp file and close geopackage.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[GeoPackageExportTransform.export] --> B[createGeoPackageFile tmp]
      B --> C{observationParams}
      C --> D[Forms table, Form_id tables, Observations table, styles, Attachments media]
      D --> E[iterate obs]
      E --> F{projected forms empty?}
      F -- yes --> G[break loop]
      F -- no --> H[addGeoJSONFeature + icon mapping]
      H --> I[Form_id rows + media links]
      I --> E
      G --> J[RTree + bounds]
      C --> K{locationParams}
      J --> K
      K --> L[Locations table + user icons + RTree]
      L --> M[append name.gpkg; unlink on archive end]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Temp SQLite GeoPackage file; reads observations, icons (repo/content), attachments, users, user icons, locations. Legacy import: `IconAttrs` type from `models/icon` (legacy models/ coupling).
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    Zip entry `<EventName>.gpkg`; temp dir under OS tmp (directory itself never removed).
    
    ##### External calls
    @ngageoint/geopackage (GeoPackageAPI, FeatureTableStyles, RTreeIndex, media/related tables), wkx, moment, stream/consumers.buffer.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - `break` on first observation with zero projected form entries silently truncates the export.
    - primary/variant become the literal string `"undefined"` when the entry lacks the value.
    - Form rows use all form entries, not projection-filtered ones; a non-projected form's table doesn't exist → error logged.
    - Filename regex `\W` strips spaces too; moment format `YYY`/`hh` (12h) quirks.
    - `Location Id` column never populated; locations `count` incremented once per row (observations incremented at loop start).
    - Feature style uses `console.warn` on icon failures.

Customer input: the `break` on an observation with no projected forms stops the whole export — confirm intent.
  Note: End-to-end flow: GeoPackage leg of the Observation Export flow: app.ts exportFactory('geopackage') -> GeoPackageExportTransform(locationRepo, observation stream, iconRepo/iconStore, attachmentStore, ...), invoked by CreateExport's ZIP build. Icon styling reads MongooseObservationIconRepository (finding 013b4490). No dedicated transform test found under service/test. Upstream finding IDs: sfind-46ae6cb069824236b5afb6296869c4e1, sfind-516f1257079348f2b8616f2380b94d61.
    Triage: Kept CRITICAL tier with other export formats: implicit GeoPackage table/style rules, no dedicated test.
    Owners from git history (last committers) + CODEOWNERS.
    
    
    ---
    Detail folded from duplicate sfind-f9a655098f82453eb7fabeb1ec5cc374 (GeoPackage export format: temp .gpkg with Forms, Form_<id>, Observations, Attachments, Locations tables), original documentation:
    
    ##### Entry point
    `GeoPackageExportTransform.export` for `format === 'geopackage'` (deps: locationRepo, IterateObservations, observation iconStore, attachmentStore, observation iconRepo, userRepo, user iconStore, logger).
    
    ##### Inputs
    `ExportParams`, MageEvent.
    
    ##### Processing flow
    1. `createGeoPackageFile`: `mkdtemp(os.tmpdir()/geopackage-)`, file `moment().format('YYYMMDD_hhmmssSSS').gpkg`; `GeoPackageAPI.create`.
    2. Observations: 
       - `Forms` attributes table (`formName, primaryField, variantField, color, formId` TEXT) with one row per projected form (only if any).
       - `Form_<formId>` attribute table per projected form: one column per non-archived projected field (type numberfield->INTEGER, else TEXT, with data-column title), plus `formId INTEGER default id`, `primaryField`/`variantField` TEXT if configured.
       - `Observations` feature table: `lastModified, timestamp, createdAt DATETIME; mageId, userId, deviceId, primaryField, variantField TEXT`.
       - Feature style extension; table default icon from `iconRepository.getIcon(event.id)` (cached in `IconTreeCache`).
       - `Attachments` media table (`name TEXT, size REAL`).
       - Per observation: count++, track timestamps; projected forms; **if none -> `break` (stops processing all remaining observations)**; primary entry = first projected form; `primary = String(entry[form.primaryField])`, `variant` similarly (only if primaryField). Add GeoJSON feature; expand bounds; link icon (`ensureIconInGeopackage`: cache by formId/primary/variant, else `iconRepository.getIcon(eventId, formId, primary, variant)`, store PNG row width 36 anchor 0.5/1.0, name per `populateGpkgIconRow`; failures cached as ICON_LOAD_ERROR); insert style mapping.
       - For **every** form entry of the observation (not projected): collect attachments whose `observationFormId == entry.id`, append attachment ids to the entry field array (mutates entry); convert values: multiselectdropdown join `, `, date ISO, checkbox String, geometry WKT, attachment ids join `, `, else raw; skip unknown fields/null; `addAttributeRow('Form_'+formId)`; add attachment media (buffer content, contentType default `application/octet-stream`, name default id) and link to observation and form row; `linkRelatedRows(Observations -> Form_x, ATTRIBUTES)`; errors per entry logged and skipped.
       - RTree index; set content bounds.
    3. Locations: `Locations` feature table (`Location Id, User Id, Username, Display Name, Device Id TEXT; Date/Time DATETIME; Accuracy, Altitude, Bearing, Speed REAL`); per location (user looked up when userId changes) add feature with those properties (Location Id never populated), set per-row default icon from user icon (PNG width 36, cached per user); content bounds only set if a user was resolved at the end; RTree.
    4. Append file stream as `<event.name stripped of \W, or Event_<id>>.gpkg`; on archive `end` unlink file and close geopackage.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[GeoPackageExportTransform.export] --> B[createGeoPackageFile tmpdir]
      B --> C{observationParams?}
      C -->|yes| D[Forms table]
      D --> E[Form_id tables]
      E --> F[Observations table + styles]
      F --> G[loop observations]
      G -->|no projected forms| X[break loop]
      G --> H[add feature + icon mapping]
      H --> I[Form_id rows + Attachments media + relations]
      C --> J{locationParams?}
      J -->|yes| K[Locations table + user icons]
      J --> L[append name.gpkg to ZIP; unlink on end]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Reads observations, icons, attachments, locations, users, user icons. Writes temp file in `os.tmpdir()` (needs disk space), ZIP entry `<EventName>.gpkg`.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    GeoPackage in ZIP; summary; temp file deleted on archive end (temp directory itself is not removed).
    
    ##### External calls
    `@ngageoint/geopackage` (GeoPackageAPI, FeatureTableStyles, RTreeIndex, related tables/media), `wkx`, `moment`.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - `break` on first observation without projected forms silently truncates the export, and count includes that observation.
    - `String(undefined)` produces the literal `"undefined"` for missing primary/variant values.
    - Form rows are written for all form entries even when projection excludes the form (table `Form_x` may not exist -> logged error).
    - Filename format `YYY` (3-digit year) and 12-hour `hh`.

Functions: ReadObservations, AllocateObservationId, SaveObservation, StoreAttachmentContent, ReadAttachmentContent, registerDeleteRemovedAttachmentsHandler, registerRecordRecentFormFieldChoicesHandler.
    
    ##### Inputs
    Read: `search` {filter (fieldFilter), userIsAnyOf, teamIsAnyOf, lastModifiedAfter/Before, timestampAfter/Before, geometryIntersects, stateIsAnyOf, isFlaggedImportant, isFavoriteOfUser, hasAttachments, orderBy, paging, populateUserNames}, optional `mapping`. Save: `ExoObservationMod` {id, geometry, bbox, noGeometry, properties{timestamp, accuracy, delta, provider, forms:[{id?, formId, <field>: value | attachment mods [{action: add|delete, id, name, contentType, size, width, height, oriented}]}]}}. StoreAttachmentContent: observationId, attachmentId, content{mediaType, bytes (stream or StagedAttachmentContentRef)}. ReadAttachmentContent: observationId, attachmentId, minDimension?, contentRange{start,end}?.
    
    ##### Processing flow
    - **ReadObservations**: `ensureReadObservationPermission` (READ_OBSERVATION_ALL, or READ_OBSERVATION_EVENT + event Read ACL) → resolveUserIsAnyOf → search ids if filter → `repo.find(spec, mapper(exoObservationFor(obs, user, important.user)))` → `all` list or `paged` page; exceptions → InfrastructureError.
    - **AllocateObservationId**: `ensureCreateObservationPermission` (CREATE_OBSERVATION + event participant) → `repo.allocateObservationId()`.
    - **SaveObservation**: findById(mod.id); existing → ensureUpdateObservationPermission (UPDATE_OBSERVATION_ALL, or UPDATE_OBSERVATION_EVENT + event Read ACL) else ensureCreate; `prepareObservationMod`: base attrs (userId/deviceId/createdAt/states/favorites/important kept from existing, lastModified=now, accuracy/delta/provider first defined of mod then existing); compute removed form entries (existing ids not in mod) and new entries (allocated via `nextFormEntryIds`); extract attachment mods from attachment-type fields (only items with `action`); allocate attachment ids for Add; remove attachments of removed form entries; `Observation.assignTo`; apply add/remove attachment mods (unknown action → invalidInput). `repo.save` → success: log 'added observation' for creates, look up creator & importantFlagger users, return ExoObservation; errors InvalidObservation→invalidInput(validation message), InvalidObservationId→EntityNotFound.
    - **StoreAttachmentContent**: observation & attachment must exist; media type must equal attachment.contentType; `ensureStoreAttachmentContentPermission` (update permission, or for attachments without content: creator with create permission); no hooks → `attachmentStore.saveContent`; StagedAttachmentContentRef → patch {processingStatus: Pending, stagedContentId}; else `stagePendingContent` + pipeline to temp → Pending patch (error → StorageError). StorageError→InfrastructureError, other store error→invalidInput; null patch → return observation unchanged; else `obsRepo.patchAttachment`.
    - **ReadAttachmentContent**: read permission → obs/attachment lookup → minDimension: thumbnail via `thumbnailIndexForTargetDimension` + `readThumbnailContent`, fallback to full content; else `readContent(id, obs, contentRange)`; returns bytes + bytesRange (omitted for thumbnails).
    - **Handlers**: on `AttachmentsRemoved` → setTimeout → `attachmentStore.deleteContent` each (errors logged). On `ObservationSaved` with userId → setTimeout → for dropdown/multiselect active fields with maxRecent>0, non-empty choices → `userPreferenceRepository.addRecentFormFieldChoices`.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      S[SaveObservation] --> A[repo.findById]
      A --> B{exists?}
      B -- yes --> C[ensureUpdateObservationPermission]
      B -- no --> D[ensureCreateObservationPermission]
      C --> E[prepareObservationMod]
      D --> E
      E --> F[nextFormEntryIds / nextAttachmentIds]
      F --> G[Observation.assignTo + add/removeAttachment]
      G --> H[repo.save]
      H -- Observation --> I[userRepo.findAllByIds -> ExoObservation]
      H -- error --> J[invalidInput / entityNotFound]
      U[StoreAttachmentContent] --> K{attachmentHooks?}
      K -- none --> L[attachmentStore.saveContent]
      K -- staged ref --> M[Pending patch]
      K -- stream --> N[stagePendingContent + pipeline] --> M
      L --> P[obsRepo.patchAttachment]
      M --> P
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Per-event observation collection (via ObservationRepositoryForEvent), search index, teams, users, user preferences, attachment content store (files/staging).

    Observation documents created/updated; attachment content written/staged/deleted; recent-choice preferences updated asynchronously; info logs.

    AttachmentHook plugins (only their count is consulted here; processing occurs in a separate job), domain EventEmitter.

    - Save permission check depends on whether the id already exists; create-only roles can still upload content to their own new attachments.

  Description: ##### Entry point
    `CsvExportTransform.export(event, archive, params)` invoked by `CreateExport` when format=`csv` (constructed in app.ts with locationRepo, streamObservations, attachmentStore, deviceRepo, userRepo).
    
    ##### Inputs
    `ExportParams.observationParams` {findSpec, projection} and/or `locationParams` {findSpec}; `MageEvent` with `forms[]` (id, name, archived, fields[{id,name,title,type,archived}]).
    
    ##### Processing flow
    1. Observations (if params): build column list in this exact order: `id`, `User`(user), `Device`(device), `Shape Type`(shapeType), `Latitude`, `Longitude`, `MGRS`, `Date (ISO8601)`(timestamp), `Excel Timestamp (UTC)`(excelTimestamp), `Well Known Text`(wkt), `Location Provider`(provider), `Location Accuracy +/- (meters)`(accuracy); then for each non-archived form, its non-archived, non-`attachment`, projection-included fields sorted by field `id`: label `<form.name>.<field.title>`, value key `<form.name>.<field.name>`; if `includeAttachments` append `Attachment`(attachment) and `Attachment Orig Name`(attachmentOriginalName).
    2. `json2csv.AsyncParser` (object mode) appended to zip as `observations.csv`.
    3. Iterate observations; track min/max `properties.timestamp`; `projectedObservationFormFields`; `observationColumns`:
       - row = {id, ...properties}; user lookup `userRepository.findById` only when cached user differs and observation has userId; device lookup `getDeviceById` likewise; user→`username`, device→`uid`.
       - `turfCentroid(observation)`; mgrs = `mgrs.forward(centroid)`; shapeType = geometry.type; Point → lon/lat from coordinates, else centroid; wkt = `wkx.Geometry.parseGeoJSON(geometry).toWkt()`; excelTimestamp = literal formula `=DATEVALUE(MID(INDIRECT(ADDRESS(ROW(),COLUMN()-1)),1,10)) + TIMEVALUE(MID(INDIRECT(ADDRESS(ROW(),COLUMN()-1)),12,8))`.
       - for each form entry whose form exists, for every form field (archived included) with a **truthy** value: row[`<form.name>.<field.name>`] = value.
       - for each attachment: `attachmentStore.readContent(id, Observation.evaluate(obs,event))`; if Readable: name = `attachment.name || Attachment_<id>`; row.attachment = name; row.attachmentOriginalName = attachment.name; zip entry at archive root with that name.
    4. finally: close cursor, push null (end CSV).
    5. Locations (if params): fields `user,timestamp,latitude,longitude,altitude,provider,mgrs,accuracy,speed,bearing,battery_level,device`; `locations.csv`; `locationRepository.iterate(findSpec)`; `flattenLocation`: {...properties, longitude=coord[0], latitude=coord[1], mgrs=mgrs.forward(coords)}; user refetched when cached id differs; device fetched by `properties.deviceId` (else undefined); username/uid substituted.
    6. Return summary {observations:{count,start,end}, locations:{...}}.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[CsvExportTransform.export] --> B{observationParams?}
      B -- yes --> C[build observationFields] --> D[AsyncParser -> observations.csv]
      D --> E[streamObservations iterate]
      E --> F[observationColumns<br/>user/device cache, centroid, MGRS, WKT, excel formula]
      F --> G[attachmentStore.readContent -> zip root]
      B -- no --> H{locationParams?}
      G --> H
      H -- yes --> I[locations.csv] --> J[locationRepository.iterate] --> K[flattenLocation]
      H -- no --> Z[return summary]
      K --> Z
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Reads: event observation collection (cursor), users (findById), devices (getDeviceById), user locations (cursor), attachment content files. Writes: zip entries only.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    Zip entries `observations.csv`, `locations.csv`, and one file per attachment at zip root.
    
    ##### External calls
    json2csv AsyncParser, @turf/centroid, mgrs.forward ([lon,lat] input, default 5-digit precision), wkx.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - Excel formula references the cell immediately to its left; column order (timestamp directly before excelTimestamp) is load-bearing.
    - Stale cache: if an observation has no userId/deviceId, the previous observation's user/device is written for it.
    - Only truthy form values are written (0, false, '' dropped). Multiple entries of the same form overwrite (last wins). Form names containing '.' may be interpreted as paths by json2csv.
    - Multiple attachments: all go into the zip, but the CSV cell shows only the last one; duplicate names collide in the zip.
    - Attachment columns only present if includeAttachments; with includeAttachments=false the repo returns empty attachments.
    - Location device cache compares `_id` while observation cache compares `id`.
  Recommendation: Fully documented. Confirm with customer whether the stale-user/device cache behavior and 'last attachment wins' column are bugs to fix or behaviors to preserve.
  Note: End-to-end flow: CSV leg of the Observation Export flow: app.ts exportFactory('csv') builds CsvExportTransform(locationRepo, IterateObservations stream, attachmentStore, deviceRepo, userRepo); invoked by CreateExport's async ZIP build in app.impl.exports.ts. No dedicated unit test for this transform exists under service/test (only lifecycle tests in test/app/exports/app.exports.test.ts).     ##### Entry point

    ##### Inputs
    `ExportParams` (see export lifecycle flow): `observationParams.{findSpec, projection}`, `locationParams.findSpec`; the `MageEvent` (forms, fields).
    
    ##### Processing flow
    1. If observationParams: build column list: fixed `id, User, Device, Shape Type, Latitude, Longitude, MGRS, Date (ISO8601), Excel Timestamp (UTC), Well Known Text, Location Provider, Location Accuracy +/- (meters)` (values `id,user,device,shapeType,latitude,longitude,mgrs,timestamp,excelTimestamp,wkt,provider,accuracy`), then for each **non-archived form** its non-archived, non-`attachment` fields included by projection, sorted by `field.id`: label `<form.name>.<field.title>`, value `<form.name>.<field.name>`. If `findSpec.includeAttachments`: add `Attachment`, `Attachment Orig Name`.
    2. `json2csv.AsyncParser` appended to archive as `observations.csv`; iterate observations; per row (`observationColumns`): spread `observation.properties` + id; user lookup cached on last userId (`user.username`); device lookup cached on last deviceId (`device.uid`); `mgrs.forward(turfCentroid)`; Point -> raw lon/lat else centroid; `wkt` via `wkx`; `excelTimestamp` is the literal Excel formula `=DATEVALUE(MID(INDIRECT(ADDRESS(ROW(),COLUMN()-1)),1,10)) + TIMEVALUE(MID(INDIRECT(ADDRESS(ROW(),COLUMN()-1)),12,8))` (relies on the previous column being the ISO date); for each projected form entry copy truthy field values to key `<form.name>.<field.name>`; for each attachment read content via `attachmentStore.readContent(id, Observation.evaluate(...))` and if Readable append to ZIP root as `attachment.name || Attachment_<id>` and set `attachment`/`attachmentOriginalName` columns.
    3. Track min/max `properties.timestamp`, count; finally `close()` iterator and push null.

    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[CsvExportTransform.export] --> B{observationParams?}
      B -->|yes| C[exportObservations build fields]
      C --> D[AsyncParser -> observations.csv]
      D --> E[pipeObservations IterateObservations]
      E --> F[observationColumns user/device cache, mgrs, wkt, form fields]
      F --> G[attachmentStore.readContent -> archive root]
      B --> H{locationParams?}
      H -->|yes| I[exportLocations -> locations.csv]
      I --> J[locationRepository.iterate -> flattenLocation]
      H --> K[return summary]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Reads: observations (event collection via repository), users (`findById`), devices (`getDeviceById`), attachment files (attachment store), user locations. Writes: ZIP entries `observations.csv`, `locations.csv`, attachment files at archive root.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    CSV entries + attachments; `ExportSummary {observations?, locations?: {count, startTimestamp, endTimestamp}}`.
    
    ##### External calls
    `json2csv` AsyncParser, `@turf/centroid`, `mgrs`, `wkx`.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - Falsy form values (0, false, '') are not written (`if (fieldEntry)`).
    - Multiple attachments: only the last one's name stays in the row; all files are appended. Duplicate attachment names collide in the ZIP root.
    - Attachment fields excluded from columns; archived forms/fields excluded from columns but archived field values still copied (dropped by json2csv since no column).

    - Startup background task `searchIndexTask` in app.ts `initTasks` → `indexAllEvents(eventRepo, indexEventObservations)` (force=false).
    - `POST /api/search-index/events` → `SearchIndexAllEvents`; `POST /api/search-index/events/:eventId` → `SearchIndexEvent` (bearer).

    ##### Inputs
    Event id path param; request context principal.
    
    ##### Processing flow
    `IndexEventObservations(event, force=false)`: `eventRepository.claimIndexing(event.id)` (atomic claim; false → debug log and return). Get per-event repo, `observationRepo.iterate({})` cursor over all observations, `observationSearchRepo.populate(event.id, cursor, force)` returns count; finally close cursor. Then `eventRepository.update({id, observationSearchStatus:'indexed'})`. Any error → log and set `observationSearchStatus:'pending'`.
    `indexAllEvents`: `eventRepository.findAll()`; sequentially for each: if status `'running'` reset to `'pending'`, then await index.
    `SearchIndexAllEvents`: permission UPDATE_EVENT role permission; fire `indexAllEvents(..., force=true)` without await; return `{}`.
    `SearchIndexEvent`: findById (404 Event) **before** permission check; `authorizeEventAccess(event, user, UPDATE_EVENT, EventAccessType.Update)`; reset running→pending; fire index with force=true; return `{}`.
    Listener: on `Observation.Saved` → `await searchRepo.save(e.observation)`.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      T[boot searchIndexTask / POST search-index] --> A[indexAllEvents]
      A --> L[for each event: running->pending]
      L --> I[IndexEventObservations]
      I --> C{claimIndexing?}
      C -- no --> X[skip]
      C -- yes --> P[iterate observations -> searchRepo.populate]
      P -->|ok| OK[status indexed]
      P -->|error| ER[status pending]
      O[Observation.Saved] --> S[searchRepo.save observation]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Events collection field `observationSearchStatus` ('pending'|'running'|'indexed'); per-event observation collection (streamed); observation search collection (populated/upserted).
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    Search index documents; event status. HTTP returns 200 `{}` immediately.
    
    ##### External calls
    None outside MongoDB.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - Admin reindex returns before work completes; errors only logged.
    - Single-event endpoint leaks existence (404) before authorization.
    - Stale 'running' reset makes concurrent reindex across nodes possible.
    - Listener errors become rejected promises captured by EventEmitter `captureRejections` → logged.
    - Boot indexing uses force=false; admin uses force=true.

      export function IndexEventObservations(
        eventRepository: MageEventRepository,
        observationRepoForEvent: ObservationRepositoryForEvent,
        observationSearchRepo: ObservationSearchRepository,
        log: Logger = NoopLogger
      ): api.IndexEventObservations {
        return async function indexEventObservations(event: MageEventAttrs, force: boolean = false): Promise<void> {
          try {
            const claimed = await eventRepository.claimIndexing(event.id)
            if (!claimed) {
              log.debug(`skipping index for event ${event.id}, already running`)
              return
            }
      
            let observations: AsyncIterable<ObservationAttrs> & { close?: () => void } | null = null
            try {
              const observationRepo = await observationRepoForEvent(event.id)
              observations = observationRepo.iterate({})
              const count = await observationSearchRepo.populate(event.id, observations, force)
              log.debug(`indexed ${count} new observations for search for event ${event.id}`)
            } finally {
              observations?.close?.()
            }
      
            await eventRepository.update({ id: event.id, observationSearchStatus: 'indexed' })
          } catch (err) {
            log.error(`failed to index observations for search for event ${event.id}`, err)
            await eventRepository.update({ id: event.id, observationSearchStatus: 'pending' })
          }
        }
      }
      
      export async function indexAllEvents(
        eventRepository: MageEventRepository,
        indexEventObservations: api.IndexEventObservations,
        force: boolean = false
      ): Promise<void> {
        const events = await eventRepository.findAll()
        for (const event of events) {
          // Reset any stale 'running' status left by a previous crash so claimIndexing can proceed
          if (event.observationSearchStatus === 'running') {
            await eventRepository.update({ id: event.id, observationSearchStatus: 'pending' })
          }
          await indexEventObservations(event, force)
        }
      }
      
      export function SearchIndexAllEvents(
        permissionService: api.SearchIndexPermissionService,
        eventRepository: MageEventRepository,
        indexEventObservations: api.IndexEventObservations
      ): api.SearchIndexAllEvents {
        return async function searchIndexAllEvents(req: api.SearchIndexAllEventsRequest): ReturnType<api.SearchIndexAllEvents> {
          const denied = await permissionService.ensureSearchIndexAllPermission(req.context)
          if (denied) {
            return AppResponse.error(denied)
          }
      
          indexAllEvents(eventRepository, indexEventObservations, true)
      
          return AppResponse.success({})
        }
      }
      
      export function SearchIndexEvent(
        permissionService: api.SearchIndexPermissionService,
        eventRepository: MageEventRepository,
        indexEventObservations: api.IndexEventObservations
      ): api.SearchIndexEvent {
        return async function searchIndexEvent(req: api.SearchIndexEventRequest): ReturnType<api.SearchIndexEvent> {
          const event = await eventRepository.findById(req.eventId)
          if (!event) {
            return AppResponse.error(entityNotFound(req.eventId, 'Event'))
          }
      
          const denied = await permissionService.ensureSearchIndexEventPermission(req.context, event)
          if (denied) {
            return AppResponse.error(denied)
          }
      
          // Reset any stale 'running' status left by a previous crash so claimIndexing can proceed
          if (event.observationSearchStatus === 'running') {
            await eventRepository.update({ id: event.id, observationSearchStatus: 'pending' })
          }
      
          indexEventObservations(event, true)
      
          return AppResponse.success({})
        }
      }
      
      export function registerObservationSavedHandler(domainEvents: EventEmitter, repo: ObservationSearchRepository): void {
        domainEvents.on(ObservationDomainEventType.ObservationSaved, async (e: ObservationEmitted<ObservationSavedDomainEvent>) => {
          await repo.save(e.observation)
        })
      }

  Description: ##### Entry point
    Module exports `getNext(collection)` and `getGroup(collection, amount)`; used by legacy models and migration 011 (`getNext('form')`).
    
    ##### Inputs
    Sequence name (string), amount.
    
    ##### Processing flow
    `Counter.findOneAndUpdate({_id: name}, {$inc:{sequence: amount}}, {upsert:true, new:true})` → `range(counter.sequence, counter.sequence + amount)` (inclusive both ends). `getNext` returns first element.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[getGroup name,n] --> B[findOneAndUpdate $inc upsert new]
      B --> C[range seq..seq+n inclusive]
      D[getNext] --> A --> E[ids 0]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Model `Counter`, collection `counters`, schema `{ _id: String required, sequence: Number required }`, no `__v`.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    Increments sequence.
    
    ##### External calls
    None.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - Off-by-one: returns n+1 ids starting at the *post-increment* value; e.g. first call on empty counter with amount 1 returns `[1,2]`, getNext → 1; the next call returns `[2,3]` → 2. So ids returned overlap the next group's first id when callers use all elements of the range. getNext is safe; consumers of getGroup that use all values can collide.
    - First ever id is 1 (upsert from 0).

      let mongoose = require('mongoose');
      
      // Creates a new Mongoose Schema object
      let Schema = mongoose.Schema;
      
      // Collection to hold counters/sequences for ids
      let CounterSchema = new Schema({
        _id: { type: String, required: true },
        sequence: { type: Number, required: true }
      },{
        versionKey: false
      });
      
      // Creates the Model for the Attachments Schema
      let Counter = mongoose.model('Counter', CounterSchema);
      
      function range(start, end) {
        let values = [];
        for (var i = start; i <= end; i++) {
          values.push(i);
        }
      
        return values;
      }
      
      function getNext(collection) {
        return getGroup(collection, 1).then(function(ids) {
          return Promise.resolve(ids[0]);
        });
      }
      
      function getGroup(collection, amount) {
        const query = {_id: collection};
        const update = {$inc: {sequence: amount}};
        const options = {upsert: true, new: true};
      
        return Counter.findOneAndUpdate(query, update, options).exec().then(function(counter) {
          const ids = range(counter.sequence, counter.sequence + amount);
          return Promise.resolve(ids);
        });
      }
      
      exports.getNext = getNext;
      exports.getGroup = getGroup;

      "use strict";
      
      const log = require('winston')
        , ObjectId = require('mongodb').ObjectId;
      
      exports.id = 'attachment-form-field';
      
      async function createAttachmentField(db) {
        const collection = await db.collection('events');
        const formCounterCollection = await db.collection('counters');
        const events = await collection.find().toArray();
        for (const event of events) {
          log.info(`creating attachment fields for event ${event.name}`);
      
          event.forms.forEach(form => {
            let id = 0;
            const fields = form.fields.slice() || [];
            if (fields.length) {
              id = fields.sort((a, b) => b.id - a.id)[0].id + 1;
            }
      
            // Attachment field will be first, add one to every other field id
            fields.forEach(field => field.id = ++field.id);
      
            fields.push({
              id: 0,
              name: `field${id}`,
              required: false,
              type: 'attachment',
              title: 'Attachments',
              choices: [],
              allowedAttachmentTypes: ['image', 'video', 'audio']
            });
      
            log.info('adding attachment field to form', fields[fields.length - 1]);
      
            form.fields = fields;
          });
      
          if (event.forms.length === 0) {
            log.info(`Event ${event.name} has no forms`);
      
            const observationCollection = await db.collection(`observations${event._id}`);
            const count = await observationCollection.countDocuments({ attachments: { $exists: true, $ne: [] } })
            if (count > 0) {
              log.info(`Event ${event.name} has no forms, but does contain attachments, create new form w/ attachment field`);
      
              const counter = await formCounterCollection.findOneAndUpdate({ _id: 'form' }, { $inc: { sequence: 1 } }, { upsert: true, returnDocument: 'after' });
      
              // Create a new form for this event that would allow users to submit attachments
              event.forms = [{
                _id: counter.sequence,
                name: event.name,
                color: '#1E88E5',
                userFields: [],
                archived: false,
                default: false,
                fields: [{
                  id: 1,
                  name: 'field1',
                  required: false,
                  type: 'attachment',
                  title: 'Attachments',
                  choices: [],
                  allowedAttachmentTypes: ['image', 'video', 'audio']
                }]
              }];
            }
          }
      
          await collection.findOneAndReplace({ _id: event._id }, event);
        }
      }
      
      async function updateEventAttachments(db, event) {
        const collectionName = `observations${event._id}`;
        log.info(`updating observations ${collectionName}`);
      
        const collection = await db.collection(collectionName);
        const observations = await collection.find().toArray();
        log.info(`found ${observations.length} in collection`)
        for (const observation of observations) {
          // Add _id to observation form, if exists
          const observationFormId = new ObjectId();
          if (observation.properties.forms && observation.properties.forms.length) {
            const observationForm = observation.properties.forms[0];
            observationForm._id = observationFormId;
          }
      
          const attachments = observation.attachments || [];
          if (attachments.length) {
            // observation has attachments, add to form if exists, create if not
            let observationForm;
            if (observation.properties.forms && observation.properties.forms.length) {
              observationForm = observation.properties.forms[0];
            } else {
              observationForm = {
                _id: observationFormId,
                formId: event.forms[0]._id
              }
              observation.properties.forms = [observationForm];
            }
      
            const form = event.forms.find(form => form._id === observationForm.formId);
            const attachmentField = form.fields.find(field => field.type === 'attachment');
            attachments.forEach(attachment => {
              attachment.observationFormId = observationFormId;
              attachment.fieldName = attachmentField.name;
            });
          }
      
          log.info('updating observation attachments', observation.attachments);
      
          await collection.findOneAndReplace({ _id: observation._id }, observation);
        }
      }
      
      async function updateAttachments(db) {
        const collection = await db.collection('events');
        const events = await collection.find().toArray();
        for (const event of events) {
          await updateEventAttachments(db, event);
        }
      }

      import { AppResponse } from '../../app.api/app.api.global'
      import * as api from '../../app.api/systemInfo/app.api.systemInfo'
      import { EnvironmentService } from '../../entities/systemInfo/entities.systemInfo'
      import * as Settings from '../../models/setting'
      import * as Users from '../../models/user'
      import * as AuthenticationConfiguration from '../../models/authenticationconfiguration'
      import AuthenticationConfigurationTransformer from '../../transformers/authenticationconfiguration'
      import { ExoPrivilegedSystemInfo, ExoRedactedSystemInfo, ExoSystemInfo, SystemInfoPermissionService } from '../../app.api/systemInfo/app.api.systemInfo'
      
      /**
       * This factory function creates the implementation of the {@link api.ReadSystemInfo}
       * application layer interface.
       */
      export function CreateReadSystemInfo(
        environmentService: EnvironmentService,
        version: api.ApiVersion,
        serverVersion: string,
        settingsModule: typeof Settings = Settings,
        authConfigModule: typeof AuthenticationConfiguration = AuthenticationConfiguration,
        authConfigTransformerModule: typeof AuthenticationConfigurationTransformer = AuthenticationConfigurationTransformer,
        permissions: SystemInfoPermissionService
      ): api.ReadSystemInfo {
        // appending the authentication strategies to the api
        async function appendAuthenticationStrategies(
          api: any,
          options: any = {}
        ): Promise<any> {
          const apiCopy = {
            ...api,
            authenticationStrategies: {}
          }
          const authenticationConfigurations = await authConfigModule.getAllConfigurations()
          const transformedConfigurations = authConfigTransformerModule.transform(
            authenticationConfigurations.filter(config => config.enabled || options.includeDisabled),
            options
          )
          transformedConfigurations.forEach(
            (configuration: { name: string | number }) => {
              apiCopy.authenticationStrategies[configuration.name] = {
                ...configuration
              }
            }
          )
          return apiCopy
        }
      
        return async function readSystemInfo(req: api.ReadSystemInfoRequest): Promise<api.ReadSystemInfoResponse> {
      
      	  // FIXME: Replace this with Robert's first-run secret implementation when available
          const legacyUsers = Users as any   
          const userCount = await new Promise(resolve => {
            legacyUsers.count({}, (err:any, count:any) => {
              resolve(count)
            })
          })
      
          // Initialize with base system info
          let systemInfoResponse: ExoRedactedSystemInfo = {
            version: version,
            serverVersion: serverVersion,
            initial: userCount == 0,
            disclaimer: (await settingsModule.getSetting('disclaimer'))?.settings || {},
            contactInfo: (await settingsModule.getSetting('contactinfo'))?.settings || {}
          }
      
          // Add environment details for authenticated users with permission
          const hasReadSystemInfoPermission =  await permissions.ensureReadSystemInfoPermission(req.context)
          if (hasReadSystemInfoPermission === null) {
            const environmentInfo = await environmentService.readEnvironmentInfo()
            systemInfoResponse = {
              ...systemInfoResponse,
              environment: environmentInfo
            } as ExoPrivilegedSystemInfo
          }
      
          // Apply authentication strategies to the system info response
          const updatedApiConfig = await appendAuthenticationStrategies(systemInfoResponse, {
              whitelist: true
          })
      
          return AppResponse.success(updatedApiConfig as ExoSystemInfo) // Cast to ExoSystemInfo
        }
      }

      import * as api from '../../app.api/preferences/app.api.preferences'
      import { withPermission, KnownErrorsOf } from '../../app.api/app.api.global'
      import { EventPreference, UserPreferenceRepository } from '../../entities/users/entities.users'
      import { entityNotFound } from '../../app.api/app.api.errors'
      
      export function GetEventPreferences(
        userPreferenceRepository: UserPreferenceRepository,
        permissions: api.UserPreferencePermissionService
      ): api.GetEventPreferences {
        return async function getEventPreferences(req: api.GetEventPreferencesRequest): ReturnType<api.GetEventPreferences> {
          return await withPermission<EventPreference, KnownErrorsOf<api.GetEventPreferences>>(
            permissions.ensureGetEventPreferencePermission(req.context),
            async () => {
              const user = req.context.requestingPrincipal()
              const eventPreference = await userPreferenceRepository.getEventPreferences(user.id, req.eventId)
      
              if (!eventPreference) {
                return entityNotFound(req.eventId, 'Event Preference')
              }
      
              return eventPreference
            }
          )
        }
      }

      B -- yes --> Z[return service]

      C --> D[mkdirp attachmentBaseDirectory / iconBaseDirectory]
      D --> E[initDatabase: waitForDefaultMongooseConnection]
      E --> F[models.initializeModels]
      F --> G[migrate.runDatabaseMigrations]
      G --> H[initRepositories + initializeAttachmentStore]
      H --> I[initTasks: ExportArchiveTask, searchIndexTask]
      I --> J[initAppLayer / initWebLayer]
      J --> K[for each servicePlugin: import + integratePluginHooks]
      K --> L[attachmentHooks.push + setAttachmentHooks]
      L --> M[startAttachmentProcessing]
      M --> N[addPluginRoutes reverse-sorted]
      N --> O{task.background?}
      O -- yes --> P[task.run no await]
      O -- no --> Q[await task.run]
      P --> R[http.createServer webController]

      R --> S[open: server.listen port,address -> emit comingOfMage]

    ##### Data
    - Mongo: `migrations` collection (migration ledger); `exports` (read all, update status, delete expired); `events` (read all for search index, update `observationSearchStatus`).
    - Filesystem: creates attachmentBaseDirectory, `<attachmentBase>/pending`, iconBaseDirectory, exportDirectory; deletes export content files.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    HTTP server bound to address:port; `comingOfMage` event; background loops: attachment processing (15 s), export sweep (exportSweepInterval s), one-time search index catch-up.
    
    ##### External calls
    MongoDB (mongoose default connection + per-plugin connections); dynamic `import(pluginId)` of npm plugin packages (e.g. ArcGIS, SFTP, ATAK, image plugins) given injected services, returning hook objects.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - env.js runs at require time and **mutates process.env** (`MAGE_PORT='4242'` if neither MAGE_PORT nor PORT set). `port` uses `.map(parseInt)` — parseInt receives array index as radix (MAGE_PORT radix 0 = base 10, PORT radix 1 → always NaN); so `PORT` alone is effectively ignored unless MAGE_PORT also set... in practice MAGE_PORT is forced to '4242' when absent, so a PORT-only deployment still listens on 4242 if PORT is set? No: MAGE_PORT is only defaulted when both absent; with only PORT set, MAGE_PORT is undefined→NaN, PORT parsed with radix 1→NaN, falls to 4242. Re-implementer must preserve or consciously fix this (PORT is effectively ignored).
    - Numeric env vars use `parseInt(x) || default`, so `0` falls back to defaults. Mongo timeouts are given in seconds and multiplied by 1000.
    - x509 inline path: if MAGE_MONGO_X509_KEY is set but CERT/CA are not, `Buffer.from(undefined)` throws at startup.
    - SCRAM-SHA-1 hard-coded.
    - Plugin import failures are swallowed; migration failure calls `process.exit(1)`.
    - ExportArchiveTask is awaited, so boot blocks until the first expired-export sweep finishes; any error from the Running→Failed reset propagates and aborts boot (only doTask is try/caught).
    - Plugin route mount order is reverse-sorted so longer/later ids win prefix conflicts.
    - A standalone export service would need: MAGE_MONGO_URL (+auth vars), MAGE_EXPORT_DIR, MAGE_EXPORT_TTL, MAGE_EXPORT_SWEEP_INTERVAL, MAGE_ATTACHMENT_DIR and MAGE_ICON_DIR mounts (exports embed attachments/icons).

    Detail folded from duplicate sfind-dcb1477878a0445abc429021594b30f6 (MAGE service boot sequence (boot → initDatabase → migrations → repositories → tasks → app layer → web layer → plugins → listen)), original documentation:
    
    ##### Entry point
    `service/bin/mage.service.js:90` calls `boot(merged)` exported from `service/src/app.ts:234`. `boot(config: BootConfig)` returns a `MageService { webController, server, open() }`. It is a process-wide singleton: module variable `service` (line 232) is returned immediately on a second call.
    
    ##### Inputs
    - `BootConfig = { plugins: { servicePlugins?: string[], webUIPlugins?: string[] } }` — npm package names.
    - `environment` from `environment/env.js` (see the configuration flow): `attachmentBaseDirectory`, `iconBaseDirectory`, `mongo.{uri,connectTimeout,connectRetryDelay,options}`, `exportTtl`, `exportDirectory`, `exportSweepInterval`, `userBaseDirectory`, `port`, `address`.
    - `../package.json` `apiVersion` ("major.minor.patch") and `version`, read in `initSystemInfoAppLayer`.
    
    ##### Processing flow
    1. Mongoose global debug hook (241-256): every collection op is logged at debug level on `log.mongooseLogger` as `collection.method(args)`. `util.inspect` depth is 10, newlines are removed and whitespace is collapsed.
    2. Mongoose global validation message: `required` becomes `'{PATH} is required.'` (258).
    3. `logPermissionDenials(log.child({component:'permissions'}))` (262).
    4. `fs.mkdirp(attachmentBaseDirectory)`, then `fs.mkdirp(iconBaseDirectory)` (265-281). Either failure is logged and rethrown, which aborts the boot. The user, layer, temp and security dirs are not created here. The export dir is created later by `ExportArchiveTask.run`.
    5. `initDatabase()` (497):
       a. `waitForDefaultMongooseConnection(mongoose, uri, connectTimeout, connectRetryDelay, options)` retries until the timeout.
       b. Builds `PluginConnectionFactory(pluginId)`, which returns a thunk. The thunk uses a new `mongoose.Mongoose()` instance with options `{...options, minPoolSize:5, maxPoolSize:5, bufferCommands:false, autoIndex:false}` and logs `get db connection for plugin <id>` on every call.
       c. `require('./models').initializeModels()` requires every module in `models/` to register the legacy Mongoose models.
       d. `migrate.runDatabaseMigrations(uri, options)` (`migrate.ts`) uses `@ngageoint/mongodb-migrations`. It runs the files in `src/migrations` in directory order and tracks them in the `migrations` collection. **On any migration error, or a connection error, it calls `process.exit(1)`.**
       e. Loads the legacy models `models/event`, `models/user`, `models/setting` and `models/team` and builds the new-style models on `conn`: `DeviceModel`, the feed models, `ExportModel`, `StaticIconModel`, `UserPreferenceModel`, `ObservationIconModel`, `ObservationSearchModel`, `UserLocationModel`, `RecentUserLocationModel` and `RoleModel`.
    6. `initRepositories` (680):
       - Wraps each model in its Mongoose repository.
       - `MongooseExportsRepository(model, exportTtl*1000)` sets the export TTL in ms.
       - Content stores: `FileSystemExportContentStore(exportDirectory)`, `FileSystemIconContentStore(iconBaseDirectory)` for static icons, `FileSystemUserIconContentStore(userBaseDirectory)` and `FileSystemObservationIconContentStore(iconBaseDirectory)`.
       - `PluginUrlScheme(servicePlugins)` resolves the static-icon source URLs.
       - Calls `models/user.initialize({userLocationRepo, recentUserLocationRepo})` and `models/role.initialize({roleRepo})` to inject the new repos into the legacy modules.
       - `initializeAttachmentStore(attachmentBaseDirectory)`: if it returns a `FileSystemAttachmentStoreInitError`, that error is thrown.
       - `createObservationRepositoryFactory(eventRepo, DomainEvents)` builds the per-event observation repos.
       - `EnvironmentServiceImpl(conn)` provides system info.
    7. `initTasks` (1443) only constructs the tasks; they are run in step 12:
       - `ExportArchiveTask(exportDirectory, exportSweepInterval, exportStore, exportRepo)`.
       - `searchIndexTask {background:true, run: indexAllEvents(eventRepo, IndexEventObservations(...))}`.
    8. `initAppLayer(repos, attachmentHooks)`: wires every use case and registers the domain-event handlers (see the composition flow). `attachmentHooks` is an empty array whose reference is captured by `StoreAttachmentContent`.
    9. `initWebLayer(repos, appLayer, webUIPlugins)`: imports `express.js`, which builds the express app, runs `AuthenticationInitializer.initialize` and mounts the legacy routes, then mounts the new routers (see the composition flow).
    10. Plugin loop (325-365): see the plugin-hooks flow. Afterwards the per-plugin attachment hooks are flattened into the same `attachmentHooks` array with `push(...)`, which mutates rather than reassigns it, and are also passed to `setAttachmentHooks` (global registry).
    11. `startAttachmentProcessing(obsRepoFactory, attachmentStore, attachmentHooks, console)` (377) starts a self-rescheduling `setTimeout` job with defaults `intervalSeconds=15`, `batchSize=20`, `retryLimit=3`. Each attachment from `findPendingAttachments(20)` goes through `runPipeline(hooks, attachment, stagedPath)`:
        - `pass`: `attachmentStore.saveContent(...)`, then the attachment is patched with `processingStatus=Success` and `stagedContentId` unset.
        - `reject`: the staged content is deleted and the attachment is patched with `Rejected`, `processingMessage=reason` and `processingHook`.
        - `error`: the retry count is incremented. If it is below 3 the attachment is patched with `Pending` and the message and hook. Otherwise the staged content is deleted and the attachment is patched with `Error`.
        - Unexpected exceptions are logged and the attachment is left for the next cycle.
    12. Plugin routes are added in **reverse lexical order of plugin id** (379-385).
    13. Tasks run in order:
        - The export task is **awaited**. `ExportArchiveTask.run`: mkdir the export dir, set every export with `status=Running` to `Failed` and delete its content, then `schedule()` → `doTask()` (delete exports whose `expirationDate` is in the past, from the repo and the store), then `setTimeout(schedule, interval*1000)`.
        - The search-index task is fired without awaiting (`background`).
    14. `httpLib.createServer(webController)`. `open()` calls `server.listen(environment.port, environment.address)`. The listen callback logs and emits `MageReadyEvent = 'comingOfMage'` on the express app with the service.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[mage.service.js boot config] --> B{service singleton set?}
      B -- yes --> Z[return existing service]
      B -- no --> C[mongoose.set debug -> mongooseLogger]
      C --> D[logPermissionDenials]
      D --> E[fs.mkdirp attachmentBaseDirectory]
      E --> F[fs.mkdirp iconBaseDirectory]
      F --> G[initDatabase: waitForDefaultMongooseConnection]
      G --> H[models.initializeModels]
      H --> I[migrate.runDatabaseMigrations]
      I -- error --> X[process.exit 1]
      I --> J[initRepositories + initializeAttachmentStore]
      J --> K[initTasks: ExportArchiveTask, searchIndexTask]
      K --> L[initAppLayer: use cases + DomainEvents handlers]
      L --> M[initWebLayer: express.js + routers]
      M --> N[for each servicePlugin: import + integratePluginHooks]
      N --> O[attachmentHooks.push + setAttachmentHooks]
      O --> P[startAttachmentProcessing 15s/20/3]
      P --> Q[addPluginRoutes reverse-sorted ids]
      Q --> R[await ExportArchiveTask.run]
      R --> S[searchIndexTask.run background]
      S --> T[http.createServer]
      T --> U[open: listen port,address -> emit comingOfMage]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    - **MongoDB (default connection):**
      - All legacy models are registered.
      - The `migrations` collection is written by the migrator.
      - `exports` is read and updated at startup (Running→Failed) and swept for expiry.
      - Observation collections (per event) are scanned by the attachment processor (`findPendingAttachments`) and the search indexer.
    - **Filesystem:**
      - `attachmentBaseDirectory` and `iconBaseDirectory` are created at boot.
      - `exportDirectory` is created by the export task, which deletes expired or interrupted export files there.
      - The attachment staging/final content lives under the attachment dir.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    - Long-running timers: export sweep (`exportSweepInterval` s) and attachment processing (15 s).
    - A one-off background search-index rebuild over all events.
    - Running exports are marked `Failed` on every restart.
    - `comingOfMage` is emitted on listen.
    
    ##### External calls
    - MongoDB through mongoose and through `@ngageoint/mongodb-migrations`, which opens its own client with the same URL and options.
    - Dynamic `import(pluginId)` for each service plugin.
    - `require.resolve('@ngageoint/mage.web-app/package.json')` for static UI hosting; on failure it only warns.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - **Boot blocking:** boot waits on the first export sweep and on the Running→Failed fix-up, but not on the search index. The search index may be incomplete for a while after startup.
    - **Migration failures:** a failed migration kills the process (`process.exit(1)`) rather than throwing to the caller.
    - **Plugin connections:** they use a separate Mongoose instance with fixed pool 5/5, `autoIndex:false` and `bufferCommands:false`. Every call of the returned thunk calls `waitForDefaultMongooseConnection` again on the same instance.
    - **Attachment hook array:** the array passed to `StoreAttachmentContent` is captured before the plugins load, and it is filled by mutation later. A re-implementation must not copy it at app-layer construction.
    - **Required directory volumes:** a standalone export service needs `exportDirectory`, `attachmentBaseDirectory`, `iconBaseDirectory` and `userBaseDirectory` mounted. The KML/GeoPackage transforms read icons and avatars, and the CSV/GeoJSON/KML transforms read attachments.
    - **Listen port:** `environment.port` can be `undefined` (see the configuration flow). In that case `server.listen` binds a random ephemeral port.
    - **Duplicate `Device` model:** `Device` is registered by legacy `models/device.js` on the default connection and again by `DeviceModel(conn)` with an explicit collection `'devices'`. Both target the same collection. Whether Mongoose 8.24.1 returns the existing model or a new one in this case was not verified by reading Mongoose source.

      export const boot = async function(config: BootConfig): Promise<MageService> {
        if (service) {
          return service as MageService
        }
      
        const mongooseLogger = log.mongooseLogger;
      
        mongoose.set('debug', function(
          collection: any,
          method: any,
          ...methodArgs: any[]
        ) {
          const formatter = (arg: any): string => {
            return util
              .inspect(arg, false, 10, true)
              .replace(/\n/g, '')
              .replace(/\s{2,}/g, ' ');
          };
      
          mongooseLogger.debug(
            `${collection}.${method}(${methodArgs.map(formatter).join(', ')})`
          );
        });
      
        mongoose.Error.messages.general.required = '{PATH} is required.';
      
        log.info('Starting MAGE Server ...');
      
        logPermissionDenials(log.child({ component: 'permissions' }));
      
        // Create directory for storing media attachments
        const attachmentBase = environment.attachmentBaseDirectory;
        log.info(`creating attachments directory at ${attachmentBase}`);
        try {
          await fs.mkdirp(attachmentBase);
        } catch (err) {
          log.error(`error creating attachments directory ${attachmentBase}: `, err);
          throw err;
        }
      
        const iconBase = environment.iconBaseDirectory;
        log.info(`creating icon directory at ${iconBase}`);
        try {
          await fs.mkdirp(iconBase);
        } catch (err) {
          log.error(`error creating icon directory ${iconBase}: `, err);
          throw err;
        }
      
        const dbLayer = await initDatabase();
        const repos = await initRepositories(dbLayer, config);
        const tasks = await initTasks(repos, log.child({ component: 'export-archive' }));
        const attachmentHooks: AttachmentHook[] = [];
        const appLayer = await initAppLayer(repos, attachmentHooks);
        const { webController, addPluginRoutes } = await initWebLayer(
          repos,
          appLayer,
          config.plugins?.webUIPlugins || []
        );
      
        const routesForPluginId: { [pluginId: string]: WebRoutesHooks } = {};
        const collectPluginRoutesToSort = (
          pluginId: string,
          initPluginRoutes: WebRoutesHooks
        ): void => {
          routesForPluginId[pluginId] = initPluginRoutes;
        };
      
        // Hooks by plugin
        const attachmentHooksByPluginId: { [pluginId: string]: AttachmentHook[] } = {};
        const collectAttachmentHooks = (
          pluginId: string,
          attachmentHooks: AttachmentHook[]
        ): void => {
          attachmentHooksByPluginId[pluginId] = attachmentHooks;
        };
      
        const globalScopeServices = new Map<InjectionToken<any>, any>([
          [FeedServiceTypeRepositoryToken, repos.feeds.serviceTypeRepo],
          [FeedServiceRepositoryToken, repos.feeds.serviceRepo],
          [FeedRepositoryToken, repos.feeds.feedRepo],
          [MageEventRepositoryToken, repos.events.eventRepo],
          [ObservationRepositoryToken, repos.observations.obsRepoFactory],
          [AttachmentStoreToken, repos.observations.attachmentStore],
          [StaticIconRepositoryToken, repos.icons.staticIconRepo],
          [UserRepositoryToken, repos.users.userRepo],
          [FeedsAppServiceTokens.CreateFeed, appLayer.feeds.createFeed],
          [FeedsAppServiceTokens.UpdateFeed, appLayer.feeds.updateFeed],
          [FeedsAppServiceTokens.DeleteFeed, appLayer.feeds.deleteFeed]
        ]);
      
        for (const pluginId of config.plugins?.servicePlugins || []) {
          console.info(`loading plugin ${pluginId}...`);
          const pluginScopeServices = new Map<InjectionToken<any>, any>();
      
          const injectService: InjectableServices = <Service>(
            token: InjectionToken<Service>
          ) => {
            // TODO: hack for now but could be better
            if (token === PluginStateRepositoryToken) {
              let stateRepo = pluginScopeServices.get(PluginStateRepositoryToken);
              if (!stateRepo) {
                stateRepo = new MongoosePluginStateRepository(pluginId, mongoose);
                pluginScopeServices.set(PluginStateRepositoryToken, stateRepo);
              }
              return stateRepo;
            } else if (token === MongooseDbConnectionToken) {
              return dbLayer.connectionFactoryForPlugin(pluginId);
            }
            return globalScopeServices.get(token);
          };
      
          try {
            /*
            TODO: may need to switch to require.resolve() or custom api to load
            modules from a different plugins folder to properly support
            docker/container deployments with a base mage instance image and an
            externally-mounted plugins directory.
            */
            const initPlugin: InitPluginHook = await import(pluginId);
            await integratePluginHooks(
              pluginId,
              initPlugin,
              injectService,
              collectPluginRoutesToSort,
              collectAttachmentHooks,
              DomainEvents
            );
          } catch (err) {
            console.error(`error loading plugin ${pluginId}`, err);
          }
        }
      
        // Flatten hooks in array. Mutates the array declared earlier (not a
        // reassignment) so the reference already passed into storeAttachmentContent
        // reflects these contents once real requests start coming in.
        attachmentHooks.push(...Object.values(attachmentHooksByPluginId).flat())
        setAttachmentHooks(attachmentHooks)
      
        // Start the background job that finds attachments staged by
        // storeAttachmentContent and runs them through the now-final attachmentHooks
        // list. Core-owned (not tied to any one plugin's init()), since it must run
        // hooks contributed by any enabled plugin.
        startAttachmentProcessing(repos.observations.obsRepoFactory, repos.observations.attachmentStore, attachmentHooks, console);
      
        const pluginRoutePathsDescending = Object.keys(routesForPluginId)
          .sort()
          .reverse();
      
        for (const pluginId of pluginRoutePathsDescending) {
          addPluginRoutes(pluginId, routesForPluginId[pluginId]);
        }
      
        for (const task of tasks) {
          if (task.background) {
            task.run();
          } else {
            await task.run();
          }
        }
      
        const server = httpLib.createServer(webController);
        service = {
          webController,
          server,
          open(): MageService {
            server.listen(environment.port, environment.address, () => {
              log.info(
                `MAGE Server listening at address ${environment.address} on port ${environment.port}`
              );
              webController.emit(MageReadyEvent, service);
            });
            return this;
          }
        };
      
        return service;

      async function initTasks(repos: Repositories, logger: Logger): Promise<Task[]> {
        const exportTask = new ExportArchiveTask(
          environment.exportDirectory,
          environment.exportSweepInterval,
          repos.exports.exportStore,
          repos.exports.exportRepo,
          logger
        );
      
        const indexEventObservations = observationsSearchImpl.IndexEventObservations(
          repos.events.eventRepo,
          repos.observations.obsRepoFactory,
          repos.observations.searchRepo,
          log.child({ component: 'search-index' })
        );
        const searchIndexTask: Task = {
          background: true,
          run(): Promise<void> {
            return observationsSearchImpl.indexAllEvents(repos.events.eventRepo, indexEventObservations);
          }
        };
      
        return [exportTask, searchIndexTask];
      }

      import { URL } from 'url'
      import { entityNotFound, infrastructureError, invalidInput } from '../../app.api/app.api.errors'
      import { KnownErrorsOf, withPermission } from '../../app.api/app.api.global'
      import { CreateLocalStaticIcon, CreateLocalStaticIconRequest, ListStaticIcons, ListStaticIconsRequest, GetStaticIcon, GetStaticIconContent, GetStaticIconContentRequest, GetStaticIconRequest, StaticIconPermissionService, iconSourceUrlFetchError, StaticIconWithContent } from '../../app.api/icons/app.api.icons'
      import { PageOf, PagingParameters, UrlResolutionError } from '../../entities/entities.global'
      import { StaticIcon, StaticIconReference, StaticIconRepository, StaticIconStoreError } from '../../entities/icons/entities.icons'
      
      export function CreateStaticIcon(permissions: StaticIconPermissionService, repo: StaticIconRepository): CreateLocalStaticIcon {
        return function(req: CreateLocalStaticIconRequest): ReturnType<CreateLocalStaticIcon> {
          return withPermission<StaticIcon, KnownErrorsOf<CreateLocalStaticIcon>>(
            permissions.ensureCreateStaticIconPermission(req.context),
            async () => {
              const reponse = await repo.createLocal(req.iconInfo, req.iconContent)
              if (reponse instanceof StaticIconStoreError) {
                return infrastructureError(reponse)
              }
      
              return reponse
            }
          )
        }
      }
      
      
      export function GetStaticIcon(permissions: StaticIconPermissionService, repo: StaticIconRepository): GetStaticIcon {
        return function getStaticIcon(req: GetStaticIconRequest): ReturnType<GetStaticIcon> {
          return withPermission<StaticIcon | null, KnownErrorsOf<GetStaticIcon>>(
            permissions.ensureGetStaticIconPermission(req.context),
            async () => {
              const ref = req.iconRef
              let parsedRef: StaticIconReference
              if (typeof ref.sourceUrl === 'string') {
                try {
                  parsedRef = { sourceUrl: new URL(ref.sourceUrl) }
                } catch (err) {
                  return invalidInput('invalid icon source url', [ `invalid url: ${ref.sourceUrl}`, 'iconRef', 'sourceUrl' ])
                }
              } else {
                parsedRef = ref as StaticIconReference
              }
              const icon = await repo.findByReference(parsedRef)
              if (icon) {
                return icon
              }
              if (parsedRef.sourceUrl) {
                return null
              }
              return entityNotFound(parsedRef.id, 'StaticIcon')
            }
          )
        }
      }
      
      export function GetStaticIconContent(permissions: StaticIconPermissionService, repo: StaticIconRepository): GetStaticIconContent {
        return function getStaticIconContent(req: GetStaticIconContentRequest): ReturnType<GetStaticIconContent> {
          return withPermission<StaticIconWithContent, KnownErrorsOf<GetStaticIconContent>>(
            permissions.ensureGetStaticIconPermission(req.context),
            async () => {
              // TODO: support caching parameters to suppress fetch/load
              const content = await repo.loadContent(req.iconId)
              if (content instanceof Error) {
                return iconSourceUrlFetchError(content, req.iconId)
              }
              if (content) {
                return {
                  iconInfo: content[0],
                  iconContent: content[1]
                }
              }
              return entityNotFound(req.iconId, 'StaticIcon')
            }
          )
        }
      }
      
      export function ListStaticIcons(permissions: StaticIconPermissionService, repo: StaticIconRepository): ListStaticIcons {
        return function findStaticIcons(req: ListStaticIconsRequest): ReturnType<ListStaticIcons> {
          return withPermission<PageOf<StaticIcon>, KnownErrorsOf<ListStaticIcons>>(
            permissions.ensureGetStaticIconPermission(req.context),
            async () => {
              const paging: PagingParameters = {
                pageSize: req.paging?.pageSize ?? 100,
                pageIndex: req.paging?.pageIndex ?? 0,
                includeTotalCount: req.paging?.includeTotalCount
              }
              return await repo.find(paging)
            }
          )
        }

    3. migrateEventData: re-read event; `forms=[form]` with `_id=formId, name=event.name, color='#5278A2', primaryField='type'`; drop fields named `timestamp`/`geometry`; first `type` field `required=false`; delete `form`; `style={fill:'#5278A2', stroke:'#5278A2', fillOpacity:0.2, strokeOpacity:1, strokeWidth:2}`; `findByIdAndUpdate(..., {overwrite:true})`.

      A[Event.find] --> B[for each event: Counter.getNext form]
      B --> C[migrateIconFiles copy/move]
      C --> D[migrateIconData Icon updates + event icon]
      D --> E[migrateEventData forms array + style]
