    ##### Processing flow
    1. **Access decision**: `middlewareAuthorizeAccess(appPerm, aclPerm)` calls `defaultEventPermissionsService.authorizeEventAccess`: granted if role has `appPerm`; else if `aclPerm==read` and user is in any of the event's teams; else if `event.acl[userId]` (string or `{role}`) is a role in `rolesWithPermission(aclPerm)` (OWNER: read/update/delete, MANAGER: read/update, GUEST: read). Denied -> 403.
    2. `determineReadAccess`: if role lacks `READ_EVENT_ALL`, set `req.access={user, permission:'read'}` which downstream causes ACL-filtered queries and ACL-trimmed output.
    3. **List**: build filter; pageSize = `page_size`||`limit`||null; page=`page`||`start`||0. `EventModel.getEvents`: complete filter (`true` or `{$ne:true}`), case-insensitive regex `term` on name/description, `teamIds $nin/$in`, `layerIds` parsed to int `$in/$nin`, `feedIds $nin/$in`. Access clause for access user AND (separately) for `userId` filter: `$or[{teamIds $in <teams containing user>},{acl.<uid> $in read roles}]` (reads `Team.Model.find({userIds:{$in:[uid]}},{_id:1}).lean()`). `countDocuments(query)` then `find(query, projection).sort({name:1,_id:1}).collation(en,strength 2,numericOrdering)`, limit/skip `start*limit`. Populate teamIds+layerIds if populate. Then each event `populateUserFields` (rebuild user-field choices from team members' displayName sorted). Response array, or `{pageSize,page,items,totalCount}` if `includePagination` truthy.
    4. **Get**: `EventModel.getById` (options.access set but `options.access.userId` never exists — see notes) then populate & populateUserFields; 404 if missing.
    5. **Create**: `api.Event.validate` (minObservationForms<=maxObservationForms; sum(form.min)<=maxObservationForms; if every form has max, minObservationForms<=sum(max); per form min<=max) -> 400 ValidationError with `errors` map. `EventModel.create`: `Counter.getNext('event')` (atomic `$inc` upsert on `counters` `_id:'event'`), `_id=id`, `collectionName='observations'+id`, `acl={<creator>:'OWNER'}`, `Event.create`; then fire-and-forget `db.createCollection(collectionName)`; then `Team.createTeamForEvent` (team name=event name, description "This team belongs specifically to event '<name>' and cannot be deleted.", teamEventId, acl creator OWNER, then `Event.addTeam`). If team creation fails the event is deleted and error returned. Finally `api.Icon(event._id).saveDefaultIconToEventForm` copies assets/default-icon.png to `<iconDir>/<eventId>/icon.png` and upserts Icon doc.
    6. **Update**: validate; `EventModel.update` whitelists keys `name, description, noGeometry, minObservationForms, maxObservationForms, complete, forms`; sets each `form._id=form.id`; `findByIdAndUpdate(..., {new:true, runValidators:true})`.
    7. **Delete**: parallel: `api.Icon(eventId).delete` (Icon docs + icon dir), `User.removeRecentEventForUsers` (`$pull recentEventIds` on all users), `api.Attachment(event).deleteAllForEvent`; then `event.deleteOne()` -> pre hook drops collection `observations<id>`; post hook deletes the event's own team (teamEventId==event._id).
    8. **Add form (JSON)**: `parseForm` clears choices of `userFields`, whitelists style keys (`fill, fillOpacity, stroke, strokeOpacity, strokeWidth`) at root, per primary choice title and per variant choice title (two levels). `EventModel.addForm`: `Counter.getNext('form')` -> `$push forms` with runValidators (at least one field, unique field names, color `^#[0-9A-F]{6}$`i). Then default icon at `<iconDir>/<eventId>/<formId>/icon.png`.
    9. **Add form (multipart)**: only if `req.is('multipart/form-data')` else `next()` falls to JSON route. `api.Form().validate(file)` -> set name/color/description -> addForm -> `api.Form(event).importIcons(file, form)` (not traced in this batch).
    10. **Update form**: `form._id=parseInt(formId)`; `EventModel.updateForm` validates via `new Form(form).validate()` then `findOneAndUpdate({'forms._id':form._id},{$set:{'forms.$':form}})` — note the filter does not include the event id.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      R[HTTP /api/events*] --> BA[bearerAuthentication]
      BA --> P{app.param eventId}
      P -->|bad id| E400[400]
      P -->|missing| E404[404]
      P --> MA[middlewareAuthorizeAccess -> EventPermissionServiceImpl.authorizeEventAccess]
      MA -->|denied| E403[403]
      MA --> DRA[determineReadAccess]
      DRA --> H{route}
      H -->|POST /api/events| V[api.Event.validate] --> C[EventModel.create: Counter.getNext event -> Event.create -> createCollection observationsN -> Team.createTeamForEvent] --> I[api.Icon.saveDefaultIconToEventForm]
      H -->|GET list| GE[EventModel.getEvents: Team.Model.find + countDocuments + find] --> PUF[api.Form.populateUserFields]
      H -->|PUT| U[EventModel.update findByIdAndUpdate]
      H -->|DELETE| D[Icon.delete + User.removeRecentEventForUsers + Attachment.deleteAllForEvent] --> DO[event.deleteOne: dropCollection + delete event team]
      H -->|POST forms| F[parseForm -> EventModel.addForm Counter form $push] --> I2[default icon + populateUserFields]
      H -->|PUT forms/:formId| UF[EventModel.updateForm forms.$ set]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    - `events` (model `Event`): `_id:Number`, `name` unique, `description`, `complete`, `collectionName`, `teamIds[ObjectId->Team]`, `layerIds[Number->Layer]`, `feedIds[String]`, `forms[Form]`, `observationSearchStatus enum pending|running|indexed`, `style` (default fill/stroke `#5278A2`, fillOpacity .2, strokeOpacity 1, strokeWidth 2), `acl{userId:role}`; options autoIndex false, minimize false, no versionKey. Form: `_id:Number, name, description, default, min>=0, max>=0, color, archived, primaryField, variantField, primaryFeedField, secondaryFeedField, userFields[], fields[Field], style Mixed`. Field: `id, archived, title, type enum(attachment,textfield,numberfield,email,password,radio,dropdown,multiselectdropdown,date,geometry,textarea,checkbox,hidden), value, name, required, choices[{id,title,value,blank}], maxRecent=5, allowedAttachmentTypes[image|video|audio], min, max, pattern{spec,description,examples}`.
    - `counters` (`_id:'event'|'form'`, `sequence`).
    - Dynamic collection `observations<eventId>` created/dropped.
    - `teams`, `users.recentEventIds`, `icons`, icon files under `MAGE_ICON_DIR` (default /var/lib/mage/icons).
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    JSON event via `toObject/toJSON` transform: `_id`->`id`, `collectionName` removed, populated `teamIds`->`teams`, `layerIds`->`layers`; when `access` present and the user's ACL role is not OWNER/MANAGER, `acl` reduced to the caller's entry; each acl entry becomes `{role, permissions}`; projection applied post-query via `whitelist.project` (always keeps id). Duplicate name (11000/11001) converted to ValidationError `{name:{type:'unique',message:'Duplicate event name'}}`.
    
    ##### External calls
    MongoDB via Mongoose; filesystem (icon copy); `api.Form.export/importIcons/validate`, `api.Attachment.deleteAllForEvent` (outside batch, not traced).
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - `getById` checks `options.access.userId`, but routes pass `{user, permission}` — the per-user filter in `getById` is effectively dead; access is enforced only by middleware.
    - `getEvents` with `teamId` uses `$in: filter.teamId` (a string, not an array) — likely a query error/oddity; `layerId` is wrapped in array.

    - Two POST /forms handlers: multipart route calls `next()` for non-multipart to reach JSON route.
    - `EventSchema.pre('init')` calls populateUserFields asynchronously on every loaded doc (result not awaited).
    - `api.Event.validate` builds `formErrors` but never populates it (dead).

    ##### Entry point
    `EventRoutes(app, security)` (`export = EventRoutes`) in `service/src/routes/events.ts`, loaded by `routes/index.js`. All routes use `security.authentication.bearerAuthentication`.
    
    | Method | Path | Authorization | Calls |
    |---|---|---|---|
    | POST | /api/events | access.authorize(CREATE_EVENT) | api.Event.createEvent(body, user) -> 201 |
    | GET | /api/events | determineReadAccess | EventModel.getEvents + api.Form.populateUserFields |
    | GET | /api/events/count | determineReadAccess | EventModel.count({access}) |
    | GET | /api/events/:eventId | READ_EVENT_ALL or ACL read; determineReadAccess | EventModel.getById + populateUserFields |
    | PUT | /api/events/:eventId | UPDATE_EVENT or ACL update | api.Event.updateEvent |
    | DELETE | /api/events/:eventId | DELETE_EVENT or ACL delete (OWNER only) | api.Event.deleteEvent -> 204 |
    | POST | /api/events/:eventId/forms (multipart `form` file) | UPDATE_EVENT/update | api.Form.validate -> api.Event.addForm -> api.Form.importIcons -> 201 |
    | POST | /api/events/:eventId/forms (JSON) | UPDATE_EVENT/update | parseForm -> api.Event.addForm -> parallel(api.Icon.saveDefaultIconToEventForm, populateUserFields) -> 201 |
    | PUT | /api/events/:eventId/forms/:formId | UPDATE_EVENT/update | parseForm -> api.Event.updateForm -> populateUserFields |
    | GET | /api/events/:eventId/:formId/form.zip | READ_EVENT_ALL/read (line ~421) | api.Form.export(parseInt(formId)) -> attachment `<event>-<form>-form.zip` |
    | GET | /api/events/:eventId/form/icons.zip | READ_EVENT_ALL/read | api.Icon.getZipPath -> sendFile then fs.remove temp zip |
    | GET | /api/events/:eventId/form/icons* | READ_EVENT_ALL/read | sendFile(api.Icon.defaultIconPath) |
    | GET | /api/events/:eventId/icons/:formId.json | READ_EVENT_ALL/read | api.Icon.getIcons -> read each file -> base64 data URLs |
    | POST | /api/events/:eventId/icons/:formId?/:primary?/:variant? (multipart `icon`) | UPDATE_EVENT/update | api.Icon.create(req.file) |
    | GET | /api/events/:eventId/icons/:formId?/:primary?/:variant? | READ_EVENT_ALL/read | api.Icon.getIcon; content negotiation image/* vs application/json |
    | DELETE | same | UPDATE_EVENT/update | api.Icon.delete -> 204 |
    | POST | /api/events/:eventId/layers | UPDATE_EVENT/update | EventModel.addLayer(event, body) |
    | DELETE | /api/events/:eventId/layers/:id | UPDATE_EVENT/update | EventModel.removeLayer(event, {id}) |
    | GET | /api/events/:eventId/users | READ_EVENT_ALL/read; determineReadAccess | EventModel.getUsers -> userTransformer |
    | POST | /api/events/:eventId/teams | UPDATE_EVENT/update | EventModel.addTeam + audit log 'team added to event' |
    | DELETE | /api/events/:eventId/teams/:teamId | UPDATE_EVENT/update | EventModel.removeTeam + audit log 'team removed from event' |
    | GET | /api/events/:id/members, /api/events/:id/nonMembers | determineReadAccess only | EventModel.getMembers/getNonMembers(parseInt(id), {access, searchTerm: term, pageSize: page_size||2, pageIndex: page||0, includeTotalCount}) |
    | GET | /api/events/:eventId/teams, /nonTeams | READ_EVENT_ALL/read | EventModel.getTeamsInEvent/getTeamsNotInEvent(teamQueryOptionsFromRequest) |
    
    ##### Inputs
    - Query for GET /api/events: `projection` (JSON string), `state` (absent/'active' -> complete=false; 'complete' -> true; any other value -> no filter), `userId`, `populate` ('false' disables), `teamId`, `excludeTeamId`, `feedId`, `excludeFeedId`, `term`, `layerId`, `excludeLayerId`, `page_size`/`limit`, `page`/`start`, `includePagination`.
    - Form JSON body `FormJson {fields[{name, choices[{title}]}], primaryField, variantField, userFields[], style}`.
    - Team query options: `term`, `omit_event_teams`, `page_size`, `page`, `total`, `populate` (comma list). If either page_size or page given, defaults pageSize 10/pageIndex 0.
    
    ##### Processing flow
    - `determineReadAccess`: if user lacks `READ_EVENT_ALL`, sets `req.access = {user, permission:'read'}` which downstream models use to restrict results.
    - `middlewareAuthorizeAccess(collectionPerm, aclPerm)`: `defaultEventPermissionsService.authorizeEventAccess(req.event, req.user, ...)` -> 403 when denied.
    - `clearUserFieldChoicesFromFormJson`: for each field named in `userFields`, empties `choices` (populated dynamically later by `api.Form.populateUserFields`). `parseEventQueryParams` also runs this on `req.body.form` (no effect on GETs).
    - `parseForm`: if `form.style`, whitelists style keys via `reduceStyle` (`fill, fillOpacity, stroke, strokeOpacity, strokeWidth`) at top level, per primary-choice title, and per primary->variant choice title; other keys dropped.
    - Multipart forms POST: first handler only runs when `req.is('multipart/form-data')`, else `next()` falls through to the JSON POST handler registered for the same path.
    - `EventModel.getEvents` (models/event.js ~L330-430): builds query from filter (complete, case-insensitive regex on name/description from `term`, teamIds $in/$nin, layerIds (parseInt) $in/$nin, feedIds $in/$nin). For `options.access.user` and for `filter.userId`, `buildAccessClause` finds `Team.Model.find({userIds:{$in:[userId]}},{_id:1}).lean()` and adds `$or: [{teamIds:{$in:teamIds}}, {['acl.'+userId]: {$in: ['OWNER','MANAGER','GUEST']}}]` to `$and`. Then `countDocuments` for totalCount, `find(query, projection).sort({name:1,_id:1}).collation({locale:'en', strength:2, numericOrdering:true})`, optional `limit/skip(start*limit)`, optional populate `teamIds`,`layerIds`. When projection given, `acl` and `teamIds` are force-included.
    - GET list response: if `includePagination` -> `{pageSize, page, items, totalCount}`, else array; each `event.toObject({access, projection})`.
    - `EventModel.count` with access: `$or` of `acl.<userId> = role` for read roles (does NOT consider team membership, unlike getEvents).
    - Icons JSON: reads each icon file, detects mime with `magic-bytes.js filetypeinfo`; if undetected `icon` is undefined (list) or `data:undefined;base64,...` (single).
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[HTTP /api/events*] --> P[app.param eventId -> Event.getById]
      P --> B[bearerAuthentication]
      B --> C{route}
      C -->|list| L1[determineReadAccess] --> L2[parseEventQueryParams] --> L3[EventModel.getEvents buildAccessClause Team.Model.find] --> L4[api.Form.populateUserFields each] --> L5[toObject access projection]
      C -->|item mutate| M1[middlewareAuthorizeAccess -> EventPermissionServiceImpl.authorizeEventAccess]
      M1 --> M2[api.Event create/update/delete/addForm/updateForm]
      C -->|forms POST multipart| F1[upload.single form] --> F2[api.Form.validate] --> F3[api.Event.addForm] --> F4[api.Form.importIcons]
      C -->|forms POST json| J1[parseForm reduceStyle] --> J2[api.Event.addForm] --> J3[api.Icon.saveDefaultIconToEventForm + populateUserFields]
      C -->|icons| I1[api.Icon getIcon/getIcons/create/delete/getZipPath] --> I2[fs.readFile base64 / sendFile / fs.remove temp zip]
      C -->|teams/layers| T1[EventModel.addTeam/removeTeam/addLayer/removeLayer] --> T2[log.info audit]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    `events` collection (fields: `_id` numeric, name, description, complete, teamIds, layerIds, feedIds, acl {userId: role}, forms[] with numeric `_id`, collectionName), `teams` (userIds, acl), `icons` + icon files under `iconBaseDirectory` (fs reads at L470/L535), temp zip from `api.Icon.getZipPath` deleted after response, forms zip stream from `api.Form.export`, `users`.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    Event/form/icon JSON, file downloads (form zip, icons zip, PNGs), 201/204 statuses, structured audit logs for team add/remove (`team, event, addedBy/removedBy, *Time`). Creating/deleting events and forms cascades through `api.Event` (not traced here — outside batch).
    
    ##### External calls
    `api.Event`, `api.Form`, `api.Icon`, `EventModel.*` (models/event.js), `userTransformer`, `defaultEventPermissionsService`, `access.authorize`, `upload` (multer `defaultHandler`). Internals of api.Event/api.Form/api.Icon are outside this batch and not traced.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - `/api/events/:id/members|nonMembers` use `:id` (not `:eventId`) so no event pre-load, no numeric validation, and only `determineReadAccess` — no per-event 403; default page size is 2.
    - `/form/icons*` ignores the event and returns the global default icon.
    - `GET icons/:formId.json` on error calls `next()` without error (falls to 404).
    - Count endpoint uses ACL only, list uses ACL OR team membership — counts can disagree with lists.
    - `pageSize` fallback chain `page_size || limit`, page `page || start`; skip = start*limit.
    - Event `state` values other than active/complete return all events.
    - Event POST passes body straight to the model (per TODO, no sanitization).

      exports.create = function (event, user, callback) {
        async.waterfall([
          function (done) {
            Counter.getNext('event')
              .then(id => done(null, id))
              .catch(err => done(err));
          },
          function (id, done) {
            event._id = id;
            event.collectionName = 'observations' + id;
      
            event.acl = {};
            event.acl[user._id.toString()] = 'OWNER';
      
            Event.create(event).then(
              newEvent => {
                createObservationCollection(newEvent);
                done(null, newEvent);
              },
              err => done(err)
            );
          },
          function (event, done) {
            Team.createTeamForEvent(event, user, function (err) {
              if (err) {
                // could not create the team for this event, remove the event and error out
                event.deleteOne().then(function () {
                  done(err);
                });
              }
              done(err, event);
            });
          }
        ], function (err, newEvent) {
          if (err) {
            return callback(err);
          }
          callback(err, newEvent);
        });
      };

    Commentary: getEvents filter/access query builder
    Code:
      exports.getEvents = async function (options, callback) {
        if (typeof options === 'function') {
          callback = options;
          options = {};
        }
      
        const query = {};
        const filter = options.filter || {};
        if (filter.complete === true) query.complete = true;
        if (filter.complete === false) query.complete = { $ne: true };
        if (filter.searchTerm) {
          const searchRegex = new RegExp(filter.searchTerm, 'i');
          query['$or'] = [
            { name: searchRegex },
            { description: searchRegex }
          ];
        }
        if (filter.excludeTeamId != null) {
          query.teamIds = { $nin: [filter.excludeTeamId] };
        }
        if (filter.teamId != null) {
          query.teamIds = { ...query.teamIds, $in: filter.teamId };
        }
        if (filter.layerId != null) {
          const layerIdNum = typeof filter.layerId === 'string' ? parseInt(filter.layerId) : filter.layerId;
          query.layerIds = { ...query.layerIds, $in: [layerIdNum] };
        }
        if (filter.excludeLayerId != null) {
          const excludeLayerIdNum = typeof filter.excludeLayerId === 'string' ? parseInt(filter.excludeLayerId) : filter.excludeLayerId;
          query.layerIds = { ...query.layerIds, $nin: [excludeLayerIdNum] };
        }
        if (filter.excludeFeedId != null) {
          query.feedIds = { $nin: [filter.excludeFeedId] };
        }
        if (filter.feedId != null) {
          query.feedIds = { ...query.feedIds, $in: [filter.feedId] };
        }
      
        let projection = {};
        if (options.projection) {
          projection = convertProjection(options.projection);
      
          // Need these to check event access
          projection.acl = true;
          projection.teamIds = true;
        }
      
        try {
          const andClauses = [];
      
          const buildAccessClause = async (userId) => {
            if (!userId) return null;
      
            const teamDocs = await Team.Model.find({ userIds: { $in: [userId] } }, { _id: 1 }).lean();
            const teamIdsForUser = teamDocs.map(t => t._id);
            const readRoles = rolesWithPermission('read');
            const aclKey = `acl.${userId.toString()}`;
            return {
              $or: [
                { teamIds: { $in: teamIdsForUser } },
                { [aclKey]: { $in: readRoles } }
              ]
            };
          };
      
          const accessUserId = options && options.access && options.access.user ? options.access.user._id : null;
          const filterUserId = filter && filter.userId ? filter.userId : null;
      
          const [accessClause, filterClause] = await Promise.all([
            buildAccessClause(accessUserId),
            buildAccessClause(filterUserId)
          ]);
      
          if (accessClause) andClauses.push(accessClause);
          if (filterClause) andClauses.push(filterClause);
          if (andClauses.length) {
            if (query.$and) {
              query.$and = query.$and.concat(andClauses);
            } else {
              query.$and = andClauses;
            }
          }
        } catch (err) {
          return callback(err);
        }
      
        const totalCount = await Event.countDocuments(query).exec();
      
        let findQuery = Event.find(query, projection)
          .sort({ name: 1, _id: 1 })
          .collation({ locale: 'en', strength: 2, numericOrdering: true });
      
        if (options.limit != null) {
          findQuery = findQuery.limit(options.limit).skip(options.start * options.limit || 0);
        }
      
        findQuery.exec().then(
          events => {
            if (options.populate) {
              Event.populate(events, [{ path: 'teamIds' }, { path: 'layerIds' }]).then(
                events => callback(null, events, totalCount),
                err => callback(err)
              );
            } else {
              callback(null, events, totalCount);
            }
          },
          err => callback(err)
        );
      };
  Snippet: service/src/api/event.js:121-157
    Commentary: deleteEvent cascade

      Event.prototype.deleteEvent = async function(callback) {
        const event = this._event
        console.info(`deleting event ${event.name} (id ${event._id}) ...`)
        const parallelPromise = util.promisify(async.parallel)
        try {
          await parallelPromise({
            icons: function(done) {
              new api.Icon(event._id).delete(function(err) {
                done(err);
              });
            },
            recentEventIds: function(done) {
              User.removeRecentEventForUsers(event, function(err) {
                done(err);
              });
            },
            attachments: function(done) {
              new api.Attachment(event).deleteAllForEvent(function(err) {
                console.info(`finished deleting attachments for event ${event.name} (id ${event._id})`);
                done(err);
              });
            }
          })
        }
        catch (err) {
          console.error(`error deleting referenced resources of event ${event.name} (id ${event._id})`, err);
          return void(callback(err));
        }
        try {
          await event.deleteOne();
        }
        catch (err) {
          console.error(`error deleting event ${event.name} (id ${event._id})`, err);
          return void(callback(err));
        }
        callback()
      };

    Commentary: best-match icon query and upsert returning old doc
    Code:
      exports.getIcon = function (options, callback) {
        var primary = options.primary;
        var variant = options.variant;
      
        var condition = {
          eventId: options.eventId,
          formId: options.formId,
          primary: { "$in": [primary, null] }
        };
      
        if (isNaN(variant)) {
          condition.variant = { "$in": [variant, null] };
        } else {
          condition["$or"] = [{ variant: { "$lte": variant } }, { variant: null }];
        }
      
        Icon.findOne(condition, {}, { sort: { primary: -1, variant: -1 } }).then(
          icon => callback(null, icon),
          err => callback(err)
        );
      };
      
      exports.create = function (icon, callback) {
        var conditions = {
          eventId: icon.eventId,
          formId: icon.formId,
          primary: icon.primary,
          variant: icon.variant
        };
        Icon.findOneAndUpdate(conditions, icon, { upsert: true, new: false }).then(
          oldIcon => callback(null, oldIcon),
          err => callback(err)
        );
      };

    Commentary: account lockout logic
    Code:
      exports.invalidLogin = async function (user) {
        const local = await AuthenticationConfiguration.getConfiguration('local', 'local');
        const { accountLock = {} } = local.settings;
      
        if (!accountLock.enabled) return user;
      
        const authentication = user.authentication;
        const invalidLoginAttempts = authentication.security.invalidLoginAttempts + 1;
        if (invalidLoginAttempts >= accountLock.threshold) {
          const numberOfTimesLocked = authentication.security.numberOfTimesLocked + 1;
          if (numberOfTimesLocked >= accountLock.max) {
            user.enabled = false;
            await user.save();
      
            authentication.security = {};
      
            log.warn('user account disabled after exceeding maximum account lockouts', {
              user: user.username,
              userId: user._id.toString(),
              invalidLoginAttempts,
              numberOfTimesLocked,
              disabledTime: new Date().toISOString()
            });
          } else {
            authentication.security = {
              locked: true,
              numberOfTimesLocked: numberOfTimesLocked,
              lockedUntil: moment().add(accountLock.interval, 'seconds').toDate()
            };
      
            log.warn('user account locked after invalid login attempts', {
              user: user.username,
              userId: user._id.toString(),
              invalidLoginAttempts,
              numberOfTimesLocked,
              lockedUntil: authentication.security.lockedUntil.toISOString()
            });
          }
        } else {
          authentication.security.invalidLoginAttempts = invalidLoginAttempts;
          authentication.security.locked = undefined;
          authentication.security.lockedUntil = undefined;
        }
      
        await authentication.save();
      };

    Commentary: ObjectId-based date paging
    Code:
      exports.getLogins = function (options, callback) {
        var conditions = {};
        var filter = options.filter || {};
      
        if (filter.userId) {
          conditions.userId = filter.userId;
        }
      
        if (filter.deviceId) {
          conditions.deviceId = filter.deviceId;
        }
      
        if (filter.startDate) {
          conditions._id = { $gte: objectIdForDate(filter.startDate) };
        }
        if (filter.endDate) {
          conditions._id = conditions._id || {};
          conditions._id.$lte = objectIdForDate(filter.endDate);
        }
      
        if (options.lastLoginId) {
          conditions._id = conditions._id || {};
          conditions._id.$lt = new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(options.lastLoginId);
        }
      
        if (options.firstLoginId) {
          conditions._id = conditions._id || {};
          conditions._id.$gt = new mongoose.Types.ObjectId(options.firstLoginId);
        }
      
        var o = {
          limit: options.limit || 10,
          sort: {
            _id: options.firstLoginId ? 1 : -1
          }
        };
      
        Login.find(conditions, null, o).populate([{ path: 'userId' }, { path: 'deviceId' }]).exec().then(
          logins => {
            if (!logins) return callback(null, logins);
            callback(null, options.firstLoginId ? logins.reverse() : logins);
          },
          err => callback(err)
        );
      };

  Description: ##### Entry point
    `POST /auth/token` in authentication/index.js: `authorize` -> `provisionDevice` -> `provision.check(type, name)` where type/name come from `req.user.authentication.authenticationConfiguration`.
    
    ##### Inputs
    Request params (`req.param`): `uid`, `name`, `description`, `appVersion`; query `createDevice`; header `user-agent`; `req.user`.
    
    ##### Processing flow
    1. At module load, every module in provision/ (uid.js, none.js; index.d.ts and `strategies/` dir excluded) is required and registered via `provision.use` keyed by strategy name ('uid', 'none').
    2. `check()` middleware: `AuthenticationConfiguration.getConfiguration(type,name)`; `settings.devicesReqAdmin.enabled !== false` -> strategy 'uid', else 'none'.
    3. **uid**: missing uid -> error 'Missing uid' (next(err)). `Device.getDeviceByUid`: not found and `createDevice==='false'` -> false + message 'Device ID is invalid...'; not found -> create `{uid,name,registered:false,description,userAgent,appVersion,userId}` then deny (false); found unregistered -> deny 'Your device has been registered. An administrator has been notified to approve this device.'; registered -> device.
    4. **none**: no uid -> `{registered:true}` pseudo-device; not found -> create registered:true; found unregistered -> set registered true & `updateDevice`; else device.
    5. Back in check: err -> next(err); `req.provisionedDevice=device`; `!device || !device.registered` -> 403 with `info.message`; else next (login issues token).
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      T[POST /auth/token] --> A[authorize passport] --> PC[provision.check]
      PC --> AC[AuthenticationConfiguration.getConfiguration]
      AC --> S{devicesReqAdmin.enabled !== false}
      S -->|yes| U[uid strategy Device.getDeviceByUid]
      S -->|no| N[none strategy auto-register]
      U --> R{registered?}
      N --> R
      R -->|no| E403[403 info.message]
      R -->|yes| OK[req.provisionedDevice -> api.User.login]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    `devices` (read/create/update), `authenticationconfigurations` (read). `Setting` is imported but unused.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    May create device records; 403 on unregistered devices.
    
    ##### External calls
    None.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - If strategy missing, `next(err)` is called but execution continues to `provision.check` on undefined (would throw).
    - none strategy `updateDevice` promise has no catch.
    - Default (no devicesReqAdmin setting) is 'uid' (admin approval required).
    - Double semicolon / unused `Setting` import harmless.
  Recommendation: Documented; Device model internals belong to another batch.

  Snippet: service/src/provision/index.js:26-51
    Commentary: strategy selection and 403 gate
    Code:
      Provision.prototype.check = function (type, name, options) {
        options = options || {};
      
        const strategies = this.strategies;
      
        return function (req, res, next) {
          AuthenticationConfiguration.getConfiguration(type, name).then(authConfig => {
            const localDeviceSettings = authConfig.settings.devicesReqAdmin || {};
            const strategy = localDeviceSettings.enabled !== false ? 'uid' : 'none';
      
            const provision = strategies[strategy];
            if (!provision) next(new Error('No registered provisioning strategy "' + strategy + '"'));
      
            provision.check(req, options, function (err, device, info = {}) {
              if (err) return next(err);
      
              req.provisionedDevice = device;
      
              if (!device || !device.registered) return res.status(403).send(info.message);
      
              next();
            });
          }).catch(err => {
            next(err);;
          });
        };

  Description: ##### Entry point
    `startAttachmentProcessing(obsRepoForEvent, attachmentStore, attachmentHooks, console, config?)` called from app.ts boot (line 377) after plugin hooks collected. Returns `{stop()}` (not retained by boot).
    
    ##### Inputs
    - Config defaults: `intervalSeconds 15, batchSize 20, retryLimit 3` (boot passes none).
    - `attachmentHooks: AttachmentHook[]` — `(content, stagedFilePath) => Promise<{outcome:'pass'|'reject'|'error', reason?, error?}>` contributed by plugins.
    - Pending references from `findPendingAttachments(limit)` (adapters.observations.db.mongoose.ts 414): reads all `events` docs `{_id, collectionName}`; for each event's observation collection runs aggregation `$match attachments.processingStatus:'pending'` → `$project {_id, attachments}` → `$unwind attachments` → `$match pending` → `$project {observationId:$_id, attachmentId:$attachments._id}` → `$limit remaining`; returns `{eventId, observationId, attachmentId}` until limit reached.
    
    ##### Processing flow
    `processNextBatch`: if stopped return; fetch references; process each sequentially (break if stopped); errors logged; re-arm `setTimeout(15 s)`.
    `processPendingAttachment`:
    1. `obsRepoForEvent(eventId)` → `findById(observationId)`; missing → warn, return.
    2. `observation.attachmentFor(attachmentId)`; missing or no `stagedContentId` → warn, return.
    3. `attachmentStore.stagedContentPath(stagedContentId)` = `<attachmentBase>/pending/<stagedContentId>`; AttachmentStoreError → log, return.
    4. `runPipeline(hooks, attachment, stagedPath)`: hooks in order; first `reject`/`error` (or thrown exception → error) returns with `hookName = hook.name`; all pass → `pass`.
    5. pass → `attachmentStore.saveContent(StagedAttachmentContentRef(id), attachment.id, observation)`: rename staged file to `<attachmentBase>/<relativeWritePathForAttachment>` (mkdir -p; refuses paths outside base), stat size; returns `{contentLocator, size}` if changed else null; error → log, return (status stays pending). Patch `{...finalized, processingStatus:'success', stagedContentId:undefined}`.
    6. reject → `deleteStagedContent`, patch `{processingStatus:'rejected', processingMessage:reason, processingHook, stagedContentId:undefined}`.
    7. error → `retryCount = (processingRetryCount||0)+1`; if `< retryLimit` patch `{processingStatus:'pending', processingMessage, processingHook, processingRetryCount}`; else delete staged content and patch `{processingStatus:'error', ..., processingRetryCount, stagedContentId:undefined}`.
    8. Any unexpected exception logged; attachment untouched.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      T[setTimeout 15s] --> F[findPendingAttachments 20]
      F --> L[for each reference]
      L --> O[obsRepoForEvent.findById]
      O -- none --> W[warn skip]
      O --> A{attachment && stagedContentId}
      A -- no --> W
      A --> P[stagedContentPath pending/id]
      P --> RP[runPipeline hooks]
      RP -- pass --> S[attachmentStore.saveContent rename] --> PS[patch success]
      RP -- reject --> D1[deleteStagedContent] --> PR[patch rejected]
      RP -- error --> RC{retryCount < 3}
      RC -- yes --> PP[patch pending + retryCount]
      RC -- no --> D2[deleteStagedContent] --> PE[patch error]
      PS --> T
      PR --> T
      PP --> T
      PE --> T
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    - Read: `events` (all), per-event observation collections (`collectionName`), attachments subdocs.
    - Write: attachment fields `processingStatus` ('pending'|'success'|'rejected'|'error'), `processingMessage`, `processingHook`, `processingRetryCount`, `stagedContentId`, `contentLocator`, `size`.
    - Files: `<MAGE_ATTACHMENT_DIR>/pending/<stagedContentId>` (read by hooks, renamed or deleted), final file under MAGE_ATTACHMENT_DIR.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    Attachment content becomes available only after `success`.
    
    ##### External calls
    Plugin attachment hooks (e.g. content scanning) with `(attachment, stagedFilePath)`.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - With zero hooks every pending attachment passes immediately.
    - Retry is per cycle (15 s), so 3 attempts ≈ 30 s; retryCount stored only on error path.
    - saveContent/patch failures leave status pending forever with no retry counter increment (infinite retry).
    - deleteStagedContent return value (error) ignored.
    - Scan iterates events in natural order and stops at batchSize — later events can starve if earlier ones keep failing.
    - `stop()` handle discarded by boot: no graceful shutdown.
    - `initializeAttachmentStore` mkdir error for `pending/` is caught and returned inside `.catch`, but the result is ignored, so the store is constructed anyway.
  Recommendation: Not traced: obsRepo.patchAttachment persistence details and storeAttachmentContent (the staging step) are in other batches.

  Description: ##### Entry point
    Module `service/src/express.ts` (exports `{app, auth}`), consumed by app.ts initWebLayer.
    
    ##### Inputs
    All HTTP requests; env `MAGE_HTTP_DEBUG`, `httpRequestLogMethods`.
    
    ##### Processing flow (middleware order)
    1. Adds `req.getRoot()` = `protocol://host` and `req.getPath()`; if `MAGE_HTTP_DEBUG==='true'` console.debug method/path/raw headers.
    2. `trust proxy` enabled (protocol/host/ip from X-Forwarded-*).
    3. Views: pug from `views/`.
    4. `express.json` and `urlencoded(extended)` with `limit:'16mb', strict:false`.
    5. `passport.initialize()`.
    6. `httpRequestLogging` for configured methods.
    7. `GET /api/docs/openapi.yaml`: read `docs/openapi.yaml`, parse YAML, set `servers=[{url: req.getRoot()}]`, respond `text/yaml`.
    8. `app.use('/api/docs', static docs/)` (unauthenticated).
    9. `AuthenticationInitializer.initialize(app, passport, provision)` (registers /auth/* routes).
    10. `app.use('/private', bearerAuthentication, static private/)`.
    11. `routes/index.js`: requires every module in `routes/` (via `modulesPathsInDir`), each must export a factory `(app, {authentication})` else throws; registers `app.param` loaders: `eventId` must match `^[0-9]+$` else 400 'Invalid event ID in request path', `Event.getById` → 404 'Event not found', sets `req.event`; `userId` must be 24-hex else 400, 404 'User not found', sets `req.userParam`; (more params beyond line 40 not in this batch).
    12. Error handler: status = err.status||500; 500 → 'Internal server error, please contact MAGE administrator.'; `ValidationError` → 400 JSON `{message, errors}`; else send `err.message`.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      R[request] --> G[getRoot/getPath + MAGE_HTTP_DEBUG]
      G --> P[json/urlencoded 16mb]
      P --> PI[passport.initialize]
      PI --> L[httpRequestLogging]
      L --> D{/api/docs/openapi.yaml?}
      D -- yes --> Y[fs.readFile + set servers]
      D -- no --> S[/api/docs static]
      S --> AU[auth routes /auth/*]
      AU --> PR[/private bearer + static]
      PR --> RT[routes/* factories + app.param eventId,userId]
      RT --> EH[error handler]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Reads files `dist/docs/openapi.yaml`, `docs/`, `private/`; `events`, `users` via param loaders.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    HTTP responses; logs.
    
    ##### External calls
    None.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - openapi.yaml handler ignores read error (`contents` undefined → throw inside callback, crashes request/possibly process).
    - Error-handler order: ValidationError check happens after msg computation, so a ValidationError always returns 400 regardless of status.
    - Route load order follows directory listing; `app.param` registered after routes but Express applies it at request time.
    - `strict:false` JSON parsing accepts primitives as bodies.

  Description: ##### Entry point
    `initialize(strategy)` called from authentication/index.js for every AuthenticationConfiguration with `type === 'openidconnect'`. Registers `GET /auth/<strategy.name>/signin` and `GET /auth/<strategy.name>/callback`, both behind an `express-session` middleware with a random per-process secret.
    
    ##### Inputs
    - Config `strategy.settings`: clientID, clientSecret, issuer, authorizationURL, tokenURL, profileURL (userInfo), scope[], profile{id, displayName, email} claim names. Defaults set by `setDefaults`: scope gains 'openid'; profile.displayName='name', email='email', id='sub'.
    - signin query `state` (e.g. 'mobile').
    
    ##### Processing flow
    1. signin: `passport.authenticate(name, {scope, state: req.query.state})` → redirect to IdP.
    2. callback verify: `profileId = uiProfile._json[profile.id]`; missing → error. `User.getUserByAuthenticationStrategy(strategy.type, profileId)`.
       - none: `Role.getRole('USER_ROLE')`, `api.User().create({username:profileId, displayName (claim or profileId), email, active:false, roleId, authentication:{type:name, id:profileId, authenticationConfiguration:{name}}})`; if new user's config not enabled → fail with message; else done(newUser).
       - existing inactive → done(user, message not approved); config disabled → done(user, message); else done(user).
    3. `authenticate`: sets `req.query.state = info.state` (workaround), `req.user`. If `!active || !enabled`, or no `authenticationConfigurationId`, or config disabled → log warn and `next()` with no token. Else generate JWT (assertion authorized, 300 s) into `req.token`.
    4. Final handler: state==='mobile' → redirect `mage://app/invalid_account?active=..&enabled=..` if inactive/disabled else `mage://app/authentication?token=<jwt>`; otherwise render pug view `authentication` `{success:true, login:{token, user}}`.
    5. Error handler: mobile → redirect `mage://app/error_account`; web → render `authentication` `{success:false, login:{}}`.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      S[GET /auth/name/signin] --> IdP[IdP authorize redirect]
      IdP --> C[GET /auth/name/callback]
      C --> V[verify: profileId from claim]
      V -- missing --> ERR
      V --> U{User.getUserByAuthenticationStrategy}
      U -- none --> N[Role USER_ROLE + api.User.create active=false]
      U -- found --> A[authenticate]
      N --> A
      A --> Q{active && enabled && configId && config.enabled}
      Q -- no --> R[no token]
      Q -- yes --> T[generateToken 300s]
      R --> M{state==mobile}
      T --> M
      M -- yes --> MR[redirect mage://app/...]
      M -- no --> W[render authentication view]
      ERR[error handler] --> M2{mobile?} -- yes --> E1[mage://app/error_account]
      M2 -- no --> E2[render success=false]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Read `users`, `authentications`, `roles`, `authenticationconfigurations`; write new `users`/`authentications` on first login.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    Redirects to `mage://` custom scheme for mobile; HTML page for web. New OIDC users are created inactive (admin approval needed).
    
    ##### External calls
    OIDC provider authorization, token and userinfo endpoints via passport-openidconnect.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - `configure` runs before `setDefaults`, but the strategy object is shared by reference so defaults apply at request time; `callbackURL` is relative.
    - Lookup uses `strategy.type` but created user's authentication.type is `strategy.name`.
    - Inactive users reaching web callback still get `success:true` render with undefined token.
    - If verify returns `false` user (config disabled for new user), `authenticate` dereferences `user.active` on false → TypeError → error handler.
    - Session secret random per process; multi-instance needs sticky sessions.
  Recommendation: Documented. Behaviour of passport-openidconnect state handling and the 'authentication' pug view are external; api.User().create is in another batch.

- sfind-3a72e1b4981f48839371e95ed82aad61: POST /auth/local/signin — local username/password login with lockout, issuing 5-minute authorization JWT [high/open] repo: COG-GTM/NGA-mage-server, scan: scan-297683f5856041e28b46cf6ff133ab19 created 2026-11-05 17:33:08 UTC, category: api-endpoint
  Description: ##### Entry point
    `initialize()` in service/src/authentication/local.js, called unconditionally from authentication/index.js (line 150) and possibly also via the config-driven loop. Registers `POST /auth/local/signin`.
    
    ##### Inputs
    Form/JSON body `username`, `password` (passport-local defaults); headers `user-agent`; `req.ip`.
    
    ##### Processing flow
    1. passport-local verify: `User.getUserByUsername(username)`; error → 500.
    2. Ordered checks, each → `failedLogin(reason, message)` (warn log with username, reason, ip, userAgent, attemptTime) → 401 with message:
       - no user: 'Please check your username and password and try again.'
       - `!user.active`: 'User account is not approved...'
       - `!user.enabled`: 'Your account has been disabled...'
       - `security.locked && now < lockedUntil`: 'Your account has been temporarily locked...' (meta lockedUntil ISO)
       - authentication not `Authentication.Local` discriminator: 'You do not have a local account...'
       - `authenticationConfiguration.enabled` false: 'Authentication method is not enabled...'
    3. `authentication.validatePassword(password)` (pbkdf2 `hasher.validPassword`).
       - valid → `User.validLogin(user)`: set `authentication.security = {}` and save (clears lock and counters).
       - invalid → `User.invalidLogin(user)`: load local config `accountLock {enabled, threshold, max, interval}`; if not enabled return; attempts+1; if attempts >= threshold: timesLocked+1; if timesLocked >= max → `user.enabled=false`, save user, `security = {}`; else `security = {locked:true, numberOfTimesLocked, lockedUntil: now+interval s}`; else store attempts and clear locked/lockedUntil. Save authentication. Then 401 'Please check your username and password...'.
    4. On success: `tokenService.generateToken(user._id, 'urn:mage:auth:authorized', 300)` → `200 {token, user: userTransformer.transform(user)}`.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[POST /auth/local/signin] --> B[User.getUserByUsername]
      B --> C{user? active? enabled? not locked? Local? config enabled?}
      C -- any fail --> X[failedLogin -> 401 message]
      C -- ok --> D[validatePassword pbkdf2]
      D -- invalid --> E[User.invalidLogin lockout counters] --> X
      D -- valid --> F[User.validLogin reset security]
      F --> G[tokenService.generateToken sub=userId 300s]
      G --> H[200 token,user]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Read `users`, `authentications` (Local discriminator `type:'local'` fields: password, previousPasswords[], security{locked, lockedUntil, invalidLoginAttempts, numberOfTimesLocked}), `authenticationconfigurations` (local settings.accountLock). Write `authentications.security`, `users.enabled`.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    401 text messages; 200 JSON with JWT (not an API token — must be exchanged at `/auth/token`). Warn logs for each failure.
    
    ##### External calls
    None.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - Expired lock (`locked` true but lockedUntil past) is allowed through; counters are only reset on next valid/invalid login.
    - When account is disabled after max lockouts, `security = {}` resets numberOfTimesLocked to 0.
    - `invalidLogin` uses the global 'local'/'local' config, not the user's own configuration.
    - local.js destructures `{app, passport, tokenService}` from the AuthenticationInitializer class at require time; it only works because it is required after `initialize()` set the statics.
    - Disabled user check precedes lock check; error-message wording is user-visible.
  Recommendation: Fully documented. pbkdf2 hasher internals (utilities/pbkdf2) not expanded.

- sfind-1841b2d710f24eb99a62966bb1cca454: POST /auth/token — exchange short-lived authorization JWT for API bearer token with device provisioning [high/open] repo: COG-GTM/NGA-mage-server, scan: scan-297683f5856041e28b46cf6ff133ab19 created 2026-11-05 17:33:08 UTC, category: api-endpoint
  Description: ##### Entry point
    `AuthenticationInitializer.initialize(app, passport, provision)` (service/src/authentication/index.js) called from `service/src/express.ts` line 57. Registers `POST /auth/token` (line 96) with middleware `authorize` → `provisionDevice` → handler. Also registers passport strategies `bearer` (API tokens) and `authorization` (JWT), and returns `{ passport, bearerAuthentication: passport.authenticate('bearer', {session:false}) }` used to guard all API routes.
    
    ##### Inputs
    - Header `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` — the JWT issued by `/auth/local/signin` or `/auth/<oidc>/callback` (HS256, issuer `urn:mage`, claim `assertion='urn:mage:auth:authorized'`, `sub`=user id, TTL 300 s).
    - `uid` (body/query, via `req.param('uid')`) — device uid; `name`, `description`, `appVersion` params; `createDevice` query ('false' disables auto-creation); header `user-agent`.
    
    ##### Processing flow
    1. **authorize**: `JWTService.verifyToken(token, {assertion: Authorized})` — verifies signature with process-random secret (`crypto.randomBytes(64)` generated at module load), algorithm HS256, issuer urn:mage; reject if assertion mismatch / expired / undecodable. Then `User.getUserById(payload.subject)`. If no user → `401` with `info.message`.
    2. **provisionDevice**: `provision.check(user.authentication.authenticationConfiguration.type, ...name)`: loads `AuthenticationConfiguration.getConfiguration(type,name)`; strategy = `'uid'` unless `settings.devicesReqAdmin.enabled === false` then `'none'`.
       - uid strategy (`provision/strategies/uid.js` + `provision/uid.js`): uid missing → error `Missing uid` (500 via error handler). Look up `Device.getDeviceByUid(uid)`: not found and `createDevice==='false'` → fail with 'Device ID is invalid...'; not found → create device `{uid,name,registered:false,description,userAgent,appVersion,userId}` then fail (unregistered, no message); found but `!registered` → fail 'Your device has been registered. An administrator has been notified to approve this device.'; else pass.
       - none strategy (`provision/none.js`): no uid → pass with pseudo-device `{registered:true}`; unknown uid → create with `registered:true`; existing unregistered → set registered=true and update; else pass.
       - Failure (`!device || !device.registered`) → `403` with message.
    3. Handler: `api.User().login(user, provisionedDevice, {userAgent, appVersion})`: `Token.createToken` = sha256(hex) of 20 random bytes, upsert on `{userId, deviceId?}` with `expirationDate = now + tokenExpiration*1000`; `Login.createLogin({userId, deviceId?})`; if device, `DeviceModel.updateDevice(device._id, {userAgent, appVersion})`.
    4. Log 'user signed in' (user, userId, deviceUid, ip, userAgent, signInTime ISO, tokenExpiration).
    5. `authenticationApiAppender.append(apiInfo)` copies apiInfo and adds `authenticationStrategies` keyed by name for every **enabled** AuthenticationConfiguration (transformed).
    6. Respond JSON; set `req.session = null`.
    
    Bearer strategy (all API routes): `Token.getToken(token)` finds token doc, populates `userId` → `authenticationId`, then `roleId`; no token/user → unauthenticated; sets `req.token`, `req.provisionedDeviceId` if token has deviceId.
    
    Startup also: `AuthenticationConfiguration.getAllConfigurations()` → for each config `require('../authentication/' + config.type).initialize(SecurePropertyAppender.appendToConfig(config))` (errors logged); then always `require('./local').initialize()` and `require('./anonymous').initialize()`.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[POST /auth/token] --> B[authorize: JWTService.verifyToken assertion=urn:mage:auth:authorized]
      B -- invalid/no user --> X1[401 info.message]
      B --> C[User.getUserById sub]
      C --> D[provision.check type,name]
      D --> E{devicesReqAdmin.enabled === false?}
      E -- yes --> F[none strategy: auto-register device]
      E -- no --> G[uid strategy: Device.getDeviceByUid]
      G -- missing & createDevice=false --> X2[403 Device ID is invalid]
      G -- missing --> H[Device.createDevice registered=false] --> X3[403]
      G -- unregistered --> X4[403 awaiting approval]
      G -- registered --> I
      F --> I[api.User.login]
      I --> J[Token.createToken upsert]
      J --> K[Login.createLogin]
      K --> L{device?}
      L -- yes --> M[DeviceModel.updateDevice userAgent,appVersion]
      L -- no --> N
      M --> N[authenticationApiAppender.append]
      N --> O[200 JSON token,expirationDate,user,device,api]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    - Read: `users` (+roles, authentications), `authenticationconfigurations`, `devices`, `tokens`.
    - Write: `tokens` upsert `{userId, deviceId?, token, expirationDate}` (TTL index `expirationDate` expireAfterSeconds 0 — Mongo removes expired tokens); `logins` insert `{userId, deviceId?}`; `devices` insert/update.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    Response `{ token, expirationDate, user: userTransformer.transform(user,{path:req.getRoot()}), device, api: { name, nodeVersion, description, version:{major,minor,patch}, serverVerion, authenticationStrategies:{...} } }`. Note misspelled key `serverVerion` (clients may depend on it).
    
    ##### External calls
    None outside Mongo; passport-http-bearer, jsonwebtoken.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - JWT secret is random per process: authorization JWTs do not survive restarts and are not valid across multiple instances (load-balanced deployments need sticky sessions or a shared secret).
    - Token upsert keyed by (userId, deviceId): one active token per user per device; login without device replaces the user's device-less token (query `{userId}` only — may match a device token too, since query omits deviceId).
    - `provision.check` with missing strategy calls `next(err)` but does not return, then dereferences undefined `provision` → TypeError (only if strategy files missing).
    - none strategy's `updateDevice` promise has no catch.
    - uid strategy creates a device record even when it fails provisioning (admin approval workflow).
  Recommendation: Fully documented. Strategy modules ldap/saml/oauth/anonymous loaded dynamically by config.type are in other batches.
  Note: End-to-end flow: Every sign-in strategy (local, LDAP, OAuth, OIDC, SAML) issues a short-lived authorization JWT that clients exchange here; together they form the Authentication sign-in -> token flow. Calls provision.check (29117267) and models/token (dc76da07).   Description: ##### Entry point
    `GeoPackageExportTransform.export` for `format === 'geopackage'` (deps: locationRepo, IterateObservations, observation iconStore, attachmentStore, observation iconRepo, userRepo, user iconStore, logger).
    
    ##### Inputs
    `ExportParams`, MageEvent.
    
    ##### Processing flow
    1. `createGeoPackageFile`: `mkdtemp(os.tmpdir()/geopackage-)`, file `moment().format('YYYMMDD_hhmmssSSS').gpkg`; `GeoPackageAPI.create`.
    2. Observations: 
       - `Forms` attributes table (`formName, primaryField, variantField, color, formId` TEXT) with one row per projected form (only if any).
       - `Form_<formId>` attribute table per projected form: one column per non-archived projected field (type numberfield->INTEGER, else TEXT, with data-column title), plus `formId INTEGER default id`, `primaryField`/`variantField` TEXT if configured.
       - `Observations` feature table: `lastModified, timestamp, createdAt DATETIME; mageId, userId, deviceId, primaryField, variantField TEXT`.
       - Feature style extension; table default icon from `iconRepository.getIcon(event.id)` (cached in `IconTreeCache`).
       - `Attachments` media table (`name TEXT, size REAL`).
       - Per observation: count++, track timestamps; projected forms; **if none -> `break` (stops processing all remaining observations)**; primary entry = first projected form; `primary = String(entry[form.primaryField])`, `variant` similarly (only if primaryField). Add GeoJSON feature; expand bounds; link icon (`ensureIconInGeopackage`: cache by formId/primary/variant, else `iconRepository.getIcon(eventId, formId, primary, variant)`, store PNG row width 36 anchor 0.5/1.0, name per `populateGpkgIconRow`; failures cached as ICON_LOAD_ERROR); insert style mapping.
       - For **every** form entry of the observation (not projected): collect attachments whose `observationFormId == entry.id`, append attachment ids to the entry field array (mutates entry); convert values: multiselectdropdown join `, `, date ISO, checkbox String, geometry WKT, attachment ids join `, `, else raw; skip unknown fields/null; `addAttributeRow('Form_'+formId)`; add attachment media (buffer content, contentType default `application/octet-stream`, name default id) and link to observation and form row; `linkRelatedRows(Observations -> Form_x, ATTRIBUTES)`; errors per entry logged and skipped.
       - RTree index; set content bounds.
    3. Locations: `Locations` feature table (`Location Id, User Id, Username, Display Name, Device Id TEXT; Date/Time DATETIME; Accuracy, Altitude, Bearing, Speed REAL`); per location (user looked up when userId changes) add feature with those properties (Location Id never populated), set per-row default icon from user icon (PNG width 36, cached per user); content bounds only set if a user was resolved at the end; RTree.
    4. Append file stream as `<event.name stripped of \W, or Event_<id>>.gpkg`; on archive `end` unlink file and close geopackage.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[GeoPackageExportTransform.export] --> B[createGeoPackageFile tmpdir]
      B --> C{observationParams?}
      C -->|yes| D[Forms table]
      D --> E[Form_id tables]
      E --> F[Observations table + styles]
      F --> G[loop observations]
      G -->|no projected forms| X[break loop]
      G --> H[add feature + icon mapping]
      H --> I[Form_id rows + Attachments media + relations]
      C --> J{locationParams?}
      J -->|yes| K[Locations table + user icons]
      J --> L[append name.gpkg to ZIP; unlink on end]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Reads observations, icons, attachments, locations, users, user icons. Writes temp file in `os.tmpdir()` (needs disk space), ZIP entry `<EventName>.gpkg`.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    GeoPackage in ZIP; summary; temp file deleted on archive end (temp directory itself is not removed).
    
    ##### External calls
    `@ngageoint/geopackage` (GeoPackageAPI, FeatureTableStyles, RTreeIndex, related tables/media), `wkx`, `moment`.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - `break` on first observation without projected forms silently truncates the export, and count includes that observation.
    - `String(undefined)` produces the literal `"undefined"` for missing primary/variant values.
    - Form rows are written for all form entries even when projection excludes the form (table `Form_x` may not exist -> logged error).
    - Filename format `YYY` (3-digit year) and 12-hour `hh`.
    - Field type mapping only distinguishes numberfield (INTEGER).
    - Location bounds skip if last user not found.
  Recommendation: Fully documented; confirm whether the `break` truncation is intended.

        async addObservationsToGeoPackage(
          geopackage: GeoPackage,
          event: MageEvent,
          styles: FeatureTableStyles,
          params: ObservationExportParams
        ): Promise<ExportItemSummary> {
          createAttachmentTable(geopackage)
      
          const iterable = await this.streamObservations(event, params.findSpec)
      
          let count = 0;
          let startTimestamp: number | undefined = undefined
          let endTimestamp: number | undefined = undefined
          let zoomToEnvelope: Envelope | null = null;
          try {
            for await (const observation of iterable) {
              this.log.debug(`exporting observation ${observation.id} ...`)
              count++;
              if (startTimestamp === undefined || observation.properties.timestamp.getTime() < startTimestamp) {
                startTimestamp = observation.properties.timestamp.getTime()
              }
              if (endTimestamp === undefined || observation.properties.timestamp.getTime() > endTimestamp) {
                endTimestamp = observation.properties.timestamp.getTime()
              }
      
              const forms = projectedObservationFormFields(observation, params.projection)
      
              if (!forms.length) {
                break
              }
      
              const primaryEntry = forms[0]
              const form = event.formFor(primaryEntry.formId)
              const primary = form?.primaryField ? String(primaryEntry[form.primaryField]) : null
              const variant = form?.primaryField && form?.variantField ? String(primaryEntry[form.variantField]) : null
              const properties: any = {
                lastModified: observation.lastModified,
                timestamp: observation.properties.timestamp,
                mageId: observation.id.toString(),
                createdAt: observation.createdAt,
                primaryField: primary,
                variantField: variant
              }
              if (observation.userId) {
                properties.userId = observation.userId.toString()
              }
              if (observation.deviceId) {
                properties.deviceId = observation.deviceId.toString()
              }
      
              const feature: geojson.Feature = {
                type: 'Feature',
                geometry: observation.geometry,
                properties
              }
      
              zoomToEnvelope = calculateBounds(feature.geometry, zoomToEnvelope)
      
              const featureId = geopackage.addGeoJSONFeatureToGeoPackage(feature, 'Observations')
              const iconSpec = {
                eventId: event.id,
                formId: primaryEntry.formId,
                primary,
                variant,
              }
              await this.linkObservationFeatureIcon(event, iconSpec, featureId, styles)
      
              const formEntries = observation.properties.forms || []
              for (const formEntry of formEntries) {
                const form = event.formFor(formEntry.formId)!;
                const primary = form.primaryField ? String(formEntry[form.primaryField]) : null
                const variant = form.primaryField && form.variantField ? String(formEntry[form.variantField]) : null
                const formToSave = {
                  primaryField: primary,
                  variantField: variant,
                  formId: formEntry.formId
                } as any;
                const attachments = [] as Attachment[]
                if (observation.attachments) {
                  observation.attachments.forEach((attachment) => {
                    if (String(attachment.observationFormId) === formEntry.id) {
                      attachments.push(attachment);
                      const attachmentFieldEntries = (formEntry[attachment.fieldName] || []) as string[]
                      attachmentFieldEntries.push(String(attachment.id))
                      formEntry[attachment.fieldName] = attachmentFieldEntries
                    }
                  })
                }
                Object.keys(formEntry).forEach(key => {
                  const fieldEntry = formEntry[key] as any
                  if (fieldEntry === null || fieldEntry === undefined) {
                    return
                  }
                  const field = event.formFieldFor(key, form.id)
                  if (!field) {
                    return
                  }
                  if (field.type === 'multiselectdropdown') {
                    formToSave[key] = fieldEntry.join(', ');
                  } else if (field.type === 'date') {
                    formToSave[key] = moment(fieldEntry).toISOString();
                  } else if (field.type === 'checkbox') {
                    formToSave[key] = String(fieldEntry)
                  } else if (field.type === 'geometry') {
                    formToSave[key] = wkx.Geometry.parseGeoJSON(fieldEntry).toWkt();
                  } else if (field.type === 'attachment') {
                    formToSave[key] = fieldEntry.join(', ');
                  } else {
                    formToSave[key] = fieldEntry
                  }
                })
      
                try {
                  const rowId = geopackage.addAttributeRow('Form_' + formToSave.formId, formToSave);
                  if (attachments.length) {
                    await this.addAttachments(geopackage, Observation.evaluate(observation, event), attachments, featureId, 'Form_' + formToSave.formId, rowId);
                  }
                  await geopackage.linkRelatedRows('Observations', featureId, 'Form_' + formToSave.formId, rowId, RelationType.ATTRIBUTES);
                } catch (e) {
                  this.log.error(`error writing rows for form entry ${formEntry.id} of observation ${observation.id} to geopackage`, e);
                }
              }
            }
          } finally {
            if (iterable.close) {
              iterable.close()
            }
          }
      
          const featureDao = geopackage.getFeatureDao('Observations');
          const rtreeIndex = new RTreeIndex(geopackage, featureDao);
          rtreeIndex.create();
          if (zoomToEnvelope) {
            setContentBounds(geopackage, featureDao, zoomToEnvelope);
          }
          this.log.info(`'wrote ${count} observations to geopackage`);
      
          return { count, startTimestamp: new Date(startTimestamp ?? 0), endTimestamp: new Date(endTimestamp ?? Date.now()) }
        }

    Code:
        async addLocationsToGeoPackage(
          geopackage: GeoPackage,
          event: MageEvent,
          params: LocationExportParams
        ): Promise<ExportItemSummary> {
          const table = 'Locations'
          await createLocationTable(geopackage, table)
          const featureTableStyles = await createLocationTableStyles(geopackage, table)
      
          const iterable = this.locationRepository.iterate(params.findSpec)
      
          let count = 0
          let startTimestamp: number | undefined = undefined
          let endTimestamp: number | undefined = undefined
          let user: User | null = null
          const userIconRows: Map<string, IconRow> = new Map()
          let zoomToEnvelope: Envelope | null = null
      
          try {
            for await (const location of iterable) {
              if (startTimestamp === undefined || location.properties.timestamp.getTime() < startTimestamp) {
                startTimestamp = location.properties.timestamp.getTime()
              }
              if (endTimestamp === undefined || location.properties.timestamp.getTime() > endTimestamp) {
                endTimestamp = location.properties.timestamp.getTime()
              }
      
              if (user?.id.toString() !== location.userId.toString()) {
                user = await this.userRepository.findById(location.userId)
              }
      
              zoomToEnvelope = calculateBounds(location.geometry, zoomToEnvelope)
      
              const properties = location.properties || {} as geojson.Feature<geojson.Point, any>
              const feature: geojson.Feature<geojson.Point, any> = {
                type: 'Feature',
                geometry: location.geometry,
                properties: {
                  'User Id': location.userId?.toString(),
                  'Username': user?.username,
                  'Display Name': user?.displayName,
                  'Device Id': properties.deviceId ? properties.deviceId.toString() : undefined,
                  'Date/Time': properties.timestamp,
                  'Accuracy': properties.accuracy,
                  'Altitude': properties.altitude,
                  'Bearing': properties.bearing,
                  'Speed': properties.speed
                }
              }
      
              delete feature.properties.id;
      
              const rowId = await geopackage.addGeoJSONFeatureToGeoPackage(feature, table)
              if (user) {
                const iconContent = await this.userIconStore.readContent(user)
                if (iconContent instanceof Readable) {
                  let iconRow = userIconRows.get(user.id)
                  if (iconRow === undefined) {
                    try {
                      iconRow = featureTableStyles.getIconDao().newRow()
                      iconRow.data =  await buffer(iconContent)
                      iconRow.contentType = 'image/png'
                      iconRow.name = user.username
                      iconRow.description = `Icon for user ${user.username}`
                      iconRow.width = 36
                      iconRow.anchorU = 0.5
                      iconRow.anchorV = 1.0
                      featureTableStyles.setIconDefault(rowId, iconRow)
                      userIconRows.set(user.id, iconRow)
                    } catch (err) {
                      this.log.error(`error reading icon for user: ${user.id}`, err)
                    }
                  } else {
                    featureTableStyles.setIconDefault(rowId, iconRow)
                  }
                }
              }
      
              count++
            }
          } finally {
             iterable.close?.()
          }
      
          const featureDao = geopackage.getFeatureDao(table);
          if (zoomToEnvelope && user) {
            // Process the last user, since it was missed in the loop above
            setContentBounds(geopackage, featureDao, zoomToEnvelope)
          }
      
          const rtreeIndex = new RTreeIndex(geopackage, featureDao);
          rtreeIndex.create();
      
          this.log.info(`wrote ${count} locations to geopackage`)
          return { count, startTimestamp: new Date(startTimestamp ?? 0), endTimestamp: new Date(endTimestamp ?? Date.now()) }
        }

  Description: ##### Entry point
    `/api/feeds` (`FeedsRoutes`, adapters/feeds/adapters.feeds.controllers.web.ts, bearer auth) using `PreFetchedUserRoleFeedsPermissionService` (permissions.feeds.ts, role-based; not traced in detail). Event-scoped content fetch reuses `FetchFeedContent` with `EventFeedsPermissionService`.
    
    ##### Inputs
    Service type id, service `{serviceType, title, summary, config}`, feed `FeedCreateMinimal` (service, topic, title, icon/mapStyle.icon `{sourceUrl}` strings, constantParams, variableParamsSchema, itemPropertiesSchema...), variableParams, `skipContentFetch`.
    
    ##### Processing flow
    - ListFeedServiceTypes: `ensureListServiceTypesPermissionFor`; descriptors of all types.
    - PreviewTopics: create-service permission; type 404; `validateServiceConfig` -> invalid input per key; `createConnection(config, locale).fetchAvailableTopics()`; errors -> InfrastructureError.
    - CreateFeedService: validate config; `serviceRepo.create({serviceType,title,summary||null,config})`; return with `redactServiceConfig`.
    - ListFeedServices: all services whose type exists, redacted. GetFeedService: list-services permission; service+type 404s; redacted + type descriptor.
    - DeleteFeedService: create-service permission; find feeds for service; `eventRepo.removeFeedsFromEvents` (**not awaited**); remove feeds by service; remove service.
    - ListServiceTopics: lookups (404) **before** permission; then `ensureListTopicsPermissionFor`; fetch topics.
    - buildFetchContext: service -> type -> connection -> topics -> topic match (404 FeedTopic); compile variableParamsSchema; wrap connection so `fetchTopicContent` pares item properties to `itemPropertiesSchema` (feed or topic).
    - resolveFeedCreate: parse icon URL strings (invalid -> key errors), `FeedCreateUnresolved(topic, feed)`, import icons `iconRepo.findOrImportBySourceUrl(url, null, EagerAwait)`, `FeedCreateAttrs`.
    - PreviewFeed: create-feed permission; validate variableParams; merged = variable then constant (constant wins); validate against topic `paramsSchema`; resolve; unless `skipContentFetch === true` fetch content -> `{feed:'preview', topic, variableParams, items, pageCursor?}`.
    - CreateFeed: resolve and `feedRepo.create`; returns with service (unredacted) and topic.
    - ListAllFeeds/ListServiceFeeds/GetFeed: list-all permission; GetFeed returns redacted service + topic.
    - UpdateFeed: 404 and service/topic immutability checks **before** permission; resolve; `feedRepo.put`.
    - DeleteFeed: 404 before permission; remove feed from all events; remove.
    - FetchFeedContent: permission; feed 404; context; `params = req.variableParams || {}; Object.assign(params, constantParams)`; fetch; return `{...content, feed: id, variableParams: req.variableParams}`; errors -> InfrastructureError.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[/api/feeds request] --> P{FeedsPermissionService}
      P -->|denied| E[PermissionDenied]
      P --> B[buildFetchContext service->type->conn->topic]
      B --> C[resolveFeedCreate icons import]
      C --> D[feedRepo create/put]
      B --> F[conn.fetchTopicContent pared items]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Mongo feed service types (plugin registered), feed services (config), feeds, events.feedIds, static icons.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    Created/updated/deleted services and feeds; icon imports from remote URLs; remote feed service calls.
    
    ##### External calls
    Plugin `FeedServiceType.createConnection` -> `fetchAvailableTopics`, `fetchTopicContent`; `JsonSchemaService.validateSchema`; static icon fetch by URL.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - `FetchFeedContent` mutates `req.variableParams`, so the echoed `variableParams` includes constant params.
    - CreateFeed response includes the unredacted service config; Get/List redact.
    - Some operations check existence before permission (404 vs 403 ordering).

      export function FetchFeedContent(permissionService: api.FeedsPermissionService, serviceTypeRepo: FeedServiceTypeRepository, serviceRepo: FeedServiceRepository, feedRepo: FeedRepository, jsonSchemaService: JsonSchemaService): api.FetchFeedContent {
        return async function fetchFeedContent(req: api.FetchFeedContentRequest): ReturnType<api.FetchFeedContent> {
          return await withPermission<FeedContent, KnownErrorsOf<api.FetchFeedContent>>(
            permissionService.ensureFetchFeedContentPermissionFor(req.context, req.feed),
            async (): Promise<FeedContent | EntityNotFoundError | InvalidInputError | InfrastructureError> => {
              const feed = await feedRepo.findById(req.feed)
              if (!feed) {
                return entityNotFound(req.feed, 'Feed')
              }
              try {
                const fetch = await buildFetchContext({ serviceTypeRepo, serviceRepo, jsonSchemaService }, feed)
                if (fetch instanceof MageError) {
                  return fetch
                }
                const conn = fetch.conn
                let params = req.variableParams || {}
                params = Object.assign(params, feed.constantParams || {})
                const content = await conn.fetchTopicContent(feed.topic, params)
                return { ...content, feed: feed.id, variableParams: req.variableParams }
              }
              catch (err) {
                console.error(`error fetching content for feed ${feed.id}, ${feed.title}`, err)
              }
              return infrastructureError('error fetching feed content')
            }
          )
        }
      }

      async function buildFetchContext(services: ContentFetchDependencies, fetchContextParams: FetchContextParams): Promise<ContentFetchContext | EntityNotFoundError | InvalidInputError> {
        // TODO: this logic might belong more in the entity/domain layer
        const { service: serviceId, topic: topicId, variableParamsSchema, locale } = fetchContextParams
        const service = await services.serviceRepo.findById(serviceId)
        if (!service) {
          return entityNotFound(serviceId, 'FeedService')
        }
        const serviceType = await services.serviceTypeRepo.findById(service.serviceType)
        if (!serviceType) {
          return entityNotFound(service.serviceType, 'FeedServiceType')
        }
        const conn = await serviceType.createConnection(service.config, { locale: fetchContextParams.locale })
        const topics = await conn.fetchAvailableTopics()
        const topic = topics.find(x => x.id === topicId)
        if (!topic) {
          return entityNotFound(topicId, 'FeedTopic')
        }
        let variableParamsValidator: JsonValidator | undefined = undefined
        if (variableParamsSchema && services.jsonSchemaService) {
          try {
            variableParamsValidator = await services.jsonSchemaService.validateSchema(variableParamsSchema)
          }
          catch (err) {
            return invalidInput('invalid variable parameters schema', [ err, 'feed', 'variableParamsSchema' ])
          }
        }
        const propertyParingConn: FeedServiceConnection = {
          fetchServiceInfo: () => conn.fetchServiceInfo(),
          fetchAvailableTopics: () => conn.fetchAvailableTopics(),
          fetchTopicContent: async (topicId: string, params?: any) => {
            const sourceContent = await conn.fetchTopicContent(topicId, params)
            const paredItems = retainSchemaPropertiesInFeatures(sourceContent.items, fetchContextParams.itemPropertiesSchema || topic.itemPropertiesSchema)
            return {
              ...sourceContent,
              items: paredItems
            }
          }
        }
        return { serviceType, service, topic, conn: propertyParingConn, variableParamsValidator }
      }
