      export function AddFeedToEvent(permissionService: EventPermissionServiceImpl, eventRepo: MageEventRepository): AddFeedToEvent {
        return async function(req: AddFeedToEventRequest): ReturnType<AddFeedToEvent> {
          const event = req.context.mageEvent
          // TODO: also check for permission to read the feed?
          const principal = req.context.requestingPrincipal() as UserWithRole
          const denied = await permissionService.authorizeEventAccess(event, principal, MageEventPermission.UPDATE_EVENT, EventAccessType.Update)
          if (denied) {
            return AppResponse.error(denied)
          }
          const updated = await eventRepo.addFeedsToEvent(event.id, req.feed)
          if (updated) {
            return AppResponse.success<MageEventAttrs, unknown>(updated)
          }
          return AppResponse.error(entityNotFound(event.id, 'MageEvent', 'event removed before update'))
        }
      }
      
      export function ListEventFeeds(permissionService: EventPermissionServiceImpl, feedRepo: FeedRepository): ListEventFeeds {
        return async function(req: ListEventFeedsRequest): ReturnType<ListEventFeeds> {
          const event = req.context.mageEvent
          const principal = req.context.requestingPrincipal() as UserWithRole
          const denied = await permissionService.authorizeEventAccess(event, principal, MageEventPermission.READ_EVENT_USER, EventAccessType.Read)
          if (denied) {
            return AppResponse.error(denied)
          }
          const feeds = await feedRepo.findAllByIds(event.feedIds)
          const langPrefs = req.context.locale()?.languagePreferences || []
          // TODO: is this the right way to return content languages?
          const { userFeeds, langs } = Object.values(feeds).reduce(({ userFeeds, langs }, feed) => {
            if (feed) {
              const { constantParams, ...userFeed } = { ...feed }
              const localized = localizedFeed(userFeed, langPrefs)
              userFeeds.push(localized)
              const lang = localized[ContentLanguageKey]
              if (lang) {
                langs.add(lang.toString())
              }
            }
            return { userFeeds, langs }
          }, { userFeeds: [] as UserFeed[], langs: new Set<string>() })
          return AppResponse.success(userFeeds, Array.from(langs).map(x => new LanguageTag(x)))
        }
      }
      
      export function RemoveFeedFromEvent(permissionService: EventPermissionServiceImpl, eventRepo: MageEventRepository):  RemoveFeedFromEvent {
        return async function(req: RemoveFeedFromEventRequest): ReturnType<RemoveFeedFromEvent> {
          const event = req.context.mageEvent
          const principal = req.context.requestingPrincipal() as UserWithRole
          const denied = await permissionService.authorizeEventAccess(event, principal, MageEventPermission.UPDATE_EVENT, EventAccessType.Update)
          if (denied) {
            return AppResponse.error(denied)
          }
          if (event.feedIds.indexOf(req.feed) < 0) {
            return AppResponse.error(entityNotFound(req.feed, 'MageEvent.feedIds'))
          }
          const updated = await eventRepo.removeFeedsFromEvent(event.id, req.feed)
          if (updated) {
            return AppResponse.success<MageEventAttrs, unknown>(updated)
          }
          return AppResponse.error(entityNotFound(event.id, 'MageEvent', 'event removed before update'))
        }
      }

    ##### Inputs
    `ExportParams` (see export lifecycle flow): `observationParams.{findSpec, projection}`, `locationParams.findSpec`; the `MageEvent` (forms, fields).
    
    ##### Processing flow
    1. If observationParams: build column list: fixed `id, User, Device, Shape Type, Latitude, Longitude, MGRS, Date (ISO8601), Excel Timestamp (UTC), Well Known Text, Location Provider, Location Accuracy +/- (meters)` (values `id,user,device,shapeType,latitude,longitude,mgrs,timestamp,excelTimestamp,wkt,provider,accuracy`), then for each **non-archived form** its non-archived, non-`attachment` fields included by projection, sorted by `field.id`: label `<form.name>.<field.title>`, value `<form.name>.<field.name>`. If `findSpec.includeAttachments`: add `Attachment`, `Attachment Orig Name`.
    2. `json2csv.AsyncParser` appended to archive as `observations.csv`; iterate observations; per row (`observationColumns`): spread `observation.properties` + id; user lookup cached on last userId (`user.username`); device lookup cached on last deviceId (`device.uid`); `mgrs.forward(turfCentroid)`; Point -> raw lon/lat else centroid; `wkt` via `wkx`; `excelTimestamp` is the literal Excel formula `=DATEVALUE(MID(INDIRECT(ADDRESS(ROW(),COLUMN()-1)),1,10)) + TIMEVALUE(MID(INDIRECT(ADDRESS(ROW(),COLUMN()-1)),12,8))` (relies on the previous column being the ISO date); for each projected form entry copy truthy field values to key `<form.name>.<field.name>`; for each attachment read content via `attachmentStore.readContent(id, Observation.evaluate(...))` and if Readable append to ZIP root as `attachment.name || Attachment_<id>` and set `attachment`/`attachmentOriginalName` columns.
    3. Track min/max `properties.timestamp`, count; finally `close()` iterator and push null.
    4. If locationParams: `locations.csv` with fields `user,timestamp,latitude,longitude,altitude,provider,mgrs,accuracy,speed,bearing,battery_level,device`; `locationRepository.iterate(findSpec)`; `flattenLocation`: spread properties, lon/lat from coordinates, mgrs, user username (cache by userId), device uid (cache compared by `cache.device._id`).
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[CsvExportTransform.export] --> B{observationParams?}
      B -->|yes| C[exportObservations build fields]
      C --> D[AsyncParser -> observations.csv]
      D --> E[pipeObservations IterateObservations]
      E --> F[observationColumns user/device cache, mgrs, wkt, form fields]
      F --> G[attachmentStore.readContent -> archive root]
      B --> H{locationParams?}
      H -->|yes| I[exportLocations -> locations.csv]
      I --> J[locationRepository.iterate -> flattenLocation]
      H --> K[return summary]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Reads: observations (event collection via repository), users (`findById`), devices (`getDeviceById`), attachment files (attachment store), user locations. Writes: ZIP entries `observations.csv`, `locations.csv`, attachment files at archive root.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    CSV entries + attachments; `ExportSummary {observations?, locations?: {count, startTimestamp, endTimestamp}}`.
    
    ##### External calls
    `json2csv` AsyncParser, `@turf/centroid`, `mgrs`, `wkx`.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - Falsy form values (0, false, '') are not written (`if (fieldEntry)`).
    - Multiple attachments: only the last one's name stays in the row; all files are appended. Duplicate attachment names collide in the ZIP root.
    - Attachment fields excluded from columns; archived forms/fields excluded from columns but archived field values still copied (dropped by json2csv since no column).
    - Column values use keys containing dots (`Form.field`); whether json2csv resolves these as flat keys or nested paths was not verified in library source — confirm against output.
    - User/device caches only remember the last record (efficient only if iteration is sorted by user/device).
    - If the user lookup fails the previous cached user remains for observations (cache not cleared when `userId` missing).
    - Location device cache compares `_id`, observation cache compares `id`.

    Code:
        async exportObservations(
          event: MageEvent,
          params: ObservationExportParams,
          archive: Archiver
        ): Promise<ExportItemSummary> {
          const forms = event?.forms || []
          const observationFields = [
            { label: 'id', value: 'id' },
            { label: 'User', value: 'user' },
            { label: 'Device', value: 'device' },
            { label: 'Shape Type', value: 'shapeType' },
            { label: 'Latitude', value: 'latitude' },
            { label: 'Longitude', value: 'longitude' },
            { label: 'MGRS', value: 'mgrs' },
            { label: 'Date (ISO8601)', value: 'timestamp' },
            { label: 'Excel Timestamp (UTC)', value: 'excelTimestamp' },
            { label: 'Well Known Text', value: 'wkt' },
            { label: 'Location Provider', value: 'provider' },
            { label: 'Location Accuracy +/- (meters)', value: 'accuracy' },
          ].concat(forms
            .filter(form => !form.archived)
            .flatMap(form => {
              const fields = form.fields
                .filter(field => !field.archived)
                .filter(field => field.type !== 'attachment')
                .filter(field => projectionIncludesField(form.id, field.name, params.projection))
                .sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id)
                .map(field => {
                  return {
                    label: `${form.name}.${field.title}`,
                    value: `${form.name}.${field.name}`
                  }
                })
              return fields
            }))
      
          if (params.findSpec?.includeAttachments) {
            observationFields.push({
              label: 'Attachment',
              value: 'attachment'
            })
      
            observationFields.push({
              label: 'Attachment Orig Name',
              value: 'attachmentOriginalName'
            })
          }
      
          const asyncParser = new json2csv.AsyncParser({ fields: observationFields }, { readableObjectMode: true, writableObjectMode: true })
          archive.append(asyncParser.processor as stream.Transform, { name: 'observations.csv' })
          return this.pipeObservations(event, params, asyncParser.input, archive)
        }
  Snippet: service/src/app.impl/exports/app.impl.exports.csv.ts:137-210
    Commentary: Per-observation row building and attachment archiving.
    Code:
        async observationColumns(
          event: MageEvent,
          observation: ObservationAttrs,
          forms: FormEntry[],
          cache: { user: User | null, device: Device | null },
          archive: archiver.Archiver,
        ): Promise<any> {
          const column = {
            id: observation.id,
            ...observation.properties
          } as any
      
          if (!cache.user || cache.user.id !== observation.userId) {
            if (observation.userId) {
              cache.user = await this.userRepository.findById(observation.userId!)
            }
          }
      
          if (!cache.device || cache.device.id.toString() !== observation.deviceId?.toString()) {
            if (observation.deviceId) {
              cache.device = await this.deviceRepository.getDeviceById(observation.deviceId)
            }
          }
      
          if (cache.user) {
            column.user = cache.user.username
          }
          if (cache.device) {
            column.device = cache.device.uid
          }
      
          const centroid = turfCentroid(observation as any)
          column.mgrs = mgrs.forward(centroid.geometry.coordinates)
      
          column.shapeType = observation.geometry.type
          if (observation.geometry.type === 'Point') {
            column.longitude = observation.geometry.coordinates[0]
            column.latitude = observation.geometry.coordinates[1]
          } else {
            column.longitude = centroid.geometry.coordinates[0]
            column.latitude = centroid.geometry.coordinates[1]
          }
          column.wkt = wkx.Geometry.parseGeoJSON(observation.geometry).toWkt()
          column.excelTimestamp = "=DATEVALUE(MID(INDIRECT(ADDRESS(ROW(),COLUMN()-1)),1,10)) + TIMEVALUE(MID(INDIRECT(ADDRESS(ROW(),COLUMN()-1)),12,8))"
      
          forms.forEach(formEntry => {
            const form = event.formFor(formEntry.formId)
            if (!form) {
              return
            }
            for (const field of form.fields) {
              const fieldEntry = formEntry[field.name]
              if (fieldEntry) {
                column[`${form.name}.` + field.name] = fieldEntry
              }
            }
          })
      
          if (observation.attachments) {
            const evaluatedObservation = Observation.evaluate(observation, event)
            for (const attachment of observation.attachments) {
              const content = await this.attachmentStore.readContent(attachment.id, evaluatedObservation)
      
              if (content instanceof Readable) {
                const name = attachment.name || `Attachment_${attachment.id}`
                column.attachment = name
                column.attachmentOriginalName = attachment.name
                archive.append(content, { name })
              }
            }
          }
      
          return column
        }

  Description: ##### Entry point
    `/api/events/:eventId/acl` (`EventAclRoutes`, adapters.events.acl.controllers.web.ts) with `bearerAuthentication` + `ensureEventScope`: `GET /` -> `ListEventAcl`; `PUT /:userId` body `{role}` -> `SetEventAclRole`; `DELETE /:userId` -> `RemoveEventAclUser`.
    
    ##### Inputs
    Path `userId`; body `role` in `EventRole` = `OWNER|MANAGER|GUEST`; `context.mageEvent.acl` = `{ [userId]: { role, permissions: EventAccessType[] } }`.
    
    ##### Processing flow
    - Common: `ensureEventUpdatePermission` = `authorizeEventAccess(event, principal, UPDATE_EVENT, Update)`: allowed if app role has `UPDATE_EVENT`, else ACL role in roles with `update` (OWNER, MANAGER); for read checks team membership also counts.
    - List: permission -> `aclEntries`: users fetched by ids, entries `{user:{id,username,displayName,email}, role, permissions}` (missing users dropped), sorted by `displayName` localeCompare.
    - Set: invalid role -> InvalidInput (checked before permission); permission; if new role is OWNER or target currently OWNER -> `ensureCanManageOwners` (app role UPDATE_EVENT or requester is OWNER) else denied; user must exist (`findById`, errors -> 404 User); if new role not OWNER and target is the last OWNER -> InvalidInput `event must have at least one owner`; `aclRepo.setUserRole` (null -> 404 event removed).
    - Remove: permission; target not in ACL -> 404 `MageEvent.acl`; target OWNER -> owner management check; last owner -> InvalidInput; `aclRepo.removeUser`.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[PUT /acl/:userId] --> B{role valid?}
      B -->|no| E1[InvalidInput]
      B --> C{authorizeEventAccess UPDATE_EVENT}
      C -->|no| E2[PermissionDenied]
      C --> D{owner involved?}
      D -->|yes| F{ensureCanManageOwners}
      F -->|no| E2
      D --> G[userRepo.findById]
      F --> G
      G -->|none| E3[404 User]
      G --> H{isLastOwner demote?}
      H -->|yes| E1
      H --> I[aclRepo.setUserRole]
      I --> J[aclEntries sorted]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Reads event (preloaded), event teams, users. Writes event `acl` via `EventAclRepository` (Mongo implementation `adapters/events/adapters.events.acl.db.mongoose.ts`, not in batch; contract: add/change role or remove user, return updated ACL or null).
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    JSON array of ACL entries; event ACL updated.
    
    ##### External calls
    `EventPermissionServiceImpl` (permissions.events.ts), `userRoleHasPermission`, `UserRepository.findAllByIds/findById`.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - Role validation precedes the permission check (unauthorized callers learn role validity).
    - Managers can add/remove non-owners but not touch owners; app-level UPDATE_EVENT bypasses all.
    - `permissions` per ACL entry are stored values returned verbatim; how the repository derives them was not traced (outside batch).
  Recommendation: Trace adapters.events.acl.db.mongoose.ts to confirm how `permissions` are derived on setUserRole.

    Code:
      export function SetEventAclRole(permissionService: EventPermissionServiceImpl, aclRepo: EventAclRepository, userRepo: UserRepository): SetEventAclRole {
        return async function(req: SetEventAclRoleRequest): ReturnType<SetEventAclRole> {
          if (!Object.values(EventRole).includes(req.role)) {
            return AppResponse.error(invalidInput('invalid event role', [ req.role, 'role' ]))
          }
          const event = req.context.mageEvent
          const denied = await ensureEventUpdatePermission(permissionService, event, req.context)
          if (denied) {
            return AppResponse.error(denied)
          }
          if (req.role === EventRole.OWNER || event.acl[req.user]?.role === EventRole.OWNER) {
            const ownerDenied = ensureCanManageOwners(event, req.context)
            if (ownerDenied) {
              return AppResponse.error(ownerDenied)
            }
          }
          const user = await userRepo.findById(req.user).catch(() => null)
          if (!user) {
            return AppResponse.error(entityNotFound(req.user, 'User'))
          }
          if (req.role !== EventRole.OWNER && isLastOwner(event.acl, req.user)) {
            return AppResponse.error(invalidInput('event must have at least one owner', [ req.role, 'role' ]))
          }
          const acl = await aclRepo.setUserRole(event.id, req.user, req.role)
          if (!acl) {
            return AppResponse.error(entityNotFound(event.id, 'MageEvent', 'event removed before update'))
          }
          return AppResponse.success(await aclEntries(acl, userRepo))
        }
      }
      
      export function RemoveEventAclUser(permissionService: EventPermissionServiceImpl, aclRepo: EventAclRepository, userRepo: UserRepository): RemoveEventAclUser {
        return async function(req: RemoveEventAclUserRequest): ReturnType<RemoveEventAclUser> {
          const event = req.context.mageEvent
          const denied = await ensureEventUpdatePermission(permissionService, event, req.context)
          if (denied) {
            return AppResponse.error(denied)
          }
          if (!event.acl[req.user]) {
            return AppResponse.error(entityNotFound(req.user, 'MageEvent.acl'))
          }
          if (event.acl[req.user].role === EventRole.OWNER) {
            const ownerDenied = ensureCanManageOwners(event, req.context)
            if (ownerDenied) {
              return AppResponse.error(ownerDenied)
            }
          }
          if (isLastOwner(event.acl, req.user)) {
            return AppResponse.error(invalidInput('the event must have at least one owner', [ req.user, 'user' ]))
          }
          const acl = await aclRepo.removeUser(event.id, req.user)
          if (!acl) {
            return AppResponse.error(entityNotFound(event.id, 'MageEvent', 'event removed before update'))
          }
          return AppResponse.success(await aclEntries(acl, userRepo))
        }
      }
      
      function ensureEventUpdatePermission(permissionService: EventPermissionServiceImpl, event: MageEvent, context: AppRequestContext): Promise<PermissionDeniedError | null> {
        const principal = context.requestingPrincipal() as UserWithRole
        return permissionService.authorizeEventAccess(event, principal, MageEventPermission.UPDATE_EVENT, EventAccessType.Update)
      }
      
      function ensureCanManageOwners(event: MageEvent, context: AppRequestContext): PermissionDeniedError | null {
        const principal = context.requestingPrincipal() as UserWithRole
        if (userRoleHasPermission(principal, MageEventPermission.UPDATE_EVENT) || event.acl[principal.id]?.role === EventRole.OWNER) {
          return null
        }
        return permissionDenied(MageEventPermission.UPDATE_EVENT, principal.username, String(event.id))
      }
      
      function isLastOwner(acl: Acl, user: UserId): boolean {
        if (acl[user]?.role !== EventRole.OWNER) {
          return false
        }
        return Object.values(acl).filter(entry => entry.role === EventRole.OWNER).length === 1
      }

        async authorizeEventAccess(event: MageEventAttrs | MageEventModelInstance, user: UserWithRole, appPermission: AnyPermission, eventPermission: EventAccessType): Promise<PermissionDeniedError | null> {
          if (userRoleHasPermission(user, appPermission)) {
            return null
          }
          const hasEventAclPermission = await this.userHasEventPermission(event, user.id, eventPermission)
          if (hasEventAclPermission) {
            return null
          }
          return permissionDenied(appPermission, user.username, String(event.id))
        }
      
        async userHasEventPermission(event: MageEventAttrs | MageEventModelInstance, userId: UserId, eventPermission: EventAccessType): Promise<boolean> {
          if (eventPermission === EventAccessType.Read && await this.userIsParticipantInEvent(event, userId)) {
            return true
          }
          let userEventRole = event.acl[userId]
          if (typeof userEventRole === 'object') {
            userEventRole = userEventRole.role
          }
          const userRoleHasPermission = rolesWithPermission(eventPermission).some(role => role === userEventRole)
          return userRoleHasPermission
        }
      
        /**
         * Check whether the given user is a member of any of the given MAGE event's
         * teams.
         * TODO: This is arguably an entity-layer function, but is here for now as
         * the concept of team membership only really has value in access control
         * decisions, currently.
         * @param event
         * @param userId
         * @returns
         */
        async userIsParticipantInEvent(event: MageEventAttrs | MageEventModelInstance, userId: UserId): Promise<boolean> {
          const teams = await this.resolveTeamsForEvent(event)
          return teams.some(team => team.userIds.indexOf(userId) !== -1)
        }

    Express routes wired in `service/src/app.ts` (~1385-1393):
    - `POST /api/events/:eventId/exports` -> `ExportRoutes` (`adapters/exports/adapters.exports.controllers.web.ts`) -> `CreateExport` (app.impl.exports.ts:93). Middleware: `bearerAuthentication`, `ensureEventScope(eventRepo)` (loads the MageEvent into `context.mageEvent`).
    - `GET /api/exports/mine` -> `FetchExports` (:48); `GET /api/exports/mine/:exportId` -> `GetExportContent` (:60); `DELETE /api/exports/mine/:exportId` -> `DeleteExport` (:199). Middleware: `bearerAuthentication` only.
    - Background task `ExportArchiveTask` (`adapters/exports/adapters.export_archive.task.ts`) started from `initTasks` (app.ts ~1457).
    
    ##### Inputs
    POST body (parsed by `parseExportCreateParams`):
    ```
    { format: 'kml'|'geojson'|'geopackage'|'csv'   (required; EXPORT_FORMATS)
      observations?: { startDate?: ISO8601, endDate?: ISO8601, includeAttachments?: bool (default TRUE),
                       favorites?: bool, important?: bool, users?: UserId[], teams?: TeamId[],
                       hasAttachments?: bool, keyword?: string, condition?: Condition, projection?: [{formId:number, fields:string[]}] }
      locations?: { startDate?, endDate?, users?: UserId[], teams?: TeamId[] } }
    ```
    - Missing format -> InvalidInput `['missing','format']`; unknown format -> InvalidInput listing formats. Bad date -> `Export <observations|locations>.startDate must be a valid ISO-8601 date.`
    - `keyword` kept only if non-empty string; `condition` parsed by `parseConditionFilter` (app.api.observations.ts: recursive `and`/`or`; leaf needs numeric `formId`, string `field`, string `operator`; operators `= != > >= < <= LIKE` (scalar value), `IN`/`NOT IN` (array of string|number|boolean), `IS NULL`/`IS NOT NULL` (no value), `BETWEEN` (2-element string|number); any invalid leaf makes the whole condition `undefined` = silently dropped, not rejected). `fieldFilter` only set if keyword or condition present. Non-array users/teams/projection -> undefined. `hasAttachments: false` -> undefined.
    - Env (`environment/env.js`): `MAGE_EXPORT_DIR` (default `/var/lib/mage/export`), `MAGE_EXPORT_TTL` seconds (default 259200 = 3 days), `MAGE_EXPORT_SWEEP_INTERVAL` seconds (default 28800 = 8h).
    
    ##### Processing flow
    CreateExport:
    1. `withPermission(ensureCreateExportPermission)` — `RoleBasedExportsPermissionService` (permissions/permissions.exports.ts): allowed iff `EventPermissionServiceImpl.userHasEventPermission(event, user.id, Read)` — i.e. user is a member of any of the event's teams (`findTeamsInEvent` populates `teamIds`) OR the event ACL role for the user is in `rolesWithPermission(read)` = OWNER/MANAGER/GUEST. **No app-role permission (e.g. READ_OBSERVATION_ALL) is consulted**; admins not in the event are denied (`permissionDenied('CREATE EXPORT', userId)`).
    2. `exportsRepository.createExport({userId, eventId, ...req})` inserts Mongo doc with `status: Running`, `exportType=format`, `options:{eventId, filter}`, `expirationDate = now + exportTtl*1000`.
    3. `exportFactory(format)` (app.ts initExportsAppLayer) -> Csv/Kml/GeoJson/GeoPackage transform. If null -> InvalidInput `invalid export type` (record from step 2 is left behind as Running; unreachable in practice because the web layer validates format first).
    4. `contentStore.writeContent` -> `FileSystemExportContentStore` opens write stream `<exportDirectory>/<exportId>-<exportType>.zip`; update record `{status: Running, relativePath}`.
    5. Build `ExportParams`: observations -> `findSpec.where = { stateIsAnyOf:['active'], timestampAfter:startDate, timestampBefore:endDate, isFavoriteOfUser: favorites ? user.id : undefined, isFlaggedImportant: important, userIsAnyOf: resolveUserIsAnyOf(teamRepo, users, teams), hasAttachments, fieldFilter }`, `includeAttachments`, `projection`. Locations -> `{ eventId, timestampAfter, timestampBefore, userIsAnyOf }`. `resolveUserIsAnyOf` (app.impl.teams.ts:40): no teams -> users or undefined; else union(users, all `userIds` of `teamRepo.findAllByIds(teams)`), undefined if empty.
    6. `archiver('zip')` piped to file; `exporter.export(event, archive, params)` is started **without await**; the HTTP response returns immediately with the Running export + `url: <root>/api/exports/mine/<id>`.
    7. On success: wait `archive.finalize()` and file `close`, `fs.stat` size, update `{status: Completed, size, summary:{observations, locations}}`, log `<username> exported data` with format, event name, counts.
    8. On failure: log, `deleteContent`, set `status: Failed`, `archive.abort()`.
    
    IterateObservations (:226): if `fieldFilter` present -> `searchRepo.findIdsByFilter(fieldFilter, event)` restricts `where.ids`; then `obsRepoFactory(event.id).iterate(spec)` (async iterable with optional `close`).
    
    Projection helpers: `projectionIncludesForm/Field` return true when projection undefined; `projectedObservationFormFields` drops form entries whose formId not in projection and keeps only listed field keys + `id`, `formId`.
    
    FetchExports: permission = principal exists; `getExportsForUser(user.id)` sorted `_id` desc, populated user (`_id, username, displayName`) and event (`_id, name`); null if referenced docs deleted.
    
    GetExportContent: permission check; `getExportForUser(id, userId)` (owner-only) else 404 `Export`; `readContent` opens file; ExportStoreError -> InfrastructureError; respond `200 application/zip` with `content-length` = stored size if set, piping file.
    
    DeleteExport: `findOneAndDelete({_id, userId})` else 404; `deleteContent` (errors ignored); 204.
    
    ExportArchiveTask.run: mkdir -p exportDirectory; every export with status Running -> set Failed + delete file (server restart recovery); then every `interval` s: delete records and files where `now > expirationDate` (all users, errors logged).
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[POST /api/events/:eventId/exports] --> B[parseExportCreateParams]
      B -->|invalid| E400[InvalidInputError]
      B --> C[CreateExport]
      C --> P{ensureCreateExportPermission\nuserHasEventPermission Read}
      P -->|no| E403[PermissionDenied]
      P --> D[exportsRepository.createExport status=Running]
      D --> F[exportFactory format]
      F --> G[FileSystemExportContentStore.writeContent id-type.zip]
      G --> H[updateExportForUser relativePath]
      H --> I[resolveUserIsAnyOf teams->users]
      I --> J[archiver zip -> file]
      J --> K[exporter.export async]
      J --> R[respond export + url]
      K -->|ok| L[finalize, stat size, status=Completed + summary]
      K -->|error| M[deleteContent, status=Failed, abort]
      T[ExportArchiveTask] --> T1[Running->Failed on boot]
      T --> T2[delete expired every sweep interval]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Mongo collection `exports` (`adapters.exports.db.mongoose.ts`): `_id ObjectId, userId ObjectId ref User, relativePath String, filename String (never set), size Number, exportType String req, status enum Running|Completed|Failed req, options.eventId Number ref Event req, options.filter Mixed (stores the parsed filter incl. favorites boolean), processingErrors [{type,message,createdAt,updatedAt}] (never written), expirationDate Date req, summary.{observations,locations}.{count,startTimestamp,endTimestamp}, createdAt, lastUpdated` (timestamps, `updatedAt` renamed). Reads: observations (via repository iterate; filter above), search index ids, teams, locations, users, devices, attachments, icons (per format). Files: `<MAGE_EXPORT_DIR>/<id>-<exportType>.zip` (write/read/unlink).
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    JSON export record + `url`; ZIP file (contents per format flow); export records status transitions Running -> Completed|Failed; deletion of expired records/files; info log per completed export; permission-denied warn log via `withPermission`.
    
    ##### External calls
    `archiver` (zip), Node `fs`, per-format transforms (separate findings), `searchRepo.findIdsByFilter`, team/event repositories.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - Export job runs in-process, unawaited; any restart marks running exports Failed. A separate worker/container must share `MAGE_EXPORT_DIR`.
    - Missing file on download yields ExportStoreError(ContentNotFound) -> InfrastructureError, not 404 (`readContent` never returns null). `contentStats` error message says "deleting".
    - `relativePath` stored but the store recomputes the path from `id`+`exportType`.
    - `includeAttachments` defaults to true at the web layer.
    - Only `active` observations are exported; favorites resolve to the requesting user.
    - Invalid `condition` is silently ignored (exports more data than requested).
    - Summary timestamps default to epoch 0 / now when no rows.
    - Create permission only checks event read access (team member or ACL role); no app-level role bypass.

GetExportContent/DeleteExport: `exportId`.
    
    ##### Processing flow
    **CreateExport**
    1. `permissionService.ensureCreateExportPermission` (RoleBasedExportsPermissionService): allowed iff `eventPermissions.userHasEventPermission(event, user.id, Read)` — no role permission is consulted.
    2. `exportsRepository.createExport({userId, eventId, ...req})` — persists Export doc (exportType=format, expirationDate = now + exportTtl).
    3. `exportFactory(format)`; if null → `invalidInput('invalid export type')` (record already created and left behind; unreachable from web because the controller validates format first, and the factory switch covers all 4 formats).
    4. `contentStore.writeContent(newExport)` → file stream `<exportDirectory>/<exportId>-<exportType>.zip`; patch `{status: Running, relativePath}` via `updateExportForUser`.
    5. Build `ExportParams`:
       - observations: `resolveUserIsAnyOf(teamRepo, userIsAnyOf, teamIsAnyOf)`; findSpec.where = {stateIsAnyOf:['active'], timestampAfter:startDate, timestampBefore:endDate, isFavoriteOfUser: favorites ? user.id : undefined, isFlaggedImportant: important, userIsAnyOf, hasAttachments, fieldFilter}; includeAttachments; projection.
       - locations: where = {eventId, timestampAfter, timestampBefore, userIsAnyOf}.
    6. `archiver('zip')` piped to content stream; `exporter.export(event, archive, params)` started **without await** (fire-and-forget).
       - success: await `archive.finalize()` and content 'close'; `contentStats` → size (undefined if stat error); update `{status: Completed, size, summary:{observations, locations}}`; log `<username|id> exported data` with format/event/counts.
       - failure: log, `contentStore.deleteContent`, update `{status: Failed}`, `archive.abort()`.
    7. Returns immediately `{...newExport, status: Running, relativePath}`.
    
    **FetchExports**: permission = principal truthy; `repository.getExportsForUser(user.id)`.
    **GetExportContent**: permission (principal truthy) → `getExportForUser(exportId, user.id)` (null → EntityNotFound 'Export') → `contentStore.readContent` (null → EntityNotFound 'Export content'; ExportStoreError → InfrastructureError) → `{export, bytes}`.
    **DeleteExport**: permission → `deleteExportForUser` (null → EntityNotFound) → `contentStore.deleteContent(exp)` (result ignored) → return deleted export.
    **IterateObservations**: if `where.fieldFilter` → `searchRepo.findIdsByFilter(fieldFilter, event)` → ids; `obsRepoFactory(event.id).iterate({...findSpec, where:{...where, ids}})` (Mongo cursor; `includeAttachments=false` → projection `attachments: {$slice: 0}`).
    **Projection helpers**: `projectionIncludesForm/Field` return true when no projection; `projectedObservationFormFields` keeps only form entries whose formId is in the projection and only keys listed in `fields`, always re-adding `id` and `formId`.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[POST /api/events/:id/exports] --> B{ensureCreateExportPermission<br/>event Read ACL}
      B -- denied --> X[PermissionDenied]
      B -- ok --> C[exportsRepository.createExport]
      C --> D{exportFactory format}
      D -- null --> E[invalidInput]
      D -- transform --> F[contentStore.writeContent<br/>id-type.zip]
      F --> G[update status=Running]
      G --> H[resolveUserIsAnyOf teams->users]
      H --> I[archiver zip -> file]
      I --> J[[exporter.export async]]
      I --> R[return Running export]
      J -- resolved --> K[finalize, stat size<br/>status=Completed + summary]
      J -- rejected --> L[deleteContent, status=Failed, abort]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Mongo `exports` (via ExportsRepository/mongoose): userId, eventId, exportType, status (Running|Completed|Failed), relativePath, size, options/filter, expirationDate, summary.{observations,locations}.{count,startTimestamp,endTimestamp}. Files: `<MAGE_EXPORT_DIR>/<id>-<exportType>.zip`. Reads: event observations collection, user locations, teams (findAllByIds), search index ids.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    Zip file on disk; Export record status transitions Running→Completed/Failed; info/error logs. Content download streams the zip.
    
    ##### External calls
    `archiver` (zip), format transforms (CSV/KML/GeoJSON/GeoPackage — separate flows), ObservationSearchRepository, TeamRepository, ExportStore (file system).
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - Export is asynchronous: API returns Running before any data is written; there is no job queue — a process restart mid-export leaves status Running forever (cleanup only via ExportArchiveTask TTL sweep).
    - Observation state is hard-coded to `active`; `favorites` maps to the *requesting* user.
    - `resolveUserIsAnyOf` returns `undefined` (=no user filter) when teams resolve to zero members → export of ALL users' data; team ids are not checked against the event.
    - Summary timestamps default to `new Date(0)` / `new Date()` when no rows.
    - Create permission checks only event ACL, not READ_OBSERVATION_ALL/EVENT or location permissions.
    - GetExportContent does not check status, so a Running (partial) zip can be downloaded.
    - DeleteExport ignores content-delete errors; failure path deletes content then aborts archive (ordering).

    Code:
      export function CreateExport(
        exportFactory: ExportFactory,
        exportsRepository: ExportsRepository,
        contentStore: ExportStore,
        permissionService: api.ExportAppLayerPermissionService,
        teamRepository: TeamRepository,
        log: Logger = NoopLogger
      ): api.CreateExport {
        return async function createExport(req: api.CreateExportRequest): ReturnType<api.CreateExport> {
          return await withPermission<Export, KnownErrorsOf<api.CreateExport>>(
            permissionService.ensureCreateExportPermission(req.context),
            async (): Promise<Export | InvalidInputError> => {
              const user = req.context.requestingPrincipal()
              const { context, format, filter } = req
              const newExport = await exportsRepository.createExport({
                userId: user.id,
                eventId: context.mageEvent.id,
                ...req
              })
      
              const exporter = exportFactory(format)
      
              if (!exporter) {
                return invalidInput('invalid export type', [ `invalid export type: ${format}`, 'type' ])
              }
      
              const { content, relativePath } = contentStore.writeContent(newExport)
      
              const patch = {
                status: ExportStatus.Running,
                relativePath: relativePath
              }
              await exportsRepository.updateExportForUser(newExport.id, user.id, patch)
      
              const exportParams: ExportParams = {}
              if (filter?.observations) {
                const observations = filter.observations
                const observationUserIsAnyOf = await resolveUserIsAnyOf(teamRepository, observations.userIsAnyOf, observations.teamIsAnyOf)
                exportParams.observationParams = {
                  findSpec: {
                    where: {
                      stateIsAnyOf: [ 'active' ],
                      timestampAfter: observations.startDate,
                      timestampBefore: observations.endDate,
                      isFavoriteOfUser: observations.favorites ? user.id : undefined,
                      isFlaggedImportant: observations.important,
                      userIsAnyOf: observationUserIsAnyOf,
                      hasAttachments: observations.hasAttachments,
                      fieldFilter: observations.fieldFilter
                    },
                    includeAttachments: observations.includeAttachments
                  },
                  projection: observations.projection
                }
              }
      
              if (filter?.locations) {
                const locations = filter.locations
                const locationUserIsAnyOf = await resolveUserIsAnyOf(teamRepository, locations.userIsAnyOf, locations.teamIsAnyOf)
                exportParams.locationParams = {
                  findSpec: {
                    where: {
                      eventId: context.mageEvent.id,
                      timestampAfter: locations.startDate,
                      timestampBefore: locations.endDate,
                      userIsAnyOf: locationUserIsAnyOf
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
      
              const archive = archiver('zip')
              archive.pipe(content)
              exporter.export(context.mageEvent, archive, exportParams).then(async result => {
                const streamClosed = once(content, 'close')
                await archive.finalize()
                await streamClosed
                const stats = await contentStore.contentStats(newExport)
                const update = {
                  status: ExportStatus.Completed,
                  size: stats instanceof Stats ? stats.size : undefined,
                  summary: {
                    observations: { ...result.observations},
                    locations: { ...result.locations }
                  }
                }
                await exportsRepository.updateExportForUser(newExport.id, user.id, update)
                log.info(`${(user as { username?: string }).username ?? user.id} exported data`, {
                  format,
                  event: context.mageEvent.name,
                  observations: result.observations?.count ?? 0,
                  locations: result.locations?.count ?? 0
                })
              }).catch(async (err) => {
                log.error('Export error', err)
                await contentStore.deleteContent(newExport)
                await exportsRepository.updateExportForUser(newExport.id, user.id, { status: ExportStatus.Failed })
                archive.abort()
              })
      
              return { ...newExport, ...patch }
            }
          )
        }
      }

    Commentary: Request body parsing and defaults (includeAttachments=true).
    Code:
      function parseExportCreateParams(body: any): ExportCreateParams | InvalidInputError {
        const { format, observations, locations } = body
      
        if (!format) {
          return invalidInput('invalid request', [ 'missing', 'format' ])
        }
      
        if (!EXPORT_FORMATS.includes(format as ExportFormat)) {
          return invalidInput('invalid format', [ `format must be of type ${EXPORT_FORMATS.join(' or ')}`, 'format' ])
        }
      
        const filter: ExportCreateParams['filter'] = {}
      
        if (observations) {
          const parsedObservations = parseExportObservationFilter(observations)
          if (parsedObservations instanceof MageError) return parsedObservations
          filter.observations = parsedObservations
        }
      
        if (locations) {
          const parsedLocations = parseExportLocationFilter(locations)
          if (parsedLocations instanceof MageError) return parsedLocations
          filter.locations = parsedLocations
        }
      
        return {
          format: format as ExportFormat,
          filter
        }
      }
      
      function parseExportObservationFilter(body: any): ExportCreateParams['filter']['observations'] | InvalidInputError {
        const {
          startDate: iso8601StartDate,
          endDate: iso8601EndDate,
          includeAttachments = true,
          favorites,
          important,
          users,
          teams,
          hasAttachments,
          keyword,
          condition,
          projection
        } = body
      
        const startDate = parseExportDate(iso8601StartDate, 'observations.startDate')
        if (startDate instanceof MageError) return startDate
      
        const endDate = parseExportDate(iso8601EndDate, 'observations.endDate')
        if (endDate instanceof MageError) return endDate
      
        const fieldFilter: ObservationFieldFilter = {}
        if (typeof keyword === 'string' && keyword.length) {
          fieldFilter.keyword = keyword
        }
        const parsedCondition = condition ? parseConditionFilter(condition) : undefined
        if (parsedCondition) {
          fieldFilter.condition = parsedCondition
        }
      
        return {
          startDate,
          endDate,
          includeAttachments,
          favorites,
          important,
          userIsAnyOf: Array.isArray(users) ? users : undefined,
          teamIsAnyOf: Array.isArray(teams) ? teams : undefined,
          hasAttachments: hasAttachments || undefined,
          fieldFilter: Object.keys(fieldFilter).length ? fieldFilter : undefined,
          projection: Array.isArray(projection) ? projection : undefined
        }
      }
      
      function parseExportLocationFilter(body: any): ExportCreateParams['filter']['locations'] | InvalidInputError {
        const {
          startDate: iso8601StartDate,
          endDate: iso8601EndDate,
          users,
          teams
        } = body
      
        const startDate = parseExportDate(iso8601StartDate, 'locations.startDate')
        if (startDate instanceof MageError) return startDate
      
        const endDate = parseExportDate(iso8601EndDate, 'locations.endDate')
        if (endDate instanceof MageError) return endDate
      
        return {
          startDate,
          endDate,
          userIsAnyOf: Array.isArray(users) ? users : undefined,
          teamIsAnyOf: Array.isArray(teams) ? teams : undefined
        }
      }
      
      function parseExportDate(iso8601: unknown, fieldName: string): Date | undefined | InvalidInputError {
        if (!iso8601) return undefined
        const date = parseISO8601(iso8601)
        if (!date) {
          return invalidInput(`Export ${fieldName} must be a valid ISO-8601 date.`, [ fieldName ])
        }
        return date
      }

    Commentary: Boot recovery and expiry sweep.
    Code:
        async run(): Promise<void> {
          this.log.info(`Initializing job to check ${this.baseDir} for expired export files every ${this.interval} seconds.`)
      
          this.log.debug(`Creating export directory: ${this.baseDir}`)
          await fs.mkdir(this.baseDir, { recursive: true })
      
          // Server restarted, update previously running exports to Failed
          const exports = await this.repository.getExports()
          for (const exp of exports) {
            if (exp.status === ExportStatus.Running) {
              this.log.info(`Updating status of ${exp.id} to failed and deleting export content`)
              await this.repository.updateExport(exp.id, { status: ExportStatus.Failed })
              await this.store.deleteContent(exp)
            }
          }
      
          await this.schedule()
        }
      
        private async schedule(): Promise<void> {
          await this.doTask()
          setTimeout(() => this.schedule(), this.interval * 1000);
        }
      
        private async doTask(): Promise<void> {
          this.log.info('Checking for expired exports')
          try {
            const exports = await this.repository.getExports()
            for (const e of exports) {
              if (Date.now() > e.expirationDate.getTime()) {
                this.log.info(`Deleting expired export ${e.id}`)
                await this.repository.deleteExport(e.id)
                await this.store.deleteContent(e)
              }
            }
          } catch (err) {
            this.log.error('Error checking for expired exports', err)
          }
        }

  Description: ##### Entry point
    `KmlExportTransform.export` for `format === 'kml'` (deps: locationRepo, IterateObservations, observation iconRepo, observation iconStore, attachmentStore, userRepo, user iconStore).
    
    ##### Inputs
    `ExportParams`, MageEvent (style, forms, fields, primary/variant/feed fields), observation icons for the event.
    
    ##### Processing flow
    1. PassThrough appended as `mage-export.kml`; write XML header with namespaces kml/gx/atom, `<Document><name>MAGE-Export.kml</name><open>1</open>`.
    2. Observations: `iconRepository.getIcons(event.id)`; write styles: event style (only if an icon with no formId/primary/variant exists; id `<eventId>`, href `icons/<contentLocator>`), per form: default style id `<eventId>-<formId>` (href `icons/` empty), per icon with primary+variant id `<eventId>-<formId>-<primary>-<variant>` using `style[variant]`, per icon with primary only id `<eventId>-<formId>-<primary>` using `style[primary]`. Style values fall back to defaults fill/stroke `#5278A2`, fillOpacity 0.2, strokeOpacity 1, strokeWidth 2. Colors converted to KML `aabbggrr` (`~~(opacity*255)` hex). Variant/primary styles mutate running stroke/fill variables so later icons inherit previous icon's values when their style is missing.
    3. `<Folder><name>event.name</name>`; per observation `observationPlacemark`: name = first form entry's `primaryFeedField` and `secondaryFeedField` values joined ` - `, else event name; `visibility 0`; `styleUrl '#'+[eventId, formId, primaryValue, variantValue].join('-')` (variant only if primary present); `TimeStamp.when` = UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ`; geometry: Point `lon,lat`, Polygon outer ring only (extrude 1), LineString (extrude 1, clampToGround, tessellate 1), other -> nothing; description = HTML (CSS inline) with Timestamp, centroid Latitude/Longitude, MGRS, then per projected form a `h4` section with fields that are non-archived, not password/geometry and have a value (attachment: matching attachments for field+form entry; checkbox: **`field.value != null` (form default)**; else truthy), sorted by field id; attachments render `<a href=attachments/<name>>` and `<img width=150>` if contentType image/*; plus GPS section (provider, accuracy).
    4. Attachments per observation appended as `attachments/<name or Attachment_<id>>` inside a **non-awaited `forEach(async)`**.
    5. `</Folder>`; append each event icon content under `icons/<contentLocator>`.
    6. Locations: iterate; on userId change finalize previous user (write placemarks via `placemarks.join()`, append user icon `icons/users/<userId>` and push style `user-<id>`, `</Folder>`), lookup new user and write `<Folder><name>displayName</name>`; location placemark name and when = UTC timestamp, styleUrl `#user-<id>`, description lists all properties `key: value.toString()`. After loop write collected user styles (`styles.join()`).
    7. `</Document></kml>`, end stream.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[KmlExportTransform.export] --> B[write KML header]
      B --> C{observationParams?}
      C -->|yes| D[getIcons -> observationStyles]
      D --> E[Folder event.name]
      E --> F[observationPlacemark per obs]
      F --> G[attachments -> attachments/name unawaited]
      E --> H[icons -> icons/contentLocator]
      C --> I{locationParams?}
      I -->|yes| J[group by consecutive userId -> Folder displayName]
      J --> K[locationPlacemark + user icon icons/users/id]
      I --> L[close Document]
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Reads observations, observation icons (repo + content), attachments, locations, users, user icon content. Writes ZIP entries `mage-export.kml`, `icons/...`, `icons/users/<userId>`, `attachments/<name>`.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    KML + assets in ZIP; summary counts/timestamps; winston info logs.
    
    ##### External calls
    `xmlbuilder2.fragment`, `moment`, `@turf/centroid`, `mgrs`.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - `placemarks.join()`/`styles.join()` use the default comma separator, inserting `,` text between XML elements.
    - `event.name` and `user.displayName` are interpolated into XML without escaping.
    - Attachment appends are not awaited; they may race the archive finalize.
    - Location folders assume iteration is grouped by user; locations whose user is not found are counted but not written.
    - User style is emitted after the folders and its href is `icons/users/<id>` (no extension).
    - Checkbox fields are shown based on form default value, not entry value.
    - Default form style href is `icons` (empty locator).
  Recommendation: Fully documented; customer should decide whether to preserve comma-join and unescaped name behavior.

    ##### Entry point
    `KmlExportTransform.export` for format=`kml` (deps: locationRepo, streamObservations, iconRepository, observationIconStore, attachmentStore, userRepository, userIconStore).
    
    ##### Inputs
    ExportParams; event (id, name, style{fill,stroke,fillOpacity,strokeOpacity,strokeWidth}, forms with style, primaryField, variantField, primaryFeedField, secondaryFeedField); observation icons for event.
    
    ##### Processing flow
    1. Single PassThrough `mage-export.kml`; write XML header with kml/gx/atom namespaces, `<Document><name>MAGE-Export.kml</name><open>1</open>`.
    2. Observations: `iconRepository.getIcons(event.id)`; write styles: `eventStyle` (only if an icon with no formId/primary/variant exists; id=`<eventId>`, href `icons/<contentLocator>`) + per form: default style id `<eventId>-<formId>` (href `icons/` empty), per icon with primary+variant id `<eventId>-<formId>-<primary>-<variant>` (variant style overrides), primary-only id `<eventId>-<formId>-<primary>`. Colors `kmlColor` = opacityHex(~~(op*255)) + BB + GG + RR; defaults fill/stroke `#5278A2`, fillOpacity 0.2, strokeOpacity 1, strokeWidth 2; invalid hex → `000000`.
    3. `<Folder><name>{event.name}</name>`; for each observation: `observationPlacemark` — name = primaryFeedField/secondaryFeedField values of first form entry joined ` - ` else event name; visibility 0; styleUrl `#` + [eventId, formId, primary value, variant value] joined `-` (from first form entry); TimeStamp `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ` UTC; geometry: Point `lon,lat`, Polygon outer ring only (extrude 1), LineString (extrude 1, clampToGround, tessellate 1), else none; description HTML: header Timestamp/Latitude/Longitude (centroid)/MGRS, then per form an h4 + fields (exclude archived/password/geometry; include if attachment exists for field+entry (strict `===`), checkbox if definition `field.value != null`, else truthy entry) sorted by field id; attachments render `<a href=attachments/<name>>` and `<img width=150>` for image/*; other values `.toString()`; GPS section with provider/accuracy.
    4. Attachments appended as `attachments/<name|Attachment_id>` (async forEach, not awaited).
    5. `</Folder>`; append each icon content as `icons/<contentLocator>`.
    6. Locations: iterate; on user change finalize previous user (write placemarks via `placemarks.join()`, append user icon `icons/users/<userId>`, collect `userStyle`, `</Folder>`); fetch user, open `<Folder><name>{displayName}</name>`; placemark name = UTC timestamp, styleUrl `#user-<id>`, description lists every location property `key: value.toString()`. After loop write `styles.join()`.
    7. `</Document></kml>`, end.
    
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      A[KmlExportTransform.export] --> B[write KML header]
      B --> C{observationParams}
      C -- yes --> D[iconRepository.getIcons -> observationStyles]
      D --> E[Folder event.name]
      E --> F[observationPlacemark per obs]
      F --> G[async attachments -> attachments/]
      F --> H[icons -> icons/]
      C --> I{locationParams}
      H --> I
      I -- yes --> J[group by consecutive user -> Folder displayName]
      J --> K[locationPlacemark] --> L[finalizeUser: user icon icons/users/id]
      I --> M[close Document]
      L --> M
    ```
    
    ##### Data
    Reads observation icons (repo + content), observations cursor, attachments, users, user icons, locations cursor.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    Zip: `mage-export.kml`, `icons/...`, `icons/users/<id>`, `attachments/<name>`.
    
    ##### External calls
    xmlbuilder2 `fragment`, moment, @turf/centroid, mgrs, winston log.
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - `event.name` and `user.displayName` are interpolated raw (not XML-escaped) into `<name>`.
    - `placemarks.join()` / `styles.join()` use the default comma separator, inserting `,` text between elements.
    - Location folders are per *consecutive run* of userId; a user reappearing later gets another folder and duplicate icon entry; locations of unknown users are counted but not written.
    - Checkbox inclusion uses form definition `field.value`; if non-null while the entry has no value, `undefined.toString()` throws and fails the export; null location property values also throw.
    - Style variables (strokeWidth/colors) leak from one icon iteration into the next.
    - Attachment append not awaited (race with finalize).

        async exportObservations(
          event: MageEvent,
          params: ObservationExportParams,
          stream: NodeJS.WritableStream,
          archive: Archiver
        ): Promise<ExportItemSummary> {
          const icons = await this.iconRepository.getIcons(event.id)
          stream.write(observationStyles(event, icons))
      
          stream.write(`<Folder>`)
          stream.write(`<name>${event.name}</name>`)
      
          const iterable = await this.streamObservations(event, params.findSpec)
      
          try {
            let count = 0
            let startTimestamp: number | undefined = undefined
            let endTimestamp: number | undefined = undefined
      
            for await (const observation of iterable) {
              if (startTimestamp === undefined || observation.properties.timestamp.getTime() < startTimestamp) {
                startTimestamp = observation.properties.timestamp.getTime()
              }
              if (endTimestamp === undefined || observation.properties.timestamp.getTime() > endTimestamp) {
                endTimestamp = observation.properties.timestamp.getTime()
              }
      
              const forms = projectedObservationFormFields(observation, params.projection)
              stream.write(observationPlacemark(observation, forms, event))
      
              observation.attachments.forEach(async attachment => {
                const content = await this.attachmentStore.readContent(attachment.id, Observation.evaluate(observation, event))
                if (content instanceof Readable) {
                  archive.append(content, { name: attachmentLocator(attachment) })
                }
              })
      
              count++
            }
      
            log.info(`finished writing ${count} observations to kml`)
      
            stream.write(`</Folder>`)
            for (const icon of icons) {
              const iconContent = await this.observationIconStore.readContent(icon)
              if (iconContent instanceof Readable) {
                archive.append(iconContent, { name: icon.contentLocator, prefix: 'icons'})
              }
            }
            return { count, startTimestamp: new Date(startTimestamp ?? 0), endTimestamp: new Date(endTimestamp ?? Date.now()) }
          } finally {
            if (iterable.close) {
              iterable.close()
            }
          }
        }
      
        async exportLocations(
          event: MageEvent,
          params: LocationExportParams,
          stream: NodeJS.WritableStream,
          archive: Archiver
        ): Promise<ExportItemSummary> {
          const iterable = this.locationRepository.iterate(params.findSpec)
      
          let count = 0
          let startTimestamp: number | undefined = undefined
          let endTimestamp: number | undefined = undefined
          let user: User | null = null
          let placemarks: string[] = []
          const styles: string[] = []
      
          const finalizeUser = async (user: User, placemarks: string[]) => {
            stream.write(placemarks.join())
            const iconContent = await this.userIconStore.readContent(user)
            if (iconContent instanceof Readable) {
              archive.append(iconContent, { name: `icons/users/${user.id}`})
              styles.push(userStyle(user))
            }
            stream.write('</Folder>')
          }
      
          try {
            for await (const location of iterable) {
              if (!user || user.id !== location.userId) {
                if (user) {
                  await finalizeUser(user, placemarks)
                }
      
                placemarks = []
                user = await this.userRepository.findById(location.userId)
                if (user) {
                  stream.write(`<Folder><name>${user.displayName}</name>`)
                }
              }
      
              if (user) {
                placemarks.push(locationPlacemark(user, location))
              }
      
              count++
              if (startTimestamp === undefined || location.properties.timestamp.getTime() < startTimestamp) {
                startTimestamp = location.properties.timestamp.getTime()
              }
              if (endTimestamp === undefined || location.properties.timestamp.getTime() > endTimestamp) {
                endTimestamp = location.properties.timestamp.getTime()
              }
            }
      
            if (user) {
              await finalizeUser(user, placemarks)
            }
      
            stream.write(styles.join())
      
            log.info(`finished writing ${count} locations to kml`)
      
            return { count, startTimestamp: new Date(startTimestamp ?? 0), endTimestamp: new Date(endTimestamp ?? Date.now()) }
          } finally {
            if (iterable.close) {
              iterable.close()
            }
          }
        }
  Snippet: service/src/app.impl/exports/app.impl.exports.kml.ts:500-600
    Commentary: Placemark construction.
    Code:
      function observationPlacemark(
        observation: ObservationAttrs,
        forms: FormEntry[],
        event: MageEvent
      ): string {
        const names = []
        const firstFormEntry = (observation.properties.forms && observation.properties.forms.length) ? observation.properties.forms[0] : null
        if (firstFormEntry) {
          const form = event.formFor(firstFormEntry.formId)
          if (form?.primaryFeedField && firstFormEntry[form.primaryFeedField]) {
            names.push(firstFormEntry[form.primaryFeedField])
          }
          if (form?.secondaryFeedField && firstFormEntry[form?.secondaryFeedField]) {
            names.push(firstFormEntry[form.secondaryFeedField])
          }
        }
        const sections = forms.reduce((sections: any[], formEntry: FormEntry) => {
          const form = event.formFor(formEntry.formId)
          if (!form) {
            return sections
          }
          const properties = form.fields
            .filter(field => !field.archived && field.type !== 'password' && field.type !== 'geometry')
            .filter(field => {
              let hasValue = false
              switch (field.type) {
                case 'attachment':
                  hasValue = observation.attachments.some(attachment => {
                    return attachment.fieldName === field.name &&
                      attachment.observationFormId === formEntry.id
                  })
                  break
                case 'checkbox':
                  hasValue = field.value != null
                  break
                default:
                  hasValue = !!formEntry[field.name]
              }
              return hasValue
            })
            .sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id)
            .map(field => {
              let value: any = formEntry[field.name]
              if (field.type === 'attachment') {
                value = observation.attachments.filter(attachment => {
                  return attachment.fieldName === field.name &&
                    attachment.observationFormId === formEntry.id
                })
              }
              return {
                key: field.title,
                type: field.type,
                value: value
              }
            })
          return [
            ...sections,
            {
              title: form.name,
              properties: properties
            }
          ]
        }, [] as any[])
      
        const gpsProperties = []
        const { provider, accuracy } = observation.properties
        if (provider) gpsProperties.push({ key: 'Location Provider', value: provider })
        if (accuracy) gpsProperties.push({ key: 'Location Accuracy +/- (meters)', value: accuracy })
        if (gpsProperties.length) {
          sections.push({ title: 'GPS', properties: gpsProperties })
        }
      
        const styles = [ String(event.id) ]
        if (firstFormEntry) {
          const form = event.formFor(firstFormEntry.formId)
          if (form) {
            styles.push(String(form.id))
            if (form.primaryField && firstFormEntry[form.primaryField]) {
              styles.push(String(firstFormEntry[form.primaryField]))
              if (form.variantField && firstFormEntry[form.variantField]) {
                styles.push(String(firstFormEntry[form.variantField]))
              }
            }
          }
        }
      
        const coordinates = placemarkCoordinates(observation)
        const description = placemarkDescription(observation, sections)
        const placemark = {
          name: names.length ? names.join(' - ') : event.name,
          visibility: 0,
          styleUrl: '#' + styles.join('-'),
          TimeStamp: {
            when: moment(observation.properties.timestamp).utc().format('YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss') + 'Z'
          }
        }
      
        return fragment({
          Placemark: { ...placemark, ...coordinates, ...description }
        }).end()
      }

      export async function findPendingAttachments(limit: number): Promise<PendingAttachmentReference[]> {
      
        // Set the array of documents
        const eventDocs = await mongoose.connection.collection<{ _id: number, collectionName: string }>('events').find({}).toArray()
      
        // Loop through each document
        const references: PendingAttachmentReference[] = []
        for (const eventDoc of eventDocs) {
          if (references.length >= limit) {
            break
          }
          const model = legacy.observationModel({ id: eventDoc._id, collectionName: eventDoc.collectionName })
      
          // mongo aggregation pipeline
          const remaining = limit - references.length
          const pipeline = [
            { $match: { 'attachments.processingStatus': AttachmentProcessingStatus.Pending } },
            { $project: { _id: true, attachments: true } },
            { $unwind: '$attachments' },
            { $match: { 'attachments.processingStatus': AttachmentProcessingStatus.Pending } },
            { $project: { _id: false, observationId: '$_id', attachmentId: '$attachments._id' } },
            { $limit: remaining },
          ]
      
          // Run the pipeline against the model
          const matches = await model.aggregate(pipeline)
      
          // loop over the matches
          for (const match of matches) {
            references.push({
              eventId: eventDoc._id,
              observationId: match.observationId.toString(),
              attachmentId: match.attachmentId.toString()
            })
          }
        }
        return references
      }

        const routes = express.Router().use(express.json())
      
        routes.route('/')
          .get(async (req, res, next) => {
            const appReq = createAppRequest(req)
            const appRes = await app.readRoles(appReq)
            if (appRes.success) {
              return res.json(appRes.success)
            }
            next(appRes.error)
          })
          .post(async (req, res, next) => {
            const role = parseRoleBody(req.body)
            if (role instanceof MageError) {
              return next(role)
            }
            const appReq = createAppRequest(req, { role })
            const appRes = await app.createRole(appReq)
            if (appRes.success) {
              return res.json(appRes.success)
            }
            next(appRes.error)
          })
      
        routes.route('/:roleId')
          .get(async (req, res, next) => {
            const appReq = createAppRequest(req, { roleId: req.params.roleId })
            const appRes = await app.readRole(appReq)
            if (appRes.success) {
              return res.json(appRes.success)
            }
            next(appRes.error)
          })
          .put(async (req, res, next) => {
            const update = parseRoleUpdateBody(req.body)
            const appReq = createAppRequest(req, { roleId: req.params.roleId, update })
            const appRes = await app.updateRole(appReq)
            if (appRes.success) {
              return res.json(appRes.success)
            }
            next(appRes.error)
          })
          .delete(async (req, res, next) => {
            const appReq = createAppRequest(req, { roleId: req.params.roleId })
            const appRes = await app.deleteRole(appReq)
            if (appRes.success) {
              return res.json(appRes.success)
            }
            next(appRes.error)
          })
      
        return routes.use(compatibilityMageAppErrorHandler)
      }
      
      function parseRoleBody(body: any): { name: string, description?: string, permissions: string[] } | InvalidInputError {
        if (!body || typeof body.name !== 'string' || !body.name) {
          return invalidInput("cannot create role: 'name' param not specified", ['name'])
        }
        return {
          name: body.name,
          description: typeof body.description === 'string' ? body.description : undefined,
          permissions: parsePermissions(body.permissions)
        }
      }
      
      function parseRoleUpdateBody(body: any): { name?: string, description?: string, permissions?: string[] } {
        const update: { name?: string, description?: string, permissions?: string[] } = {}
        if (typeof body?.name === 'string') {
          update.name = body.name
        }
        if (typeof body?.description === 'string') {
          update.description = body.description
        }
        if (body?.permissions !== undefined) {
          update.permissions = parsePermissions(body.permissions)
        }
        return update
      }
      
      function parsePermissions(permissions: unknown): string[] {
        if (Array.isArray(permissions)) {
          return permissions
        }
        if (typeof permissions === 'string') {
          return permissions.split(',')
        }
        return []
      }

    Code:
        async resolveContent(url: URL): Promise<NodeJS.ReadableStream | UrlResolutionError> {
          const contentPath = this.localPathOfUrl(url)
          if (typeof contentPath !== 'string') {
            return contentPath
          }
          let stats: fs.Stats
          try {
            stats = await fsx.stat(contentPath)
          }
          catch (err) {
            return new UrlResolutionError(url, 'no content found')
          }
          if (stats.isFile()) {
            return fs.createReadStream(contentPath)
          }
          return new UrlResolutionError(url, 'no content found')
        }
      
        /**
         * Resolve the local path the given plugin resource URL references.
         * @param url a plugin URL that refers to a resource in a plugin module
         * @returns
         */
        localPathOfUrl(url: URL): string | UrlResolutionError {
          if (!this.canResolve(url)) {
            return new UrlResolutionError(url, 'invalid scheme')
          }
          const pluginPath = PluginResourceUrl.pluginPathOf(url)
          if (!pluginPath) {
            return new UrlResolutionError(url, 'not a plugin url')
          }
          const longestMatchingPlugin = this.pluginNamesDescending.find(pluginName => pluginPath.startsWith(pluginName))
          if (!longestMatchingPlugin) {
            return new UrlResolutionError(url, 'no matching plugin module')
          }
          const resolveOpts: { paths?: string[] } = {}
          if (Array.isArray(this.extraSearchPaths)) {
            resolveOpts.paths = this.extraSearchPaths
          }
          let manifestPath: string | null = null
          try {
            manifestPath = require.resolve(longestMatchingPlugin + '/package.json', resolveOpts)
          }
          catch (err) {
            // no package.json, no problem
          }
          let mainFilePath
          try {
            mainFilePath = require.resolve(longestMatchingPlugin, resolveOpts)
          }
          catch (err) {
            return new UrlResolutionError(url, String(err))
          }
          const baseDir = path.dirname(manifestPath || mainFilePath)
          const contentRelPath = pluginPath.slice(longestMatchingPlugin.length + 1)
          if (!contentRelPath) {
            if (url.pathname.endsWith('/')) {
              return baseDir
            }
            return mainFilePath
          }
          const contentPath = path.join(baseDir, contentRelPath)
          return contentPath
        }

  Description: ##### Entry point
    `/api/events/:<eventScopeKey>/observations/:observationId/attachments/:attachmentId` (same mount/auth as observation API) with verbs PUT, GET, DELETE.
    
    ##### Inputs
    PUT: `multipart/form-data` with exactly one file part named `attachment`, zero fields (busboy `limits:{files:1, fields:0}`). The part's mime type and filename become `ExoIncomingAttachmentContent {bytes: stream, mediaType, name}`.
    GET: query `size` (int; min thumbnail dimension), header `Range: bytes=start-end` (both numbers required; open ranges ignored).
    
    ##### Processing flow
    ```mermaid
    flowchart TD
      P[PUT] --> BB{busboy init}
      BB -->|throws| R400[400 message]
      BB --> PIPE[req.pipe busboy]
      PIPE --> FILE{file event fieldName == attachment}
      FILE -->|no| DRAIN[stream.resume + invalid structure]
      FILE --> SAC[app.storeAttachmentContent]
      SAC --> OBS{observation and attachment exist}
      OBS -->|no| N404
      OBS --> MT{mediaType == attachment.contentType}
      MT -->|no| I400[invalid input]
      MT --> PERM{ensureStoreAttachmentContentPermission}
      PERM -->|denied| D403
      PERM --> HOOKS{attachmentHooks registered}
      HOOKS -->|none| SAVE[attachmentStore.saveContent final]
      HOOKS -->|staged ref| PEND1[patch Pending + stagedContentId]
      HOOKS -->|fresh stream| STAGE[stagePendingContent + pipeline to tempLocation -> Pending]
      SAVE --> PATCH[repo.patchAttachment attachments.$]
      PEND1 --> PATCH
      STAGE --> PATCH
      PATCH --> RESP[afterUploadStream -> res.json attachmentJson]
      FIELD[field / filesLimit / fieldsLimit events] --> INV[afterUploadStream invalid structure 400]
      CLOSE[busboy close] --> FIRE[emit afterUploadStream, removeAllListeners]
      G[GET] --> RAC[app.readAttachmentContent]
      RAC --> THUMB{size given}
      THUMB -->|yes| TH[readThumbnailContent else full readContent]
      THUMB -->|no| RC[readContent with range]
      TH --> W[writeHead 200 or 206 + pipe]
      RC --> W
      DEL[DELETE] --> S204[204 no-op]
    ```
    Upload details: `afterUploadStream(finish)` defers the HTTP response until busboy emits `close` (so the request body is fully consumed); if a deferred listener is already registered, later calls are ignored (first outcome wins). On success logs `successfully stored attachment ...` and returns the attachment JSON (`url` set if contentStored). If store returns neither success nor error -> invalid structure. Store errors: `AttachmentStoreError` StorageError -> 500, other codes -> 400; `patchAttachment` null -> 404 (observation deleted concurrently); AttachmentNotFoundError -> 400. `saveContent` returning null -> success with unchanged observation.
    Permission `ensureStoreAttachmentContentPermission`: allowed with update permission; additional creator-based allowance when content not yet stored (creator + create permission) — lines 63-91 of permissions.observations.ts partially read.
    Download: `ensureReadObservationPermission`; 404 for missing observation/attachment/content; thumbnail chosen by `thumbnailIndexForTargetDimension`, falls back to original; range ignored when `size` given (bytesRange undefined). Headers: content-type, content-length (range length or size), content-range `bytes s-e/<size|*>`; status 206 for range else 200. Missing success -> 500 'unknown application response'.
    
    ##### Data
    Observation doc in `observations<eventId>`: `findOneAndUpdate({_id, attachments:{$elemMatch:{_id}}}, {$set:{'attachments.$': attachmentDoc}}, {new:true})`. Content in `AttachmentStore` rooted at `environment.attachmentBaseDirectory` (`MAGE_ATTACHMENT_DIR`, default `/var/lib/mage/attachments`), including staged/pending temp content.
    
    ##### Outputs & side effects
    File written to attachment store (final or staged). Attachment sub-doc patched with contentLocator/size etc. or `processingStatus: Pending`, `stagedContentId`. Staged attachments are later picked up by `startAttachmentProcessing` (main.impl.attachment_processing.ts) via `findPendingAttachments` (see separate flow) which runs plugin hooks (e.g. ClamAV) and finalizes or rejects.
    
    ##### External calls
    busboy multipart parser; `AttachmentStore.saveContent/stagePendingContent/readContent/readThumbnailContent`; plugin AttachmentHooks indirectly (async job).
    
    ##### Migration notes
    - Uploaded part mime type must equal the attachment's declared contentType exactly (set earlier via observation PUT).
    - When hooks are registered, upload response returns before scanning: content is not readable until the background job finalizes.
    - DELETE always returns 204 and does nothing (iOS compatibility); actual removal happens via observation PUT -> AttachmentsRemoved domain event.
    - Range parsing drops non-numeric parts; `bytes=100-` is treated as full content.
    - Errors from busboy init are returned as 400 with raw error message.
  Recommendation: Fully documented; AttachmentStore filesystem layout is in another adapter file outside this batch.
